title: Chief People Officer
description: Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future? At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world. We are seeking a Chief People Officer to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact. About Hadley Designs Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children. Our Mission: We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning. Our Vision: We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families. Role Overview As the Chief People Officer, you will be responsible for leading the development of people systems and strategies that enable Hadley Designs to scale and grow. In this role, you will partner with leadership to create the talent systems required to attract, develop, and retain a high-performing workforce. Your focus will be on building scalable, high-performance systems that align with the company’s growth objectives and help foster a positive organizational culture. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape how we build and nurture our team, enabling both the company and our people to succeed. You will play an integral role in supporting our mission by ensuring that Hadley Designs has the right talent and organizational structure to achieve long-term success. Key Responsibilities - People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for attracting, engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, aligned with the company’s growth objectives. - Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business. - Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization. - Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention. - Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness. - External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary. How Success Is Measured - Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business’s ability to scale. - Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement. - Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment. - Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company’s growth and success. Who You Are You are a strategic, results-driven leader with a passion for creating systems that empower teams and enable sustainable growth. You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and have a track record of building effective people systems in alignment with business goals. You Have: - 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR leadership, or a related field, ideally in a fast-growing environment. - Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field. - Proven ability to build scalable systems that attract, develop, and retain talent. - Strong experience working with distributed and remote teams. - A passion for people development, with the ability to design and implement programs that foster growth, learning, and employee satisfaction. - Excellent communication and relationship-building skills at all levels of the organization. - A growth mindset and a collaborative approach to solving problems. - Experience using data to drive decisions and measure success. Why You’ll Love Working Here - Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand. - Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration. - Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours. Benefits: - Remote-first work environment - Paid time off and holidays - Access to learning resources and professional development - Free access to Hadley Designs products - Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CMO - Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

title: Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA
description: WISE SCOUT RECRUITMENT OPERATIONS & CLIENT SUCCESS VA Remote · Full-Time ABOUT WISE SCOUT Wise Scout is a recruitment firm that helps small and growing businesses find and hire exceptional remote talent, primarily in the Philippines. We're a small, tight-knit team that does meaningful work: we match the right people with the right opportunities and help businesses build teams they're genuinely proud of. We're a caring, lighthearted team that believes work should be purposeful but not all-consuming. We care about our families, our people, and doing things well. If you've ever wanted to be part of a company where you're treated as a person first — this is that place. We're growing, and this hire is a critical next step. The person who steps into this role won't just support the work, they'll help shape how we operate and eventually build a team of their own. ROLE OVERVIEW We're looking for a Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA to be the operational engine behind Wise Scout's hiring pipelines and client relationships. This is a role for someone who loves moving things forward; who sees a task and gets it done without waiting to be told twice. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our recruitment process: setting up client meetings, building assessment pipelines, posting jobs, filtering candidates, tracking progress, and keeping clients informed every step of the way. You'll also support internal HR for our staff and jump into client-facing calls when needed. This isn't a role where you'll wait for perfect instructions. We have processes — many of them — but they're still being refined. You'll need to be comfortable stepping into some ambiguity, figuring out what the next step is, and moving forward. If that excites you, you'll thrive here. SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY This role requires meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours, as client meetings and internal team calls happen in U.S. time zones. - At least half of your working hours must be available during U.S. business hours in the Central time zone. During busy weeks, around a quarter of your hours will be spent in the U.S. Central time afternoons (between 12–4am PHT) - Weekly all-hands meeting with the full Wise Scout team (Tuesdays 2pm CST/3am PHT) - Weekly operational sync with Hiring Coordinator to drive hiring pipelines forward - Schedule is otherwise flexible; we trust you to manage your time and deliver results WHAT YOU'LL OWN This role is broad but focused. Here are the five core areas you'll be responsible for: 1. CLIENT COMMUNICATION & RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT - Set up and schedule intro calls with new clients; follow up with meeting notes, to-dos, and next steps - Maintain consistent, professional communication with clients throughout the hiring process - Send follow-up check-ins over days and weeks to stay top of mind with prospective clients - Represent Wise Scout warmly and confidently in email and on video calls - Potentially run intro meetings and hiring calls with clients independently over time 2. HIRING PIPELINE MANAGEMENT - Build and manage assessment pipelines in Criteria Corp for each active role - Write experience questionnaires: self-assessment quizzes designed to quantify a candidate's background through how they answer, not just what they say - Post job descriptions across multiple job boards - Download and score applicants in spreadsheets; filter to top candidates based on scores and answers - Move candidates through each stage of the pipeline with clear documentation and communication 3. RECRUITMENT REPORTING & TRACKING - Maintain a master tracking spreadsheet showing all open roles, current stage, and time-in-process for each - Upload data and report regularly to leadership on pipeline health: how many applicants, who's moving forward, and where things stand - Ensure nothing falls through the cracks between steps or between client touchpoints 4. JOB DESCRIPTION WRITING - Use AI tools (and interview notes) to draft compelling, accurate job descriptions for each client role - Collaborate with team to refine and finalize before posting 5. INTERNAL HR & STAFF SUPPORT - Check in regularly with Wise Scout's internal staff to gauge workload, morale, and needs - Answer basic technical questions about Slack, ---------- , and other internal tools - Track team hours in ---------- , compile timesheets, and submit payroll through ---------- - Support onboarding of new hires as the team grows WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Skills and tools can be taught. title: Hiring Senior DTC eCommerce Video Editor
job_title: Hiring Senior DTC eCommerce Video Editor
description: Remote | Full-Time | UGC, AI & Motion Graphics | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories About Growing Pains Marketing Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct-response advertising. We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD/THC-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter. We are looking for a highly skilled DTC eCommerce Video Editor with experience creating UGC ads, AI-generated video, direct-response creative, motion graphics, and short-form paid social content. This is not just a role for someone who knows how to cut clips together. We need an editor who understands why an ad works, how to capture attention within the first few seconds, how to make AI content look and sound human, and how to turn scripts and creative briefs into polished advertisements that drive purchases. You must be an expert at the fundamentals of editing, including pacing, storytelling, sound design, captions, typography, color correction, motion graphics, visual hierarchy, and platform-specific formatting. Role Overview As our Video Editor, you will turn scripts, raw UGC footage, product assets, AI-generated content, and creative briefs into high-performing video ads for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form platforms. You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and switching between different products, audiences, offers, and brand styles. You will work closely with creative strategists, media buyers, designers, UGC creators, and leadership to consistently produce new advertisements, iterations, hooks, and creative variations. You must be able to work quickly without sacrificing quality, brand accuracy, or compliance. Key Responsibilities Direct-Response Video Editing Edit short-form video ads for DTC eCommerce brands. Turn scripts and creative briefs into clear, persuasive advertisements. Create strong hooks that capture attention within the first one to three seconds. Structure videos around customer problems, desires, objections, benefits, proof, offers, and calls to action. Use pacing, visual changes, pattern interrupts, B-roll, captions, sound design, and motion graphics to maintain attention. Create meaningful creative variations rather than simply changing fonts or colors. Adapt videos for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other placements. UGC Editing Edit raw UGC footage into authentic, natural-looking advertisements. Remove pauses, mistakes, weak lines, and unnecessary sections without making the creator sound unnatural. Add relevant B-roll, product footage, screenshots, reviews, graphics, captions, and visual proof. Understand when UGC should look polished and when it should feel casual or imperfect. Create testimonials, founder videos, demonstrations, problem-solution ads, listicles, comparisons, and other UGC formats. Work effectively with footage that may have poor framing, inconsistent audio, or limited B-roll. AI Video Production Create AI-generated and AI-assisted video advertisements. Generate believable AI spokesperson videos Create AI B-roll that supports the script and remains visually consistent. Produce AI voices that sound natural, conversational, emotionally appropriate, and human. Adjust pacing, pauses, pronunciation, emphasis, breaths, and delivery to avoid robotic audio. Identify and correct unnatural lip movement, facial expressions, body movement, hands, objects, backgrounds, and other AI artifacts. Document AI tools, prompts, settings, and generated assets. Motion Graphics Create custom motion graphics that improve clarity and retention. Animate headlines, benefits, features, reviews, statistics, offers, calls to action, and product information. Use professional easing, timing, hierarchy, and visual direction. Create motion that supports the message without distracting from it. Avoid excessive effects, random transitions, and template-heavy editing. Build reusable motion systems while maintaining each brand’s distinct style. Sound Design and Audio Clean and balance dialogue audio. Remove distracting noise when possible. Select music that supports the video’s tone and target customer. Mix voice, music, and sound effects appropriately. Use sound effects intentionally to reinforce visual changes, transitions, text, and product ---------- nts. Correct poor pronunciation and unnatural AI voice delivery. Ensure dialogue remains clear on mobile devices. Captions and Typography Create readable captions designed for mobile viewing. Use clear hierarchy between spoken captions, hooks, benefits, offers, and calls to action. Follow brand fonts, colors, and style guidelines. Keep important text inside platform-safe areas. Check every video for spelling, grammar, capitalization, and punctuation errors. Avoid overcrowded layouts and excessive on-screen text. Brand and Compliance Accuracy Follow each client’s brand guidelines precisely. Use approved product images, packaging, logos, fonts, colors, and claims. Review briefs carefully before beginning work. Understand that many clients operate in restricted or compliance-sensitive categories. Avoid introducing unapproved health, medical, financial, performance, or product claims. Flag potential compliance issues before publishing. Maintain consistency between the advertisement, landing page, offer, and product. Agency Workflow Manage projects across multiple client accounts. Follow naming conventions, folder structures, deadlines, and project-management systems. Maintain organized project files that another editor can easily open and revise. Submit editable source files for all completed work. Communicate blockers and deadline risks before they become problems. Respond professionally to revisions and client feedback. Complete revisions quickly without repeating previous mistakes. Record Loom videos when needed to explain creative decisions. Provide clear beginning-of-day and end-of-day updates. Requirements Professional video-editing experience. Experience editing direct-response advertisements for DTC eCommerce brands. Experience editing authentic UGC-style advertisements. Experience creating or integrating AI video, AI voices, AI spokespeople, or AI-generated B-roll. Strong knowledge of motion graphics, sound design, captions, pacing, visual hierarchy, color correction, and editing fundamentals. Understanding of short-form advertising for Meta and similar platforms. Ability to turn a script and basic asset package into a complete advertisement. Ability to make AI content look and sound human. Ability to work across multiple brands without making every video look the same. EXCELLENT WRITTEN AND SPOKEN ENGLISH Comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your work. Organized, responsive, fast, and able to manage multiple deadlines. Comfortable receiving direct feedback and completing revisions. Able to provide editable project files and organized source assets. Comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories. Available during some U.S. working hours, generally between 6:00–9:00 AM and 3:00–5:00 PM Eastern Time, depending on your assigned shift. You should be highly proficient with at least one professional editing workflow, (not just capcut) such as: Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects DaVinci Resolve Final Cut Pro Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred: Photoshop Illustrator Runway Kling Veo HeyGen ElevenLabs ChatGPT Midjourney ---------- Google Drive Slack Asana Motion Foreplay Meta Ad Library TikTok Creative Center Using CapCut is acceptable, but CapCut experience alone does not qualify someone as a senior editor. Your portfolio must demonstrate professional editing fundamentals, direct-response judgment, and agency-level execution. Nice to Have Experience working inside a DTC eCommerce agency. Experience with wellness, supplements, CBD, telemedicine, research compounds, or other restricted categories. Experience reviewing creative performance data. Experience creating multiple hook variations from one concept. Experience working with UGC creators. Experience writing or improving UGC scripts. Experience building repeatable editing systems and templates. Experience reviewing or managing junior editors. Experience with AI prompt engineering. Experience with product photography, graphic design, or creative strategy. Compensation Base pay: $1,500–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, skill level, speed, and quality. Higher compensation may be considered for candidates who can: Consistently produce senior-level work. Create advanced motion graphics. Lead AI video production. Review and improve the work of other editors. Help establish editing systems and quality-control processes. Operate with minimal supervision. This is a full-time position. Hiring Process Step 1: Application Complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work. Step 2: Level 1 Test Strong applicants will receive a short Level 1 editing test. You will receive: A completed 15-second script. Basic product and brand assets. Product and offer information. Basic creative direction. You will create a punchy, 15-second vertical AI-assisted UGC advertisement. The video must: Feel human and believable. Use a natural-sounding voice. Include an AI spokesperson or AI-assisted presenter. Include at least three to four relevant B-roll shots. Capture attention immediately. Include readable captions. Include music and sound design. Clearly communicate the product or offer. End with a clear call to action. Step 3: Interview Candidates with a strong Level 1 test will be invited to an interview. You will be asked to: Walk us through your Level 1 process. Explain your editing and AI decisions. Discuss your experience with UGC, motion graphics, sound design, direct response, and agency workflows. Potentially complete a small live revision. Step 4: Level 2 Test Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced editing test (full 8 hour day) The Level 2 test will involve creating up to 5  30- 60 second direct-response UGC advertisement using from a creative brief with brand guidelines, product images and script provided. You will need to create AI-generated content (b-roll and talking head clips) , motion graphics, captions and sound design. You will allso be asked to create alternate hooks or format variations. Step 5: Final Interview and Offer The strongest candidates may complete a final interview, reference check, or short paid agency trial before an offer is made. Application Requirements Please answer the questions carefully. Generic or fully AI-generated answers that do not specifically address your experience will not be considered. You must include a Loom video under five minutes introducing yourself, explaining your experience, and walking us through examples of your work. Explain exactly what you personally created in each example, including any templates or AI tools used. Which portfolio example best represents your current ability, and why? UGC Editing What makes a UGC advertisement feel authentic, and what commonly makes it feel fake or overproduced? How do you handle footage with slow delivery, long pauses, poor framing, limited B-roll, or weak audio? How do you d ---------- where to add B-roll, captions, visual proof, and pattern interrupts? AI Video Which AI video, voice, and image-generation tools have you used professionally? Walk us through your process for making an AI spokesperson, voice, and supporting visuals look and sound human. What AI artifacts or consistency problems do you check before delivering a final video? Editing Fundamentals Which editing and motion-graphics programs do you use professionally, and what is your strongest software? Explain how you approach pacing, color correction, audio mixing, captions, and mobile-safe visual hierarchy. How do you organize footage, graphics, music, AI assets, project files, and final exports? Direct Response What makes a strong opening hook, and what should happen within the first three seconds of a Meta ad? How is editing for purchases different from editing for views or entertainment? Give one example of a video ad that performed well or poorly and explain what you learned from it. Agency Experience How do you manage multiple brands, competing deadlines, and urgent revision requests? How do you handle feedback you disagree with and prevent the same editing mistake from happening twice? Communication Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain your rating. Are you comfortable communicating through Slack, calls, and Loom videos with strategists, media buyers, leadership, and clients? As written above, you must Include a Loom video under five minutes introducing yourself and walking us through your experience and strongest work. description: ABOUT US We are building a new kind of real estate platform in the United States. It is called The Buyer Listing Service. Today, real estate websites only show homes that are for sale. We are building the buy side of the market for real estate agents. On our platform, real estate agents post buyer want-listings, not for sale listings. Our system then uses AI to match both buyer agents and seller agents together. We work directly with the official real estate databases (called MLSs) that agents use across the US. More of these databases are signing up with us every month and we're growing fast. We are a small and fast-moving team. When you write code here, it ships quickly and real people use it. This is a rare chance to help build a brand-new product from a growth stage, take real ownership, and grow with the company. THE KIND OF PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for an experienced engineer who can work independently. Over time, you will own and run large parts of this platform. We are relying on your expertise. This is not a junior role and we are not looking for someone we train from the basics. If you need a senior developer checking all of your work, this is not the right fit. If you want real ownership and the chance to be the technical expert on a growing product, it is a great fit. WHAT YOU WILL DO • Build and improve features across our website and our backend API • Review and merge code changes (we use a clean pull request workflow on GitHub) • Connect and clean real estate data from different sources so it fits our system • Use AI tools (like Claude) to help map and clean messy data • Work closely with the founder and one other developer, and increasingly own your areas YOU MUST HAVE • 4+ years of professional full-stack experience, and the proven ability to work on your own • Strong fundamentals, not just frameworks. You can explain how JavaScript works (for example, the event loop), how the web works, and how to model and query a SQL database. • Strong skills in Node.js and Express • Strong skills in React • Comfortable writing raw SQL (we use MySQL, no ORM) • Real experience integrating and cleaning messy data and APIs from other systems • A habit of learning on your own. You have personal projects or things you built to teach yourself. • Clean Git habits and small, focused pull requests • Good written English (most of our work is async and in writing) • Able to follow written rules and instructions exactly HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI We use AI tools like Claude every day and we want people who use them well. But we are hiring an experienced engineer, not a person who copies and pastes from a chatbot. You should be able to explain why your code works, and fix it when the AI gives a wrong answer. In our process we will always ask you to explain your decisions, so deep experience matters more than fast answers. NICE TO HAVE • Experience with AWS • Experience using AI or LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) in real projects • Experience with data pipelines or ETL HOW WE WORK • We write small, focused changes. We do not refactor code that is not part of the task. • We follow a written set of rules for the codebase. Following instructions matters more here than working fast. • We welcome AI tools. We want people who use them well to do more. HOURS Full-time, 40 hours per week. We would like you to work US East Coast hours if you can. This helps you work at the same time as the rest of the team. HOW TO APPLY 1. Start your message with the word BLUEPRINT so we know you read this post. 2. Send a link to one project you built and are proud of. Tell us in 2 or 3 sentences what it does, what part you built, and why you built it that way. Be ready to explain your choices on a call. 3. Tell us your experience with Node, React, and SQL, and the largest project you have owned or led. 4. Tell us if you have used AI or LLM tools in your work, and how. Our process is a short call, then a deeper technical interview, then a small paid task using fake data, then a short call to walk through your code together. We will reply to strong applicants.

title: Supply Chain & Logistics Manager
description: Supply Chain & Logistics Manager: The Supply Chain & Logistics Manager owns end-to-end supply chain, inventory planning, and logistics operations at Teton. This role is responsible for ensuring the right inventory is available at the right time to support customer demand, sales growth, and operational efficiency across domestic fulfillment and direct import fulfillment programs. This position serves as the primary bridge between Sales and Operations, partnering closely with Account Managers, Purchasing, Warehouse Operations, Product Development, Finance, and Client Services to proactively plan inventory, support customer opportunities, and execute fulfillment strategies that meet customer expectations. The Supply Chain & Logistics Manager is responsible for maintaining inventory availability across Teton facilities, fulfillment partners, and customer-specific programs while balancing service levels, inventory investment, and supply chain risk. Success in this role requires strong collaboration with the Sales team to understand upcoming customer needs, forecast demand, secure inventory, and develop fulfillment solutions that support both domestic distribution and direct import programs. This role also manages supplier relationships, international freight operations, fulfillment network optimization, and logistics support staff. Full-time: 40 hours per week, Mountain Daily Time Reports to: Director of Operations ________________________________________ Key Responsibilities Sales Partnership & Customer Fulfillment • Partner closely with the Sales team to understand customer opportunities, forecasted demand, program launches, and inventory requirements. • Ensure inventory availability and fulfillment readiness to support sales growth, customer commitments, and account retention. • Develop inventory and fulfillment strategies for both domestic distribution and direct import customer programs. • Provide proactive inventory visibility, supply chain risk assessments, and replenishment recommendations to Sales and Account Management teams. • Participate in customer planning discussions and support large opportunities by evaluating inventory availability, lead times, sourcing options, and fulfillment solutions. • Coordinate cross-functional execution of customer-specific inventory programs, special buys, launch inventories, and direct import shipments. • Identify potential inventory constraints and collaborate with Sales and Operations to develop mitigation plans before customer service is impacted. • Serve as the operational owner of inventory availability and fulfillment performance for key customer programs. Supply Chain Planning & Inventory Management • Own inventory planning and replenishment strategies across all Teton facilities and fulfillment partners. • Monitor inventory levels, inventory health, and stock availability to ensure Sales teams can confidently support customer demand and growth opportunities. • Lead collaborative forecasting efforts with Sales, Purchasing, and Operations to align inventory investments with customer demand, strategic initiatives, and revenue goals. • Analyze inventory performance, safety stock levels, and inventory turns to optimize working capital while maintaining service levels. • Develop inventory allocation strategies that prioritize customer commitments, key accounts, and growth opportunities while balancing overall inventory health. • Identify risks related to inventory shortages, excess inventory, supplier delays, and demand fluctuations, and develop mitigation plans. • Maintain accurate inventory data and reporting within Fishbowl Inventory and other operational systems. • Support product launches, seasonal demand planning, and inventory allocation strategies. • Establish additional fulfillment centers as needed and manage inventory movement between locations. Supplier & Procurement Coordination • Partner with suppliers and factories to align production schedules, readiness dates, lead times, and shipment planning. • Monitor supplier performance related to quality, lead times, capacity, and delivery reliability. • Support supplier communication, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives. • Assist with sourcing projects and supply chain optimization efforts as needed. Inbound Logistics • Manage end-to-end inbound freight from international suppliers to all Teton facilities and Canadian 3PL partners. • Coordinate directly with factories on readiness dates, booking lead times, ship windows, INCOTERMS, and routing compliance. • Manage container bookings, shipment tracking, and coordination with freight forwarders and customs brokers. • Ensure accuracy and compliance of all import documentation, packaging specifications, labeling, and shipping requirements. • Maintain complete visibility of inbound shipments and expected inventory receipts. • Analyze freight spend, transit times, and landed costs to drive efficiency and negotiate competitive rates. Client Logistics • Own client-facing logistics for both U.S.-based clients and international distributors. • Manage international client and distributor shipments, including export documentation and coordination with client-appointed forwarders. • Serve as the primary logistics point of contact for clients and distributors, ensuring clear communication and proactive issue management. • Support Sales and Client Services with accurate shipment data, inventory availability, and delivery updates. Team Leadership • Supervise and support logistics administrative staff and Online Specialist(s). • Define workflows, ownership, and communication standards across the logistics team. • Provide training, feedback, coaching, and process documentation to support accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. • Foster accountability through clear metrics and performance expectations. • Develop and monitor key supply chain metrics, including inventory turns, fill rates, forecast accuracy, freight costs, and supplier performance. • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, cost control, and data accuracy. ________________________________________ Qualifications • 5+ years of experience in supply chain management, inventory planning, international logistics, freight forwarding, or related operations roles. • Strong understanding of supply chain planning, inventory management, forecasting, procurement, and logistics operations. • Experience with AI Forecasting Tools • Demonstrated experience partnering with Sales teams to support customer demand planning, inventory availability, and fulfillment execution. • Strong knowledge of international shipping, INCOTERMS, customs compliance, tariffs, and import/export documentation. • Experience managing freight forwarders, carriers, customs brokers, suppliers, and external partners. • Proven ability to analyze inventory, freight, and operational data to drive business decisions. • Experience leading or supporting logistics, supply chain, or operations teams. • Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. • Experience with ERP, inventory management, or planning systems (Fishbowl preferred). • Advanced Excel or data analysis skills preferred. • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, or a related field preferred. ________________________________________ Success Measures • Fill rate and product availability • Inventory turns and accuracy • Forecast accuracy • Inventory availability for key customer programs • On-time fulfillment performance for domestic and direct import orders • Sales team satisfaction and responsiveness to inventory requests • On-time supplier and inbound shipment performance • Freight cost management • Landed cost optimization • Supplier performance and reliability • Customer and distributor service levels • Operational scalability and process improvement To Apply: Apply with 8 or more apply points Attach your resume Include Supply Chain & Logistics Manager in the subject line

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description: About the role Atlas Geotech LLC builds spatial data solutions for the real estate and insurance industries — property hazard disclosures, cost estimates, and risk models. The accuracy and usefulness of our data, web apps, and information products they generate is the whole product, so we're hiring a QA specialist with genuine GIS expertise and an obsessive eye for detail. This is a remote role with room to grow with responsibility. You'll work primarily async, with a short daily overlap with US Pacific Time. What you'll do GIS data & output QA — the core of the role Verify how we use the data:  the highest-value checks: is a hazard flag derived from the correct layer, does an address geocode to the right parcel, is an cost figure computed correctly? Validate outputs against known-good reference cases. Verify our apps display the right thing:  maps, layers, and overlays render the correct data in the correct place, at the right zoom, with styling that reads clearly. Verify our reports tell the right story:  hazard disclosures and replacement cost reports are correct, coherent, and sensible — e.g., a parcel inside a fire-hazard zone is never reported as low-risk, figures are plausible, and the narrative matches the underlying data. Validate spatial data:  SRID / coordinate-reference-system correctness, geometry validity (ST_IsValid — self-intersections, invalid polygons), topology issues (gaps, overlaps, slivers), and the integrity of joins between spatial and tabular attributes. Spot-check positional accuracy:  confirm hazard zones overlay parcels correctly, addresses land in the right place, and reprojections (e.g., EPSG:4326 ? 3857) haven't silently shifted geometry. Verify GeoServer & GeoNode:  WMS/WFS GetCapabilities, layer bounding boxes, SLD styling renders as intended; and GeoNode metadata / layer configuration is complete and correct. Validate data parity across environments/migrations:  confirm a migrated or cloud copy of our data matches the source — row counts, geometry integrity, and query results identical across environments. Web app & API QA Test our API endpoints:  response schemas, status codes, pagination, auth, and the correctness of returned JSON and images. Test our map front-ends:  layer toggles, popups, click handlers, coordinate display, zoom behavior, tile loading, large-payload performance, plus basic cross-browser/responsive checks. Write clear, reproducible bug reports:  steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual, severity — and verify fixes. Required GIS fundamentals — the key requirement:  spatial queries, coordinate reference systems, projections and datum transformations, when to use raster vs. vector, geometry types, topology, and spatial data-quality concepts. This is the heart of the role — strong GIS judgment matters more than any single tool. Hands-on with a desktop GIS:  QGIS or ArcGIS/Esri. If your background is ArcGIS and you haven't used the open-source stack yet, that's completely fine — the fundamentals transfer well and we'll help you ramp on QGIS/PostGIS. Spatial SQL in PostGIS —  or a genuine willingness to learn it quickly (if you've written attribute queries or Definition Queries in ArcGIS, you're closer than you think). A real eye for detail:  you notice when something is subtly wrong, not just obviously broken. Communication:  clear written English and disciplined documentation habits. Self-direction:  comfortable working independently and async. Python —  even at a basic level. We'd love someone who can grow into scripting data-validation checks with GeoPandas/Shapely, testing APIs with requests/httpx, and eventually writing automated tests (pytest, Playwright). Tell us what you've built, however small. Logistics Type:  Remote Hours:  40 Overlap:  a short daily window with US Pacific Time Rate: Equipment:  you provide your own computer and reliable internet. Selection process Strong applicants will be invited to a short video interview, including a brief walkthrough of how you'd approach QA on a sample layer or report — a conversation, not homework. We're looking for how you think and what you notice. How to apply To show us you read this carefully, start your application with the word “isoline.” Applications without it won't be reviewed. In your message, please include: a short description of your GIS background and the tools you use most. one example of a data-quality or software bug you caught that others missed, and how you found it. your Python experience, if any (be honest — “basic” is fine).

You must have experience reconciling multi-currency accounts and handling exchange rates so the bank balance in QBO matches the statement to the penny. - Shopify - Experience reconciling Shopify payouts to QBO. - Google SheetS - Comfortable with ad-hoc reports and collaboration. REQUIREMENTS Must Have: - 3+ years of bookkeeping experience using QuickBooks Online - Experience with Canadian GST/HST filing and input tax credits - Experience with e-commerce businesses (Shopify strongly preferred) - Experience reconciling multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD) - Strong attention to detail - we have zero tolerance for sloppy entries - Fluent in English with strong written communication Nice to Have: - Experience with DTC or subscription-based businesses - Experience with inventory accounting and landed cost tracking - Previous experience transitioning a company from another system onto QuickBooks HOURS & COMPENSATION - Part-time to start - most likely 10-20 hours a month as we're still a small business, but expect it to grow as we scale - Schedule: Flexible, but must have overlap with Pacific Time for communication - Rate: $5–$10 USD/hour depending on experience - Long-term: We want someone who grows with us. This is not a one-off project. WHAT THIS ROLE IS - A key financial support role for a growing e-commerce brand - Someone who brings order, accuracy, and visibility to our finances WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT - Not basic data entry - Not a once-a-month check-in - Not suitable for someone who needs constant direction HOW TO APPLY We ignore generic cover letters. Each payout bundles sales, refunds, fees, and adjustments. How would you reconcile these in QBO? Walk us through your approach. **Question C:** What is your experience with Canadian GST/HST input tax credits? Give us a specific example of how you've maximized ITCs for a previous client. **Step 3:** Include the following: - A short intro about yourself and your bookkeeping experience - Your experience with e-commerce / Shopify businesses specifically - Your expected monthly rate in PHP - Your available hours and timezone - Your QuickBooks Online proficiency self-rating (1-10) Applications that do not answer the screening questions will not be considered. job_title: Remote Bookkeeper / Bookkeeping Assistant — QuickBooks Online (long-term)
description: REMOTE BOOKKEEPER / BOOKKEEPING ASSISTANT — Functional Nutriments (Team Dog) THE SHORT VERSION We're a small group of U.S.-based, dog-focused companies looking for a sharp, dependable bookkeeper to work alongside our senior bookkeeper of nearly ten years. You'll own the day-to-day transactional work in QuickBooks Online across four related entities, so she can focus on the close, the reconciliations, and the judgment calls. This is a long-term, fully remote role for someone who chose accounting on purpose and takes quiet pride in books that tie out to the penny. WHO WE ARE Functional Nutriments makes science-backed supplements for dogs. We're part of a small family of related businesses: a dog supplement company, an independent dog-health information site, a podcast network for dog lovers, and a publishing imprint. Our people (we think of ourselves as "Team Dog") are all fully remote professionals who live across several countries and time zones. We've operated this way for over twenty years. We're real and findable. (You're encouraged to look us up.) We treat the people who work with us like long-term partners. Some have been here for over a decade. WHAT YOU'LL DO *  Categorize bank and credit-card feed transactions in QuickBooks Online, correctly and consistently *  Enter accounts-payable bills and accounts-receivable invoices *  Pull monthly revenue reports from Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, and PayPal and prep them for reconciliation *  Vendor and W-9 administration, receipt collection, and document filing *  Reconciliation prep and running reports for the senior bookkeeper's review *  Flag anything that looks off — and ask before you guess You will not be alone. A senior bookkeeper reviews the work and there's a clear escalation path. We want someone who can grow into more over time. WHAT WE GENUINELY NEED (please read this part >>>) The single most important thing: you actually understand double-entry bookkeeping, not just the software. You know why undeposited funds exists, what a prepaid expense is and how it amortizes, why a refund doesn't go to the same account as a sale, and what to do when a deposit has no matching invoice. If a step exists, you understand why it exists. We'll happily teach you our books; we can't teach you bookkeeping itself. Required: *  Solid working grasp of double-entry fundamentals (accrual basis, debits/credits, accruals, prepaids, the matching principle) *  At least 2 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including real QuickBooks Online work where you have owned the monthly books or close for at least one business (not just isolated data entry) *  Strong, clear written English — you'll communicate mostly in writing but video calls are a real thing within Team Dog *  Real attention to detail and the discipline to leave a clean audit trail *  Reliability and good async communication: you do what you say, and you flag problems early *  A quiet home work setup and stable internet and power Nice to have (not required): *  E-commerce bookkeeping experience (Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Wise) *  Experience with multiple entities or intercompany transactions *  QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification THE DETAILS *  Long-term independent contractor, fully remote *  About 20 hours/week to start, with genuine room to grow toward full-time *  USD$500-$700/month ($6 to $8/hour) depending on experience, with room to grow; paid twice per month via Wise *  Flexible schedule, with some overlap with U.S. Pacific/Hawaii hours for monthly close HOW TO APPLY — AND HOW WE HIRE We keep this simple and human: 1.  Apply here with your resume and a few sentences about your bookkeeping experience and why this role fits you. Include the word "ledger" in your note so we know you read the full post. Bonus points if you tell us about a special dog in your life. 2.  A short online skills screen (about 20 minutes, free). If your note and background look like a fit, we'll send you a personal message with a link to a quick, auto-graded screen covering bookkeeping fundamentals and QuickBooks — with a welcome video from our founder, so you know exactly who you're dealing with. 3.  A paid working interview. Our strongest candidates do a short, paid working session with us. PLUS you'll be compensated for your time as we walk through a real-world scenario and hear how you think. A real company, a real person on the other end, and we pay you for the practical stage. We're hiring one person and we intend to keep them for years. If that's the role you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Web & Design Support Specialist
description: Web & Design Support Specialist Remote · Part-Time (with Full-Time Potential) · Eastern Time About Us We are a web design and SEO studio based in New Jersey, and we've been at it for seven years. We build and care for websites for creative and service-based business owners, photographers, interior designers, coaches, and the like, who want an online home that feels as considered as the work they do offline. Our philosophy comes down to one idea: your website should let you show up online the way you show up in real life. About the Role As our Web & Design Support Specialist, you'll be the steady hand keeping our clients' websites current and looking their best, while also acting as the central point of communication across our projects. The work is a blend of hands-on website updates, design, social media, and light coordination, all built around care and attention to detail. This is a long-term role for someone who takes pride in their work and wants to grow alongside a studio that values them. What You'll Do -Keep client websites current. Add and update content across our clients' sites, including new webinars, events, tea ---------- mbers, articles, photos, and copy. -Run point on client tickets. Manage incoming requests in our CRM and act as the main point of contact so clients always know their work is in good hands. -Be the hub of communication. Coordinate with the rest of our team and outside collaborators (developers, senior designers, contractors) to keep every project moving smoothly. -Create graphics and social content. Design graphics in Canva when a ticket calls for it, and produce social graphics, reels, and light video edits for the studio's Instagram and Pinterest. -Show off the work. Put together before-and-afters of our projects, plus the occasional launch graphics we gift to clients when their sites go live. -Keep us consistent on social. Maintain a posting schedule for Instagram and Pinterest so our work stays visible. -Handle basic on-page SEO. Add meta descriptions, alt text, and other small optimizations as part of the edits. Who You Are -You're confident working in Showit, WordPress, and Squarespace. -You're detail-oriented to your core, the kind of person who catches what most people miss. -You communicate clearly and warmly in both written and verbal English, and you're comfortable being the point of contact for clients and collaborators. -You manage your time well and keep things moving without needing to be chased. -You're available during Eastern time hours so our days line up. -You're looking for a long-term partnership over short-term work. I'd rather invest in one person and keep them for years. Even Better If -You have experience with email marketing in Flodesk or similar platforms (mailchimp, convertkit, GHL, kajabi) -You have a basic foundation in SEO beyond the on-page essentials. -You've built a portfolio of aesthetic, well-designed graphics for social media. How We Work Together Most of our team has been with the studio for three years or more, and that's exactly what we're hoping for with this hire. We're not trying to build a big agency. We like being small, taking on work we genuinely care about, and protecting a happy, balanced life for everyone on the team. Most of the work runs on your own schedule, with the two of us meeting every two weeks to talk through questions, active projects, and anything that needs a decision. We don't do many client calls, though you may occasionally sit in on one to take notes. Support and Training You won't be thrown in and left to figure things out on your own. I provide hands-on training from the start and will walk you through many of our projects personally. For the things that are easier to show than to explain, I record Looms you can rewatch as often as you need. And when something feels hard, you'll have experienced tea ---------- mbers to lean on. The goal is for you to feel supported, not stranded. Schedule and Hours This is a set Monday through Friday schedule, which keeps things consistent for everyone (you included) when it comes to hours, pay, and rhythm. The ideal working window falls somewhere between 10 AM and 5 PM Eastern, Monday through Friday, with major holidays off. To confirm you've read this far, please include a picture of a pink bunny somewhere in your application. The role runs 20 to 25 hours a week to start, and I'm open to a full-time 30 hours depending on your experience and availability. COMPENSATION$ $5/hr-$8/hr depending on experience. ***** How to Apply If this sounds like the kind of work and team you've been looking for, I'd love to hear from you. Send a short note about your experience with Showit, WordPress, and/or Squarespace, a few examples of website edits or graphics you've created, any similar work you've done and a little about yourself. I read every application personally.

title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
job_title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
description: If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job.  You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description. Requirements: This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times. Time doctor use is mandatory. Growth Mindset and leadership approach. We are looking for a senior Amazon listing operator who knows how to launch, rank, and scale products on Amazon — not just write copy. You live inside DataDive, Helium 10, and Brand Analytics, and you can read a niche the way most people read a book. You will own the full lifecycle of our Amazon listings: from keyword research and competitive analysis on day one, through launch, ranking, and ongoing optimization. You will be responsible for the data-driven decisions that move our products up the page. You are the person who answers every week: • “Which keywords are we winning, losing, or missing?” • “Why did this listing drop in rank?” • “What is the next listing we should optimize, and why?” • “Where is the next growth opportunity in this category?” What You Will Own Keyword Research & Competitive Analysis • Run deep keyword research in DataDive (Cerebro-style reverse ASIN, competitor gap analysis, keyword opportunity scoring) • Build keyword master lists segmented by priority, search volume, relevance, and competition • Identify untapped long-tail and high-intent keywords competitors are missing • Analyze competitor listings, reviews, pricing, and ranking patterns • Map the competitive landscape for every product line New Listing Launch • Build SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions, and backend search terms • Write A+ Content briefs and Brand Story modules • Coordinate image and infographic briefs with the design team • Develop launch strategy: pricing, coupons, vine, PPC seeding, and ranking plan • Set up parent/child variations correctly the first time • Track launch performance against ranking and revenue targets Ongoing Listing Optimization • Audit existing listings for keyword gaps, indexing issues, and conversion leaks • Run structured A/B tests on titles, main images, and copy using Manage Your Experiments • Monitor keyword rank movements and respond to ranking drops fast • Refresh listings based on seasonality, trends, and new competitor moves • Improve conversion rate, session-to-purchase ratio, and click-through rate Brand Analytics & Seller Central Intelligence • Pull and interpret Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and Market Basket reports • Identify share-of-voice gaps vs. top competitors in each category • Track conversion share, click share, and purchase share by keyword • Use Seller Central data to validate or challenge DataDive findings • Flag listing health issues: suppressions, Buy Box loss, policy warnings, stranded inventory Reporting & Dashboards You will build and maintain: • Weekly keyword rank tracker (organic and sponsored) • Listing health scorecard by ASIN • Competitor watchlist with movement alerts • Launch performance reports vs. plan • Optimization backlog with projected impact and priority Who You Are You are not a generalist Amazon VA. You are: • A senior Amazon operator who has launched and scaled real products — not just edited listings • A true DataDive power user (this is non-negotiable) • Deeply analytical — you make decisions from data, not from gut feel • Obsessive about keyword indexing, ranking, and conversion • Comfortable reading Search Query Performance reports and explaining what they mean • Up to date on Amazon algorithm changes, policy updates, and category trends • A strong written communicator who can brief designers, copywriters, and leadership clearly • Self-directed — you bring opportunities to the table, you don’t wait to be told Required Experience • 5+ years managing Amazon listings at a senior or lead level • Proven track record of launching products and ranking them on page 1 for competitive keywords • Expert-level proficiency in DataDive (required — we will test this) • Strong working knowledge of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein, Index Checker) • Hands-on experience with Brand Analytics and Seller Central reporting • Experience writing high-converting Amazon copy and A+ Content briefs • Experience running Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests) on titles and images • Strong spreadsheet skills (pivots, lookups, basic modeling) • Familiarity with Amazon Ads / PPC concepts (you don’t need to run campaigns, but you need to understand them) What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) • Full keyword and competitor audit completed for every active ASIN • Prioritized optimization backlog built and in motion • At least one major listing relaunch with measurable rank and conversion lift • Weekly reporting cadence established with leadership • Clear launch playbook documented for future product releases Why This Role Matters Amazon is a zero-sum game. For every rank position we don’t own, a competitor does. The right person in this seat directly drives revenue — every keyword you win, every conversion point you add, and every launch you nail compounds over months and years. How to Apply Send your resume and a short note that includes: • A specific example of a listing you launched or optimized, with the keyword(s) you targeted and the rank/revenue result • How long you have used DataDive and what you use it for most • One Amazon listing mistake you see most operators make — and how you avoid it

title: PT Social Media Manager
description: WHO WE ARE Keenya Kelly LLC is a video marketing and monetization education company founded by Keenya Kelly — a short vertical video strategist. We are a small, high-performing team that moves fast, communicates clearly, and takes our craft seriously. This role starts part-time with the very real opportunity to grow into a full-time position for the right person. THE ROLE We are looking for a Part-Time Social Media Manager to own the day-to-day management and strategic growth of Keenya's TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook accounts. This is not a scheduling role. This is a strategy role. We need someone who understands what makes content perform, can read the data and make decisions from it, thinks three steps ahead, and communicates proactively without being chased for updates. You will work directly in Keenya's brand and your fingerprints will be on everything that goes out. If you love TikTok and Instagram the way other people love their favorite TV show — meaning you study it, you notice patterns, you get genuinely excited when something performs — this role was written for you. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Content Scheduling and Publishing Schedule and publish content across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook using ---------- and ---------- .io Ensure every post goes out at the right time, on the right platform, with the right caption and CTA Flag any content that needs to be posted natively by Keenya from her Houston device before it is scheduled Caption Writing and Content Strategy Write captions for all three platforms that match Keenya's brand voice exactly Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar built around the five content pillars: Video Marketing, Monetization, Video Tips and How-Tos, Inspiration, and AI for Content Creation Align the content calendar with active launches, challenges, and campaigns Community Management Monitor and respond to comments and DMs across all three platforms in Keenya's voice Escalate anything that requires Keenya's personal response immediately Keep the community feeling seen, engaged, and valued — not managed by a bot Analytics and Reporting Pull weekly and monthly performance reports across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook Track follower growth, engagement rate, reach, saves, shares, and content-to-lead conversion Identify what is working, what is not, and bring a clear recommendation — not just the numbers Present findings in a simple weekly summary Keenya can read in under five minutes Content Calendar Management Build and maintain a rolling 30-day content calendar at all times Coordinate with Adora (OBM) to align social content with email , launch, and affiliate timelines Anticipate upcoming campaigns and have content planned before Keenya has to ask WHO YOU ARE You are highly organized. You do not drop balls. You have a system for everything and you update it without being reminded. When something changes, you adjust the plan and communicate immediately — you do not wait to be asked. You are obsessed with TikTok and Instagram. Not casually familiar — genuinely obsessed. You follow the algorithm changes. You notice when a new content format is gaining traction before everyone else does. You study accounts that are growing and you know why they are growing. You are strategic. You do not just post content — you think about why each piece of content exists, what job it is doing, and how it fits into the bigger picture of the brand and the launch calendar. You are a strong writer. You can write in someone else's voice without making it sound like you. You read content back and ask yourself — does this sound like Keenya or does this sound like me? You communicate before you are asked. If something is unclear, you ask. If something is delayed, you flag it. If you see an opportunity, you bring it. You do not go quiet and you do not wait for a follow-up. You have receipts. You can point to specific accounts you have managed and show the growth — follower numbers, engagement rates, content performance — not just say you did a good job. WHAT MAKES A STRONG APPLICATION We will not review applications that do not include all three of the following: Links to at least two social media accounts you have managed — TikTok and Instagram preferred — with a brief note on what the account looked like when you started and what it looked like when you were done. Numbers matter here. A written answer to this question: Keenya's five content pillars are Video Marketing, Monetization, Video Tips and How-Tos, Inspiration, and AI for Content Creation. Walk me through how you would build one week of content across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook using these five pillars. Be specific — what type of content, what platform, what day, and why . A written answer to this question: Describe a time when a piece of content you managed underperformed. What did the data tell you, what did you change, and what happened next? Applications without answers to both written questions will not be reviewed regardless of experience level. A NOTE FROM KEENYA I need someone who loves this work the way I love this work. Social media is not a task to check off for me — it is how I have built everything. I need someone who gets that, who studies the platforms the way I do, and who brings strategy and energy to the role every single week. If you are someone who gets excited when a video performs, who notices when the algorithm shifts before everyone else does, and who takes as much pride in someone else's growth as your own — I want to hear from you. This role starts part-time. For the right person it becomes much more.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description: OVERVIEW Consult Lemonade is seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO. This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead. This is not an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders. SCHEDULE * Part-time position * Monday through Friday * 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST * Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows LEADING PEOPLE You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction. Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on Consult Lemonade's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity. DELIVERING RESULTS * CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance. * Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action. * CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses. * Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented. * Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised. * Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis. * Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time. * Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system. * Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality. * Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution. COMMUNICATION * Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests, email communications, and external inquiries. * Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks. * Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation. * Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations. * Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment. * Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up. STRATEGIC THINKING * Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management. * Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives. * Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to Consult Lemonade's mission and programs. * Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness. job_title: Creative Strategist & Producer (Meta Ads) - High-Volume AI Video & Static Creative
description: We're a performance-based lead generation company running Meta advertising campaigns across two verticals: healthcare intake and legal case intake. We need someone who can both think and produce, researching what's actually working in the market and then turning that research into a high volume of finished, ready-to-run ad creatives every single week. This is not a slow, one-creative-at-a-time role. We need 30-60+ finished images and videos per week across both verticals, and every single one needs to be high quality, not rushed or generic. Speed without quality doesn't work here, and quality without speed doesn't either, we need both. You'll be responsible for the full loop: researching competitors, identifying winning hooks and angles, writing the copy and scripts, and producing the finished assets yourself using AI creative tools. You're not handing off briefs to someone else to build, you are the one building. **Responsibilities** - Continuously research competitor ads running in the addiction treatment and lemon law space, across all formats: static, AI UGC, talking head video, and traditional creative - Identify winning hooks, angles, and formats based on what's actually converting in the market, not just what looks good - Write ad copy and scripts based on that research - Produce 30-60+ finished, ready-to-run Meta ad creatives per week, a mix of static images and AI-generated videos - Use AI creative tools including HeyGen, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, and similar platforms to produce realistic talking head and UGC-style video content at scale - Build static image ads using design tools for Meta placements - Take feedback and produce revisions/iterations quickly, same day turnaround on requested changes - Stay current on new AI creative tools as they emerge and bring new formats to the table proactively - Track which creative types and formats are performing best and adjust production focus accordingly **Requirements** - Proven experience producing high volume performance ad creative specifically for paid social, not branding or organic content - Hands-on experience with AI video/avatar tools including HeyGen, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, Kling, or similar platforms, you need to already know how to use these, not learn on the job - Strong copywriting ability, you're writing your own scripts and ad copy based on research, not waiting on someone else - Experience researching competitor ads and translating that research into new creative concepts - Proficiency with static image design tools (Photoshop, Canva, or similar) - Demonstrated ability to produce at high volume without sacrificing quality, this role requires real speed - Fast, reliable communication, you need to be reachable and responsive, this is not a role where we wait days for updates or revisions - Comfortable taking feedback and turning around iterations quickly - Experience with healthcare, legal, insurance, or another high-CPL/high-stakes vertical is a strong plus - Strong written English for daily collaboration with a US-based team **Structure:** Open to full-time or contract, based on fit **How to Apply** Submit your portfolio with specific examples of AI-generated video ads and static ads you've produced for paid social, ideally lead generation work. Include the tools you used for each example. As part of your application, complete this exercise: Pick one vertical, either addiction treatment or lemon law. Find one active Meta ad running in that space and tell us what's working about it and what you'd change. Then produce one new creative, either a static image or a short AI-generated video, that you think would outperform it, using any of the tools listed above. Send us the finished asset along with a short explanation of your thinking. We're not looking for a perfect ad, we're looking to see how fast you can move from research to a finished, usable creative, and how you think while doing it. This exercise is the part of the application we weigh most heavily.

title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Data Analyst for Account Management
job_title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Data Analyst for Account Management
description: Company: ScaleSuite Location: Remote Hours: Full Time Time Zone: Flexible Compensation: Based on Skills/Experience About The Role We manage a growing portfolio of business clients, and we need a sharp, detail-oriented contractor to be the early-warning system for that portfolio. Working hand-in-hand with our incoming in-house account manager, you'll keep a continuous pulse on every client we serve: auditing their SEO performance, reading the signals, and flagging who's thriving, who's slipping, and who needs attention before it becomes a problem. This is a skills-first hire. We care far more about what you can actually do than how many years your résumé lists. If you understand SEO, you're comfortable learning new tools quickly, and you can turn raw audit data into a clear recommendation, we want to talk to you. What You'll Do Run and interpret audits - Perform regular SEO audits across our client portfolio using SE Ranking and Local Falcon (and any future tools we adopt). - Track rankings, local visibility, technical health, and performance trends over time. - Spot anomalies, regressions, and opportunities in the data. - Analyze our client’s competitors to identify patterns and trends indicative of success that we can implement in-house for our clients Turn data into action - Translate audit findings into clear, prioritized, actionable game plans, not just a dump of numbers. - Summarize what's working, what's at risk, and what the next move should be for each client. - Effectively communicate data and ideas to progress our clients Monitor health and churn risk - Keep tabs on progress and overall sentiment for every client we work with. - Weigh churn risk across the full portfolio and surface a clear, ranked view of who we should prioritize and why. - Maintain an up-to-date picture so nothing falls through the cracks as the portfolio grows. Collaborate closely - Work directly and proactively with our in-house account manager: sharing findings, comparing notes on client sentiment, and aligning on priorities. - Communicate clearly and consistently so the team always knows where each account stands. What We're Looking For - Solid working knowledge of SEO: you understand on-page, off-page, technical, and local SEO fundamentals, and you know what healthy vs. unhealthy performance looks like. - Strong tech literacy and fast learning: you pick up new platforms quickly and don't need hand-holding to figure out a tool's features. - Hands-on with auditing tools: experience with SE Ranking and Local Falcon is a strong plus; if you haven't used them but have used comparable tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, BrightLocal, Screaming Frog, etc.), show us you can ramp fast. - Analytical thinking: you can look at a set of results and explain what it means and what to do about it, not just report the figures. - Clear, proactive communication: you flag issues early, write clear summaries, and keep collaborators in the loop without being chased. - Organized and self-directed: you can track many clients at once and stay on top of recurring work without needing constant instruction - Fluent in English: This is important for internal team communication and you may be needed to write email s to clients Nice To Have - Familiarity with Google Business Profile / local SEO and Google Search Console / Google Analytics. - Experience in an agency or working across multiple clients at once. - Comfort building reports to communicate trends. Tools You'll Use - SE Ranking — rank tracking and SEO auditing - Local Falcon — local rank and visibility tracking - Additional tools as our stack evolves (we expect you to learn them) How To Apply To apply, please submit your resume with any relevant experience!
