title: Senior Sales Lead Generator
description: I am hiring a senior lead generator who can be located globally to generate qualified discovery calls with founder-led and CEO-led SMEs in Australia and globally for my AI consulting business. This is not a junior SDR role, not a generic appointment-setting role, and not a role for someone who needs hand-holding. You will be responsible for identifying good-fit businesses, doing outbound prospecting, opening commercial conversations, qualifying decision-makers properly, and booking attended discovery calls that I will run and close. If you need constant supervision, this is not the role. If you are good at getting senior decision-makers into quality sales conversations and you want upside without being micromanaged, keep reading. I will train you in how to use AI [I'm an expert in AI] and I will work with you to build AI automations to make your tasks more efficient and easier ## About the Business I help founder-led and CEO-led SMEs adopt AI in practical, commercially sound ways that improve performance, reduce risk, and strengthen execution without turning the business into a technology experiment. My work includes AI strategy, AI policy writing, AI training, readiness assessment, and implementation support for business owners and senior leaders who care about evidence, clarity, and execution discipline. I am not a software vendor, reseller, generic online course provider, or big-consulting-style advisory firm. The people I work best with are pragmatic leaders in services and professional services businesses who know AI matters but do not want hype, chaos, or random experimentation. ## What You Will Be Selling Into Your first job is to create qualified meetings for one flagship offer: AI Foundations Training at $5,000. This is a practical six-session online training programme delivered over two months for up to 10 participants, built around real work tasks rather than generic AI awareness content. It is a strong fit when a CEO can see AI matters, staff are already using ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot inconsistently, there is concern about poor usage or lack of structure, and leadership wants the team to use AI properly rather than casually. I position it as teaching your team AI skills so they can do more with less. ## Who You Will Target You will prospect into Australia and global markets and can be located globally. The ideal buyer is usually a founder, CEO, or managing director of a service-led SME with around 5 to 50 staff and roughly $1 million to $20 million in annual revenue. Strong-fit businesses are usually service and professional services firms rather than product companies, enterprise organisations, or startups building AI products. Poor-fit prospects include businesses looking only for software, generic AI awareness sessions, or technical build work rather than commercially grounded advisory and capability building. ## What You Will Actually Do - Build your own lead list using LinkedIn, email , networking, and public signals rather than waiting for me to hand you a pipeline. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI. - Research companies and decision-makers properly before outreach. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI. - Use trigger events and commercial context to decide who is worth contacting now. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI. - Reach out to founders, CEOs, and managing directors with tailored messages that show you understand their likely AI situation. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI. - Start conversations around the right business problem, not generic “AI is the future” noise. - Qualify whether the prospect fits the ICP, has a real business problem, has some timing urgency, and is likely able to buy. - Book attended discovery calls with decision-makers and hand them over cleanly. - Record outreach, notes, status, and relevant context accurately inside my CRM. - Stay away from bad-fit leads that waste time, including enterprise firms, software shoppers, and people with no decision authority. ## What Good Looks Like You are not being measured on busywork, activity theatre, or whether you “look busy” online. You are being measured on outcomes. The main target is 12 attended qualified meetings per month with founder, CEO, or MD-level decision-makers who fit the ICP and are worth my time. A qualified meeting means the person attended, has decision-making authority, fits the business profile, and has enough budget, timing, and business pain to justify a serious discovery conversation. ## Must-Have Skills - Strong written English and commercially credible business communication. - Real experience in outbound prospecting, appointment setting, or B2B meeting generation. - Confidence contacting senior decision-makers directly. - Good judgment about fit, timing, and whether a lead is worth pursuing. - Ability to personalise outreach using real business context instead of spraying templates. - Discipline to update CRM notes and handover information properly. - Comfort using LinkedIn, email , and basic AI support tools without relying on AI to think for you. - Enough maturity to work without fixed hours, daily chasing, or emotional neediness. ## Strong Advantage You will stand out if you have a understand how to prompt AI. You will stand out if you have sold or opened conversations into founder-led service businesses before. You will also stand out if you understand professional services buyers, know how to talk to owners without sounding like a script, and can spot public signals that show when AI training is timely. ## Who This Role Is For You are likely a fit if you are commercially sharp, self-directed, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning your own results. You do not need a manager standing over you. You do need to know how to create opportunity from cold or lightly warm conditions. You are probably not a fit if you want guaranteed pay for low-quality activity, struggle with rejection, or need a heavily structured employee environment. ## Working Style Can be located globally. Remote-first. Flexible working style. Results-driven. A mix of LinkedIn, email , and networking outreach, with judgment on what gets the result. Some tools may be provided, but I expect you to bring capability, not excuses. You must record outreach and notes in my CRM properly. You must not represent competing AI consulting offers while working with me. ## Commercial Terms The is base salary is $350 USD For the initial phase, commission is tied to AI Foundations Training only. You will earn $500 AUD per closed AI Foundations Training deal once the client’s first invoice has been paid. Our target is 4 closes per month [$2000 AUD comissions] Commission is payable on any AI Foundations deal from that account that closes within 30 days of the meeting booking date. Commission will be paid within 14 days of receipt of the client’s first invoice payment. If you prove you can consistently deliver good-fit opportunities for AI Foundations Training, I am open to negotiating commission arrangements for other services I offer later. ## First 60 Days The first review point is at 60 days. By then, I should be able to see whether you can source the right types of accounts, open credible conversations, book attended qualified meetings, and keep clean CRM records. If the meetings are weak, unqualified, or mostly no-shows, this will not work. If the meetings are good and the commercial logic is sound, there is room to build from there. ## How to Apply Send me the following: 1. A short introduction in clear English. 2. A brief summary of your experience in outbound prospecting, appointment setting, or booking B2B meetings with senior decision-makers. 3. A short list of the channels and tools you have used, especially LinkedIn and email . 4. One example of a personalised outbound message you would send to the CEO of a professional services firm where staff are already using AI informally and leadership likely needs structure. 5. A short explanation of how you decide whether a lead is qualified before booking a meeting. 6. A short note on why role suits you.

title: Brand and Graphic Designer
description: SKYR N BOWLS Brand & Graphic Designer (Remote) — Build the Look of an Exciting New Miami Wellness Brand We’re a brand-new health-food concept launching in Miami, and we’re looking for a talented graphic designer to create our entire visual identity from the ground up. This is a rare chance to put your fingerprints on a brand from day one — the logo, the colors, the menus, the packaging, the whole feel. If you love clean, modern, aspirational design and want a project you’ll be proud to show off, keep reading. Who We Are Skyr N Bowls is Miami’s first protein bowl built on authentic Icelandic skyr — nearly 40g of protein, no added sugar, real ingredients, beautifully made. Think of the gorgeous, Instagram-ready açai bowl, but reinvented around a genuinely healthy, high-protein base. Our signature bowls have names like Lúcuma, Pink Coconut, Caffao, and Açai Bliss. We sit right at the intersection of fitness, wellness, and beautiful aesthetics that defines Miami’s active culture. The brand should feel calm, clean, and aspirational — a small daily luxury, not just food. There’s a lovely international travel story woven through it too: Iceland, Amsterdam, Barcelona, and Miami. The Creative Vision We already have a clear point of view, and now we need a designer to bring it fully to life. Here’s the feeling we’re going for: • A soft, sky-blue color palette — fresh, cool, and unmistakably ours. • Minimalist, modern styling with lots of light and breathing room. • Aspirational and wellness-forward — it should feel like permission to enjoy something delicious without any guilt. • Keywords to keep front and center: real food, balance, vitality, self-care, trust, and freshness. You’ll have real creative ownership here. We want your ideas, your eye, and your craft — not just hands to execute. The right person gets to define how an entire brand looks and feels. What You’ll Create This is a launch project first, with ongoing design work to follow as we grow. To start, you’ll design: • A complete logo suite and brand identity. • Our color palette, typography, and a simple brand guidelines document. • Menu cards and price boards. • Packaging — cups, labels, branded stickers, and to-go items. • In-store signage and display graphics. • Loyalty cards and promotional pieces. • A starter kit of social media templates and launch content for Instagram and TikTok. Once the brand is established, we’d love to keep working with you on an ongoing basis for social content, new campaigns, and seasonal designs as the business expands from our pilot toward a flagship Miami café. Who We’re Looking For • A strong portfolio in branding and graphic design — ideally with food, beverage, wellness, or lifestyle work. • A real sense of modern, minimalist aesthetics and clean typography. • Skilled in industry-standard tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Figma, or Canva Pro). • Able to take a brand vision and run with it — thoughtful, self-directed, and detail-oriented. • Good written English and clear, responsive communication for remote collaboration. • Reliable, organized, and able to hit deadlines. Why You’ll Love This Project • Build a real brand from scratch — a standout, complete identity for your portfolio. • Creative freedom and a direct line to the founders, with no layers of bureaucracy. • Fully remote, flexible hours — work from wherever you are. • A genuine chance for an ongoing, long-term working relationship as we grow. • A fun, positive, healthy brand you’ll actually enjoy designing for. How to Apply Please send your portfolio (or a link to it) along with a short note about why this project excites you. If you have any food, beverage, or wellness branding in your portfolio, point us to it. We can’t wait to see your work and find the designer who’ll help shape the face of Skyr N Bowls. Eating healthy is an act of self-love — come help us make it beautiful.

title: Experienced Real Estate Caller - Lead Manager

description: We are hiring a Lead Manager to nurture and manage our pipeline of real estate leads, ensuring no opportunities slip through the cracks. As a Lead Manager, you will be the main point of contact for warm leads: following up with prospects, building rapport, and guiding them until they are ready to close or speak with our acquisitions closer. Additionally, you will engage in targeted outbound prospecting, using our high-quality data (e.g. fresh county records for probate and foreclosures) to initiate conversations with potential sellers. This hybrid role is critical – you'll keep our funnel organized and full by both managing incoming leads and proactively hunting new ones. If you are a people-person who is also organized and driven, this could be a perfect fit. Who We Are: The OmniKey Group is founded and led by top-ranking Fortune 500 Sales Managers with a proven track record of developing and employing elite talent. We don't just build businesses — we build careers. As we scale aggressively, we are looking for driven individuals who want to grow alongside a leadership team that knows how to invest in people. Responsibilities: Lead Nurturing: Manage a pipeline of ~50 active leads in our CRM. Promptly follow up with interested home sellers via phone, text, and email . Your goal is to build relationships over time – check in regularly, understand their situation, and keep our company top-of-mind for when they're ready to sell. Initial Lead Qualification: Call new inquiries (from inbound calls or web forms) as soon as they come in. Have a friendly introductory conversation to gather information: Why might they sell? When? What's the property condition? Identify serious motivation versus casual interest. Ensure every new lead is contacted and categorized (hot, warm, long-term, etc.). Set Appointments: When a lead is qualified and shows strong interest/motivation, schedule an appointment or transfer the call to our acquisitions closer. You control the calendar for our acquisition team – scheduling consultations or property visits. Make sure our closer gets all key information before the meeting. Outbound Prospecting: Devote part of your time to reaching out to cold prospects from our premium data lists (such as probate, pre-foreclosure, or other niche lists we've pulled). Use cold calling or personalized texts/emails to introduce our service and see if they have a property they might consider selling. This "deep prospecting" uses the valuable data provided by our Data Manager to generate new leads beyond the ones who come to us. Pipeline Organization: Keep the CRM updated meticulously. Log every call, update lead statuses, and add detailed notes after each contact. Set follow-up reminders for each lead so you always remember to call back when promised. No lead should ever be forgotten or left without a next action. Team Coordination: Work closely with the acquisitions (closing) team. Clearly hand off highly motivated leads with full context (notes about the seller's situation, motivation level, etc.). After our closer makes an offer, circle back with the seller to address any concerns or continue nurturing if they didn't sign immediately. Essentially, you bridge the gap between initial interest and closed deal, keeping communication smooth. Requirements: Excellent Communication: Fluent English speaker who can converse naturally and confidently with U.S. homeowners. You have a friendly phone demeanor, active listening skills, and can build trust over multiple conversations. (Experience talking to older American homeowners is a plus – you can strike the right tone of patience and professionalism.) Sales/Customer Service Experience: 1+ year in a role like sales representative, account manager, customer service, or any position requiring consistent client follow-up. Real estate experience (especially in investing or related to motivated sellers) is highly advantageous – if you've dealt with sellers or real estate leads before, let us know! Follow-Up and Organizational Skills: A proven ability to juggle dozens of leads and keep an organized system. You never let a task or callback slip. Using a CRM or lead management system should be second nature to you. (If you pride yourself on color-coded spreadsheets or meticulous task lists, that's a good sign!)Google Drive Persuasion & Empathy: You know how to connect with people, ask the right questions, and handle objections. You're empathetic to sellers' situations (many may be in tough circumstances like foreclosure, probate, etc.) and also persuasive in highlighting how our service can help them. Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with CRM software, click-to-call phone systems, and general productivity tools (Google Workspace, etc.). Able to learn new apps quickly. Also, must have reliable internet and a headset/quiet workspace for frequent calls. Work Hours: Available to work full-time on US hours (e.g. 9am–6pm PST). Leads must be called quickly during da ---------- hours in the US. Flexibility to occasionally adjust hours for an urgent lead is appreciated. We are seeking someone who can commit long-term (12+ months) and become an integral part of the team. What We Offer: Base Pay + Commission: Competitive base salary plus commission on each deal you help close. Your earning potential grows with every deal. Impactful Work: This role is at the heart of our business – you will directly influence our revenue by turning leads into deals. It's rewarding to see your relationship-building result in a family helped and a successful transaction. We often deal with homeowners in difficult situations; you'll take pride in guiding them toward a solution. Training & Development: We will provide training on our scripts, CRM, and the real estate investment process. You'll learn about the wholesale home-buying industry, negotiations, and how to evaluate seller motivation. Ongoing coaching will be available to sharpen your skills (we succeed when you succeed). Team Environment: Work with a supportive, growth-minded team. We maintain open communication and regular team check-ins despite being remote. You'll get feedback and recognition for your hard work. We also encourage new ideas – if you have suggestions to improve our follow-up processes, we want to hear them. Remote Work Lifestyle: This is a 100% remote position. Save on commute time and work from the comfort of your home (or home office). As long as you can reliably cover the required hours and stay connected, you'll enjoy the flexibility of remote work. How to Apply: If you're excited about nurturing leads and driving deals, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a short voice recording introducing yourself. In your intro, tell us why you're interested in this Lead Manager role and highlight any relevant experience (especially in real estate or sales). You can use a service like Vocaroo for the recording and share the link. Feel free to also include a brief note or cover letter about a time you successfully convinced a customer or closed a tough deal – we value those who take initiative to showcase their skills. Qualified candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview (and possibly a role-play exercise). Come join a team where your follow-up prowess will be highly valued and rewarded!

description: Who We Are: At Happy Little Games, games are art. We are an independent studio built by gamers, for gamers, making the kinds of games we would want to play ourselves. Being good at one thing does not mean you have to do only that thing forever. Role Overview * Build and prototype gameplay features in Unreal Engine using Blueprints. * Work on gameplay systems, basic AI, physics, interactions, and related gameplay functionality. * Create focused test environments that clearly show how a feature works. * Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review. * Keep implementation focused on the requested scope and avoid unnecessary files, systems, or dependencies. * Document what you build, how it works, and how it should be tested. * Manage assigned user stories, communicate progress, and raise questions, blockers, or risks early. * Learn and follow the studio’s technical standards, workflows, and development practices. What You Need to Bring: You do not need to know every Unreal Engine system before joining us, but you should already be able to work productively without constant step-by-step instruction. You should already be able to: * Work comfortably within Unreal Engine. * Build functional gameplay features using Blueprints. * Build simple gameplay systems and basic AI behavior. * Apply basic software-development principles, including logic, data flow, organization, and debugging. * Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review. * Test both the expected behavior and a basic control case where the feature should not activate or behave the same way. * Research unfamiliar but well-documented problems and make reasonable progress independently. * Manage your own time and keep assigned work moving toward completion. * Keep your work focused on the requested scope. * Ask useful questions when requirements or technical direction are unclear. * Communicate progress, blockers, and risks early. * Create and maintain basic documentation for your work. * Keep project files and implementation reasonably clean and organized. * Explain how your work functions and why you made important implementation decisions. * Remain professional, dependable, and honest about what you do and do not know. What You Can Learn Here: You are not required to already know every tool, framework, or production practice used by the studio. You can learn or further develop the following after joining: * Git and the studio’s source-control workflow. * Notion and the studio’s user-story workflow. * Agile and Scrum practices. * The Gameplay Ability System and how it is used within our projects. * The studio’s architecture, naming conventions, and technical standards. * Formal system-design and diagramming practices. * Stronger documentation practices. * Multiplayer replication. * Basic C++ as your responsibilities grow. * More advanced gameplay, AI, animation, physics, and Unreal Engine systems. You should be willing to research these areas, learn from available documentation and examples, and apply feedback to future work. Compensation: Your final hourly rate will be based on your experience, demonstrated skills, technical ability, communication, and level of independence. We will determine the appropriate rate through the interview and trial process. Work Progression: New developers begin with a trial project so we can evaluate how they work, communicate, and deliver against a real set of requirements. Developers who complete the trial successfully may continue with project-based work. From there, strong and consistent contributors may move into hourly work as availability and studio needs allow. As the company grows, hourly developers may also have the opportunity to move into a full-time role if both sides are interested. How to Apply: Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph whenever possible and include your resume, portfolio, and any relevant Unreal Engine work samples. description: Higher Ground Transportation Services, Inc.  · ---------- ·  Remote / Virtual  ·  Full-Time Salary About You ---------------- You're the kind of person who genuinely enjoys making a business's finances make sense. The messy QuickBooks file, the pile of unreconciled accounts, the invoices going out late — these aren't just problems to you, they're puzzles worth solving. You've worked with US small businesses before, you know how to talk to clients and subcontractors without hand-holding, and you take quiet pride in the fact that your books are clean, your reports land on time, and your principals never have to wonder what's happening with the money. If you're looking for a role where you own the financial system — not just maintain it — and where your attention to detail and follow-through directly shapes whether a growing transportation company hits its numbers, this is it. About Higher Ground Transportation Services ---------------- Higher Ground Transportation Services is a Baltimore-based transportation company that moves students, construction crews, and other clients reliably, every day. Founded and led by CEO Jan, with COO Teressa running operations, Higher Ground has earned contracts with Baltimore City Public Schools, Clark Construction, DPR, and a growing roster of partners. The company is at an inflection point — scaling up, bringing financial operations in-house, and building the systems that will support its next phase of growth. The person who steps into this role will have a direct line to leadership and a real stake in getting the financial foundation right. About the Role ---------------- This is a full-time, fully remote bookkeeping and financial operations role reporting directly to Jan (CEO). You'll own the company's books in QuickBooks, manage AR and AP, handle high-volume invoicing across multiple contract types, coordinate subcontractor billing, and produce the monthly financial statements that give Jan and Teressa the visibility they need to run the business. You'll also serve as the primary point of contact for client billing questions and work closely with Jan's Virtual Assistant to keep the quote-to-booking pipeline moving. This is a build role. You'll inherit a QuickBooks file that needs cleanup, processes that need documentation, and a financial operation that needs ownership. If you like starting with a blank slate and making it better, this is the right opportunity. What You'll Do ---------------- Core bookkeeping and financial operations: • Own the QuickBooks file — clean it up, keep it current, and make it the reliable source of truth for the business • Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts monthly • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable end-to-end • Produce monthly financial statements: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, AR aging, AP aging • Support year-end preparation and CPA coordination Invoicing and contract billing: • Handle all customer invoicing — accurately, on time, and on cadence — for schools, construction clients, summer camps, and subcontractor trips • Populate client-specific invoice templates with zero-error accuracy (dates, trip data, PO numbers) • Manage invoicing volume during peak periods (500+ trips over an 8-week summer camp season) Subcontractor and DPR contract management: • Collect, review, and verify subcontractor invoices against actual work performed • Communicate with subcontractors regarding missing information, corrections, payment status, and deadlines • Manage dedicated invoicing for the DPR contract and farmed-in trips Client communication and revenue operations: • Follow up on unpaid invoices and lapsed quotes — professionally and persistently • Confirm quote acceptance, payment method, and PO requirements before trips are finalized • Work with Jan's VA to keep the Working Document current: quote status, payment method, PO requirements, invoice status, trip readiness A Day in the Life ---------------- You start the morning by reviewing the QuickBooks dashboard and flagging anything that needs same-day attention — an overdue invoice, a subcontractor payment due this week, a reconciliation discrepancy from yesterday. You send the daily status note to Jan before 9am without being asked. Mid-morning, you pull the BCPS invoices for the previous week's trips, populate the mileage and time formulas in the client template, and transmit them on schedule. You follow up by phone with a construction client whose invoice from three weeks ago is still outstanding — you've email ed twice; this one needs a call. After lunch, you reconcile the last of the credit card accounts for month-end, generate the AR aging report, and flag one account that's gone 60 days past due for Jan's review. You finish the day by entering three new subcontractor invoices, verifying them against the trip log, and updating the Working Document so the VA has current status on tomorrow's pending bookings. Nothing dropped. The books moved. Leadership has what they need. What We're Looking For ---------------- Must have: • Strong QuickBooks proficiency — QBO experience required, ProAdvisor certification strongly preferred • Experience cleaning up and maintaining bookkeeping files (not just inheriting a clean set of books) • Full-cycle AR/AP experience including proactive collections follow-up • Demonstrated high-volume invoicing experience — accuracy under volume pressure • Professional English communication — written and verbal, including client-facing calls • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and meet deadlines without reminders • Experience supporting US-based businesses Strongly preferred: • Prior experience at a CPA firm, accounting firm, or multi-client bookkeeping service • Experience with client-specific invoice templates and contract-based billing • Experience managing subcontractor or vendor invoices • Familiarity with Limo Anywhere or willingness to learn it quickly • Experience supporting small and growing businesses (owner-operator environment) Schedule & Compensation  ---------------- Full-time, fully remote. Core hours aligned to US Eastern Time, with consistent availability during business hours for client and internal communication. Compensation is structured at full-time equivalent of $12/hr USD, with compensation options, vacation and other benefits discussed transparently in the offer process based on qualifications and experience. A 90-day performance review is standard. How to Apply  ---------------- Please apply to this position through our online application. title: BIM Support Virtual Assistant
description: Application Requirements To be considered for this position, all applicants must submit both an updated CV or Resume and a 2–3 minute introduction video. In your introduction video, please tell us about your professional background, your relevant experience as a Virtual Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or Project Coordinator, any experience working with AEC, BIM, construction, engineering, or architectural teams, and why you believe you are a good fit for this role. IMPORTANT: Applications submitted without both an updated CV and an introduction video will not be reviewed or considered. Incomplete applications will be automatically disqualified. Job Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized BIM Support Virtual Assistant to assist our Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) team with administrative and project coordination tasks related to Building Information Modeling (BIM) workflows. This role supports BIM Coordinators, Architects, Engineers, and Project Managers by ensuring project documentation, file management, and communication processes run smoothly. The ideal candidate is highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable working with construction project documentation and cloud-based collaboration platforms. Responsibilities The BIM Support Virtual Assistant will be responsible for organizing and maintaining BIM project files, drawings, and documentation. You will upload, download, and manage files within BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or similar platforms while ensuring project folders follow company naming conventions and standards. You will maintain document version control and archive outdated files when necessary. You will provide administrative support by scheduling meetings, coordination calls, and project reviews. You will prepare meeting agendas, distribute meeting minutes, track project deadlines and deliverables, and manage team calendars and appointments. You will assist with project coordination by tracking RFIs (Requests for Information), submittals, and project correspondence. You will update project logs, spreadsheets, and reporting dashboards while coordinating communication between architects, engineers, contractors, and other project stakeholders. You will monitor project updates and ensure records remain accurate and current. You will also perform data entry and reporting tasks, generate basic project status reports, and assist with quality checks to ensure documentation is complete and properly formatted. As part of BIM workflow support, you will assist BIM teams with the administrative aspects of BIM processes, maintain BIM-related records, and support model-sharing and collaboration workflows under the direction of BIM specialists. Qualifications Candidates should have previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Project Coordinator, or a similar support role. Strong organizational and time-management skills are essential, along with proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required, as well as the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Preference will be given to candidates who have familiarity with the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry, experience using BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Procore, or similar construction management platforms, and a basic understanding of construction drawings and project documentation. Important Information This position is a support role and is not responsible for BIM model creation, Revit modeling, clash detection, technical design coordination, or architectural and engineering decision-making. Those responsibilities remain with BIM Coordinators, BIM Specialists, Architects, and Engineers. Employment Type This is a remote position and may be offered on either a full-time or part-time basis depending on project requirements and business needs.

title: B2B Content & Social Media Manager (Video + Ads)
job_title: B2B Content & Social Media Manager (Video + Ads)
description: Read this first I'm hiring one person to take over our content, social media and ads. If you're a content creator at heart who likes the marketing game and can ship every day without being chased, keep reading. About Feight AI We build custom AI solutions for manufacturers in Central Europe doing over €1M in annual revenue. The technical side is now staffed. I run sales, strategy and client relationships myself. What's missing is the engine that produces content, runs the social channels, and brings inbound interest from manufacturing decision-makers. This is a blank canvas. No content, no funnel, no paid presence yet. The person we hire defines what good marketing at Feight AI looks like from scratch, with me holding the strategic frame and you producing the actual work. What matters most The single most important skill is content creation, especially video. Our organic growth across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and our blog depends on it, and our paid ads only work if the creative is strong. You produce content yourself, every day, consistently. That's the heart of this role. Second to that is marketing sense. Enough to look at our numbers and tell me what's working and what isn't, and enough to have a real conversation about strategy. I hold the strategic frame. You execute and bring proposals. What you'll be doing day to day Producing 1 to 2 social posts per day, every working day, across our channels (Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, blog). Mix of text, graphics, and video. Creating short video content regularly. Editing, voiceover, visuals. This is the most important muscle. Running Meta Ads when we launch them. Building simple landing pages when needed for campaigns or lead magnets. Tracking what works. You watch the numbers across channels and tell me what's worth doubling down on. You probably Create content yourself as your main skill, especially video. You can show us examples. Have a marketing brain. Enough strategy sense to discuss what we should try next and why. Are organized and self-directing. You ship every day without being chased. Have a strong work ethic. If you say you'll publish something, it goes out, on time, at the quality you promised. Learn fast. If you don't know LinkedIn Ads or a particular landing page tool yet, you figure it out in a week. Communicate in English clearly and professionally. Use AI tools daily for the actual work. We expect this, not just talk about it. Want to earn more through results, not hours. The base is steady. The bonus is where it gets interesting. This isn't a fit if You don't personally create content. You manage other creators or "also write." You can't be consistent. You need someone to chase you every day to ship. You're motivated mainly by hourly pay, not by performance. You expect detailed onboarding and three months to figure out the basics. What we offer $1,500/month base, paid reliably and on time. Performance bonus tied to qualified leads and closed revenue. If your work drives sales, the bonus has no upper limit. This role exists for someone who wants the upside. Room to grow. As Feight scales, this seat scales with it. Today's content + social manager becomes tomorrow's head of marketing with a team. Fair, direct treatment. Clear expectations, no politics, predictable payments. We treat the people running important parts of our business like partners. Remote work with autonomy. Work on your own rhythm as long as the work ships and the numbers move. To apply Start your message with the word PLAYBOOK on the first line, so we know you read the post. Anything without it gets skipped. Then send us: A short video, 1 to 2 minutes, where you introduce yourself. Who you are, what you've done, why this role caught your attention. Three samples of content you've personally created. At least one of them should be video. One or two examples of B2B or business marketing work you've done before. Show us what you've shipped and the thinking behind it. Your full AI stack for marketing work. What tools you actually use for content, video, design, copy, ads, research. We want to see the whole setup, not just one tool. Generic copy-paste applications get skipped. We would rather wait than fill the seat with the wrong person. Next steps Here's what happens after you send your application: We'll get back to you within 5 business days. If your application makes it through the first filter, we'll send you a short trial task. It should take less than an hour. The top candidates from that round move on to an interview with the founder. All the best, FEIGHT AI Team

title: Junior Video Editor
description: *** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! *** *** About the Role *** If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it! Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals. If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading. *** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP *** To succeed here, you need to live these three values: Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision. Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team. Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable. *** Role Overview *** You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress. The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client. *** Core Responsibilities *** Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project. Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes. Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency. Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals. Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product. Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers. Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here. *** Required Qualifications *** Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats. Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results. Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows. RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media. Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume. Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress. *** Bonus / Preferred Skills *** - Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar) - Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers - Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content - Familiarity with ---------- or structured feedback workflows - Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects *** Compensation *** Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill. This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability. Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP). Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP). [*Conversions are approximate.] *** A Note on AI and Judgment *** At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt. If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now. *** How to Apply *** Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job. - Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]" - Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP). - Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration. - State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section. - In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff. - Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only. - Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list. Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

title: MSP IT Support Technician
description: MSP IT Support Technician — Job Description About Us We are a small, family-oriented Managed Services Provider based in Northern California, USA. Our team is made up of just two to three people, and we treat each other like family — not like numbers on an org chart. We work closely together every single day, helping each other solve problems, sharing knowledge, and making sure no one is ever left to figure things out alone. If you have ever wanted to be part of a team where you truly matter, where your contributions are noticed and appreciated, and where the people you work with genuinely care about you — this is that place. We pride ourselves on the deep, lasting relationships we build with our clients. Our customers are not just ticket numbers or account names. They are small business owners, professionals, and teams who depend on us every day to keep their technology running smoothly. We take that trust seriously. Every interaction we have with a customer is an opportunity to show them that they are valued, heard, and appreciated. We do not just fix problems — we make people feel taken care of. That philosophy is at the heart of everything we do, and it is the single most important quality we look for in every person who joins our team. The Role We are hiring an MSP IT Support Technician to join our small, close-knit team. This is a full-time, work-from-home position. You will be the friendly, knowledgeable voice and presence our customers interact with when they need help. Your primary responsibility will be to field incoming support requests from customers via phone calls, email s, and text messages, turn those requests into organized tickets in our system, and then work to resolve them — either on your own or by collaborating closely with the rest of the team. This is not a siloed role where you are handed a queue and left to grind through it alone. You will be working side by side with the team throughout the day, communicating constantly, asking questions, sharing ideas, and leaning on each other to deliver the best possible outcomes for our customers. We believe that the best support comes from a team that actually talks to each other, and we have built our workflow around that belief. Working Hours Your working hours will be 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday, Los Angeles, California time (Pacific Time). You must be available and at your desk during these hours. Our customers operate on this schedule, and being reachable and responsive during their business day is essential to the role. Key Responsibilities Customer Communication & Support Intake Answer incoming phone calls from customers who are reaching out for technical support. You will be the first point of contact for many of our clients, so a warm, patient, and professional phone presence is essential. Monitor and respond to support requests received via email and text message throughout the workday. For each request, gather all relevant details from the customer — what the issue is, when it started, what they have already tried, and any other information that will help us solve the problem efficiently. Create well-organized, detailed support tickets in our ticketing system for every request, ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks and that the team has the information needed to start working the issue immediately. Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting Work through support tickets to diagnose and resolve technical issues across a variety of client environments. Typical issues you will encounter include workstation and laptop problems, printer and peripheral connectivity, email and Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, network and internet connectivity issues, password resets and account lockouts, software installation and configuration, VPN and remote access problems, and basic server and infrastructure alerts. You will not be expected to know everything or solve every problem on your own. Part of your job is knowing when to ask for help and collaborating with teammates to find the right answer. We solve problems together. Ticket Management & Documentation Keep tickets updated with clear, thorough notes so that any tea ---------- mber can pick up where you left off. Document the steps you took, what you found, and what was done to resolve the issue. Maintain accurate records within our systems, including client assets, configurations, and procedures. Good documentation is what allows our small team to operate efficiently and deliver consistent, high-quality support across all of our clients. Team Collaboration & Continuous Learning Participate actively in daily team communication — whether that is a quick call, a group chat message, or a screen-sharing session to work through a tough problem together. Share what you learn with the team so that we all grow together. Stay current on the technologies and platforms our clients use, and be open to learning new tools and systems as our client base evolves. What We Are Looking For Required Previous experience in IT helpdesk or technical support, whether in an internal IT department or at a Managed Services Provider. We are not looking for a specific number of years — we are looking for someone who genuinely knows their way around common IT support scenarios and can hit the ground running with real-world troubleshooting skills. Familiarity with the day-to-day realities of MSP work. If you have previously worked at an MSP, you already understand the pace, the variety, the multi-client juggling act, and the importance of documentation and ticket hygiene. That experience is a big plus. Strong English communication skills. You will be communicating directly with our customers through email , text, and phone calls. Your English must be clear, professional, and easy to understand. You should be comfortable writing detailed email s, carrying on a natural phone conversation, and adjusting your tone depending on the situation — whether it is a calm explanation to a frustrated user or a friendly check-in after resolving an issue. A genuinely friendly, patient, and positive personality. This is not optional and it is not a soft requirement — it is central to who we are as a company. Our customers need to feel appreciated and taken care of every time they interact with us. If you are the kind of person who naturally puts people at ease, who stays calm under pressure, and who actually enjoys helping others, you will thrive here. Reliability and consistency. You need to be at your desk, ready to work, during our business hours every day. Our customers depend on us being available, and your teammates depend on you being present and engaged. A reliable home office setup including a stable, high-speed internet connection (at least 25 Mbps), a quiet workspace free from background noise during phone calls, and a computer capable of running multiple remote access sessions and browser tabs simultaneously. A headset with a quality microphone for clear voice communication on customer phone calls. Preferred (Nice to Have, Not Required) Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Entra ID (Azure AD). Familiarity with RMM and PSA tools such as Atera, NinjaOne, or similar platforms. Working knowledge of Windows Server environments, Active Directory, and Group Policy. Basic networking knowledge — understanding of DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewall basics, and general LAN/WAN connectivity troubleshooting. Experience with backup and disaster recovery platforms such as Veeam, Acronis, or similar solutions. Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, or Microsoft certifications. Experience using a ticketing system and understanding of basic ticket lifecycle management. What It Is Like to Work With Us We are not a large, impersonal company. We are a handful of people who genuinely like each other, look out for each other, and want to see each other succeed. When you join our team, you are not filling a seat — you are becoming part of something small and meaningful. Your work will be visible. Your impact will be felt. And the relationships you build with our customers will matter, because those relationships are the foundation of our business. We maintain a positive, friendly, and collaborative work environment and it is a high priority for us that every tea ---------- mber contributes to that culture. We want people who are likeable, who bring good energy, and who make the people around them — teammates and customers alike — feel better for having interacted with them. If that sounds like you, we would genuinely love to hear from you. Compensation & Benefits Competitive monthly salary in USD Paid time off 13th-month pay Permanent work-from-home setup — no commute, no dress code, just a comfortable place to do great work. A supportive team that actually has your back.

On the IT side, we manage our clients' networks, servers, Microsoft 365 environments, endpoints, and phone systems. On the security side, we design, install, and support their video surveillance and access control systems. We do things differently from most MSPs: we don't run a Tier 1 help desk. When a client reaches us, they get a skilled engineer who takes ownership immediately, not a scripted first-tier queue or an automated phone tree. That first-contact competence is a big part of why our clients enjoy working with us, and it's why we only hire technicians at Tier 2 and above. We're hiring part-time to cover our weekends, Saturday and Sunday, and we have additional weekday evening shifts available for the right person. Weekends and evenings are much quieter than our weekday daytime operation, so this isn't a high-pressure call queue. You'll handle the calls, email s, and tickets that do come in, owning each from first contact through resolution, and spend the rest of your time moving project work forward: deployments, configurations, maintenance windows, documentation, and backlog cleanup. Weekends and evenings are also when we can safely take systems offline for upgrades that would disrupt clients during the day, so a meaningful part of this role is planned project execution, not just reactive support. The weekend coverage is what we're most eager to fill. If you're interested, you can also pick up one or more weekday evening shifts on top of it; the full schedule is below. Because you'll often be our main presence outside core business hours, independence and sound judgment matter here. You won't be alone: you'll have escalation paths to senior engineers and the owner, and we take on the hardest problems as a team, but you should be comfortable owning a client environment and knowing when to escalate. The role is fully remote, and you'll be a full member of our team, not an isolated, outsourced contractor. What You'll Do - Handle client requests by phone, email , and ticket during your shifts, and own them from first contact through resolution - Deliver a confident, professional experience on every interaction; clients should feel they're in good hands from the first minute - Execute project work handed off from the weekday team: deployments, migrations, network and system configuration, and backlog items that need uninterrupted time to complete - Run maintenance windows: patching, firmware upgrades, server maintenance, and other changes best done while clients are offline - Administer Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD): user and license provisioning, Exchange Online, mail flow, and email security - Monitor and respond to RMM alerts (Atera) and manage endpoint security tools (Huntress, Bitdefender) - Troubleshoot networks: firewalls (FortiGate), switches and access points (UniFi), VLANs, VPNs, and DNS - Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy - Manage and verify backups (Datto) - Support VoIP systems and IP phones - Configure, support, and troubleshoot video surveillance systems (IP cameras, NVRs, and video management software such as Hikvision, Digital Watchdog, and Speco), including secure remote access and viewing - Administer access control systems (users, credentials, and door schedules) and troubleshoot controllers and readers - Remotely support our field technicians during security-system installs and service calls - Keep clear, accurate documentation for every client environment, including writing up the project work you complete - Work alongside our AI tooling, which we use heavily across daily operations What We're Looking For - 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience, ideally at an MSP - Excellent spoken and written English, with a strong customer-first attitude; you'll be the voice of our company on every call - The confidence to own client interactions and project work independently, along with the judgment to know when to involve the team - Self-direction: with lighter supervision outside business hours, you should be able to pick up a project, see it through, and document it without hand-holding - Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365/Entra, Windows Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals - Hands-on experience with firewalls and managed switches (FortiGate and UniFi a strong plus) - Experience with IP video surveillance and/or access control systems, or the aptitude and willingness to develop this expertise quickly (it's a core part of what we do) - Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection - A quiet, dedicated home workspace Bonus Points - Deep familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude, which we use extensively day to day - Spanish-speaking ability (written and/or spoken) - Hands-on experience with VMS platforms (e.g., DW Spectrum), access control systems, or remote video monitoring services (e.g., Immix) - Certifications (CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, Microsoft, Fortinet NSE, Ubiquiti, Cisco CCNA) - PowerShell or other scripting Work Setup - 100% remote, based in the Philippines - Part-time, permanent employee position, not contract work - All hours are in US Eastern Time, which maps to an overnight or early-morning shift in the Philippines (about an hour later when the US is on standard time) Weekend coverage, the core of this role (both days): - title: $10/hour: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Scheduler (TikTok/Reels)
description: Hi, I'm Andrew. I run two e-commerce brands and a personal channel. Yesterday alone, one video I created hit 2M+ views on IG, and I'm looking for a coachable long-term video editor to keep the virality spree going. You'll be directly tasked with creating content for brands with a combined 30,000+ followers and an algorithm that's currently on fire. You will be making a real impact. The deal: - $10 USD/hour via Hubstaff, growing as the role grows - Paid every 2 weeks via Wise, on time - Pro-rated 13th month bonus every December - Long-term role with growing hours and responsibilities - Paid 2-week trial period before formal long-term hiring The role starts at 10 hrs/week. It will grow toward full-time as we continue to scale and I trust you more and more. I keep my people: I have another VA who's been with me for over a year. She started at 30 minutes a week and now works 20-30 hours a week with multiple raises along the way. When I say long-term and growing, I mean it. Schedule: Flexible on when you work. What matters is the posting calendar: videos edited, scheduled, and live on time, every day. ~80% short-form content, ~10% long-form content, ~10% scheduling said content To be clear: short-form IS this role. If you're elite at short-form and just decent at long-form, you're exactly who I'm looking for. If long-form explainers are your specialty, this isn't your job. What you'll do: - Edit short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) for my brands: hooks, captions, pacing, sound - Main work entails working with AI-generated video clips (Higgsfield) and making viral short-form content: assembling, polishing, and making them feel native to the platform - Schedule and publish all content via Metricool across multiple accounts - Follow and improve our content SOPs (hook formulas, caption styles, what's working) - Secondary task: edit my personal channel. 5-10 minute talking-head videos plus shorts, 1-2 per week, simple clean style - Communicate with me daily via WhatsApp (async, I don't expect instant replies) - Take on new responsibilities as the business grows Hard skills required (short-form specific): - Elite short-form editing in CapCut: hooks that stop the scroll in under 1 second, pacing that holds retention, captions and sound that feel native to the platform - You can look at a video's first 3 seconds and tell me why it will or won't get pushed by the algorithm - A track record editing for TikTok/Reels/Shorts specifically. Show me, don't tell me. - You watch short-form daily and know the difference between an amazing video, a good one, and a bad one - Comfortable with Metricool (or willing to learn quickly) - Good written English, reliable internet, and a machine that can handle editing Soft skills required: - Highly coachable: I'll teach you our brand styles, hook formulas, and workflows. Learn fast and ask good questions. - Detail-oriented: a typo in a caption or a video posted to the wrong account costs real money - Consistent: this role lives and dies on the posting schedule - Has taste: you should have opinions about why a video is boring and how to fix it How to apply: No skills test, no essay. Just message me the link to one Loom video, covering these things. 5 minutes max or you will be disqualified. Being concise is crucial in this role, refilm if needed: - About yourself. Your short-form editing experience and why you fit this role - One thing that actually makes you you (a weird hobby, a strong opinion, your worst cooking disaster, anything but "I'm passionate about editing") - Screen-share 1-2 short-form videos you've edited that performed well (TikTok/Reels/Shorts, NOT long-form explainers, those will be ignored) and walk me through: why that hook, why that cut, what you'd change now. Show me the timeline. If you've run accounts with big view counts, drop those links too. - Please attach your portfolio via Google Drive if you have it. If not OK. Loom is the most important part. One real ask: don't run this through ChatGPT and read it off a script. I can tell instantly, it's painfully obvious, and it looks exactly like every other application. I'd genuinely rather watch you fumble through a real answer than nail a robotic one. Be a person, get creative, go off-script. There are no rules here, I just want it from the heart. I will watch every single Loom. Impress me, be different, and be creative!

title: Amazon PPC Growth Lead
description: Amazon PPC Growth Lead Please fill out this Google Form to apply for this job: ---------- Availability Full-time Only: Do not apply if you are seeking part-time work. Required Hours: 8:00am to 5:00pm CST, Monday through Friday. 100% Remote: No travel required. Internet: Reliable connection is a must. About the Role We are hiring an Amazon PPC Growth Lead to own advertising strategy and performance across a portfolio of Amazon brands. This is not a maintenance role. We are not looking for someone who simply adjusts bids, checks budgets, and waits for instructions. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of PPC as a growth function inside the business. If you are used to brand managers specifically telling you which products to raise budgets on and by how much, this is not the role for you. You will analyze the performance, know the brands inside and out, talk to the clients directly, collaborate with the brand manager on joint strategy, and advise on the strategy necessary to drive the growth. The right person knows how to analyze performance, identify what matters, create a plan, and communicate clearly with clients. They understand that Amazon advertising is not just about ACoS. It is about revenue, profitability, ranking, product growth, budget allocation, conversion, and total business performance. You should be the person who sees what is happening before the client asks. You bring ideas. You find problems. You recommend action. You follow through. Clients should feel confident that you understand their business and are actively leading the advertising strategy forward. You must be comfortable organizing and presenting data and analysis to the client, explaining your analysis and decision making and talking for a 1 hour PPC meeting 4-5 times per week. We are building a growth oriented agency with the longer term goal of launching our own products. What You’ll Own You will own PPC strategy and performance for assigned Amazon accounts. That means you will: Build and manage Amazon PPC strategies that support client growth goals Analyze performance across campaigns, products, keywords, search terms, budgets, and profitability Identify opportunities to grow revenue, improve efficiency, reduce waste, and scale what is working Explain what is happening in the account, why it is happening, and what should happen next Bring proactive recommendations to clients and internal teams Create action plans for underperforming areas and follow through until there is a result Connect PPC performance to broader business drivers like conversion rate, pricing, inventory, reviews, organic rank, margin, and product lifecycle Communicate strategy clearly so clients trust that their business is being actively managed Stay current on Amazon Ads changes, new opportunities, testing strategies, and competitive shifts What Success Looks Like Success in this role is not measured by whether you “touched” campaigns or adjusted bids. Success is measured by whether you are helping move the client’s business forward. You are successful when: Clients feel confident that PPC is being owned, not maintained You bring smart recommendations before being asked You can clearly explain performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps Accounts become stronger, cleaner, more strategic, and more scalable under your ownership PPC decisions are tied to business outcomes, not just campaign metrics You identify problems early and come with solutions You know when to push for growth, when to protect profitability, and when to challenge the current strategy Your work creates visible impact on revenue, profitability, efficiency, or client confidence What We Do Not Want This role is not a fit for someone who: Is used to spending most of your time raising and lowering bids Waits to be told what to do Runs mostly auto and category campaigns Reports high level aggregated numbers without diving into the details and explaining what they mean Thinks ACoS is the only metric that matters Avoids accountability for business outcomes Needs someone else to create the strategy Does the minimum required campaign work and calls it optimization Uses AI or Automation to do the majority of the work. We need someone who thinks, owns, communicates, and drives. Responsibilities Own Amazon PPC strategy across assigned client accounts Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns Analyze account performance and identify growth, efficiency, and profitability opportunities Build campaign structures that support scale, control, and clear decision-making Manage keyword strategy, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, budgets, and bid strategy Develop testing plans for new campaigns, products, keywords, placements, creative, and budget strategies Review performance trends and create clear action plans Prepare client-facing insights, recommendations, and strategic updates Partner with account managers and leadership to align PPC strategy with client business goals Identify when non-PPC issues are impacting performance, including pricing, inventory, reviews, conversion rate, content, or competition Communicate risks and opportunities early, with recommended next steps Must be highly competent managing accounts with over $100k/mo advertising budgets. Goals for This Role The goal of this role is simple: Make clients trust that their Amazon advertising is being actively led by someone who understands the business. You will be expected to: Drive profitable growth where opportunity exists Improve inefficient or underperforming accounts Build client trust through clear strategic communication Create proactive recommendations that lead to action Make PPC strategy easier for clients and internal teams to understand Turn data into decisions Own outcomes, not just tasks Requirements 3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience Must be able to run accounts manually. Must also be familiar with Pacvue Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display Deep knowledge of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC, CTR, keyword strategy, campaign structure, and profitability Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear recommendations Strong communication skills, especially when explaining performance and strategy Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or brands Ability to work independently and take ownership without constant direction Strong judgment around growth, efficiency, budget allocation, and profitability tradeoffs Preferred Experience Experience working in an agency or multi-client environment Experience with Amazon reporting tools, PPC software, or business intelligence dashboards Experience presenting strategy directly to clients or senior stakeholders Understanding of Amazon SEO, product launches, ranking strategy, promotions, and catalog performance Who Will Thrive Here You will thrive in this role if you are used to driving a business forward with ad strategies. You are analytical, creative, and accountable. You like digging into accounts and figuring out what is really going on. You are not satisfied with surface-level reporting. You want to know what is working, what is broken, where the opportunity is, and what should happen next. You do not need to be micromanaged. You want ownership. You want to be trusted. You want your recommendations to matter. Most importantly, you understand that great PPC management is not maintenance. It is leadership.

title: Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator
description: We are a U.S.-based private money lending company that provides short-term, asset-based loans to real estate investors. We focus on first- and second-position loans, bridge funding, gap funding, and creative real estate transactions. We value clean execution, capital protection, and professional communication. Role Overview We are hiring a Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator to run borrower intake, manage our loan pipeline, and prepare deal files for underwriting. This role is the operational backbone of our lending business and works directly with borrowers, brokers, and internal leadership. This is not a bank mortgage role. You will support private money and creative real estate deals using a CRM pipeline (GoHighLevel) and documented internal SOPs. Key Responsibilities Borrower Intake & Pipeline Management Respond to new borrower applications and CRM inquiries the same business day Send first-touch outreach to all new borrower leads promptly Follow up consistently to collect missing application items Accurately track and update borrower status through the correct CRM pipeline stages Keep the pipeline clean — no stale files, no unanswered leads Flag urgent or high-priority deals for leadership without delay Loan File Organization & Documentation Create and maintain borrower folders in Google Drive per company naming conventions Collect ALL required documents before escalating a file: purchase agreement, rehab budget/scope of work, ARV comps, property photos, borrower ID, LLC documents (Operating Agreement + proof of good standing), verified HUDs, insurance, and a clearly stated exit strategy Track all documents and file status accurately in the CRM Submit complete, clearly labeled files that are ready for underwriting SOP Adherence & Deal Pre-Qualification Pre-qualify deals against our lending criteria before escalating (private money vs. hard money vs. hybrid) Apply our quick-screen criteria accurately (LTV, borrower spread, combined leverage, close timeline) Verify all non-negotiable borrower requirements Route deals that fall outside our criteria to our referral process per SOP Escalate unclear or borderline deals to leadership — never force a file through Communication & Reporting Provide consistent daily end-of-day (EOD) updates: completed, pending, needs attention Communicate professionally and clearly with borrowers throughout the loan process Proactively surface open loops, urgent items, and potential issues without being asked Log all borrower conversations and decisions in the CRM accurately and promptly Important Authority Boundaries You will prepare, organize, and pre-qualify deals — but you will not approve loans, set terms, or make funding decisions. All approvals and final decisions stay with internal leadership. Requirements 2+ years experience in real estate transactions, loan processing, or lending support Strong attention to detail and organization Excellent written and spoken English Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients Ability to manage multiple deals at once without dropping follow-ups Experience using CRMs and pipeline-based systems Reliable daily availability and consistent EOD reporting Nice to Have (Not Required) Private money, hard money, or creative real estate (subject-to, seller finance) experience Familiarity with real estate investing terminology and underwriting basics (ARV, LTV, HUDs, exit strategy) Experience pulling comps (e.g., PropStream, Redfin) GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience What Success Looks Like Clean, accurate CRM records with every lead answered Deals move smoothly with minimal rework Files reach leadership complete and ready for underwriting Borrowers feel informed and supported Leadership does not need to fix or chase files Growth Path Strong performers move into expanded responsibility: full pipeline management without daily supervision, loan-file audits, lead generation in investor communities, weekly pipeline and loan-admin reporting, and coordinating document requests with borrowers and title companies. How to Apply Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why you're an excellent fit for this role. Include the word "Lending" in your application message so we know you read this fully.

job_title: Content Workflow & Systems VA (No Video Editing, No Strategy)
description: READ THIS FIRST – THIS IS A SYSTEMS ROLE (NO VIDEO EDITING, NO STRATEGY) If you want to be a “creative” or editor, this is NOT the job for you. I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance. I have already built a detailed Content Operating System (Google Drive structure, Content Tracker, SOPs, Loom trainings). I shoot content and drop it into a Drive INBOX. I need a Content Workflow & Systems VA who loves structure and can run the machine so I don’t have to think about it. Your mission: take every video I drop into Drive and, using my SOPs, turn it into organized assets and scheduled posts across Instagram, Facebook , TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn. This is FULL-TIME and LONG-TERM for someone in the Philippines with very strong written English and experience supporting coaches/creators. WHAT THIS JOB IS (YOUR DAILY WORK) You will NOT do video editing. You will NOT design graphics. You will NOT invent content strategy. You WILL: 1) Handle content intake & organization – Check a Google Drive INBOX for new videos. – Move files into the correct folders (RAW, PROOF, Stefan Asset Bank). – Create/update rows in a Google Sheets Content Tracker (AssetID, file path, type, status, transcript level, etc.). 2) Create and clean transcripts – Upload videos to transcription tools. – Paste transcripts into Google Docs. – Fix grammar, misheard words, punctuation and formatting so they read like a native wrote them (especially for testimonials, VSLs and “hero” videos). 3) Build editor briefs and manage revisions – Use AI tools + my prompts to generate editor briefs. – Copy the brief into a Clip Brief template (Google Doc). – Fill in Meta info (source file links, goals, etc.). – Add simple thumbnail notes (text + which folder to pull photos from). – Coordinate with the editor: • Move status from Raw ? Briefed ? Editing ? Needs Revision ? Approved. • Watch drafts, write clear revision notes, and approve final versions. 4) Schedule and publish content (NO editing) – Take finished assets from the “Approved” folders. – Schedule posts in: • Meta Business Suite (IG/FB) • TikTok Scheduler • YouTube Studio • LinkedIn native scheduler – Use provided captions/CTAs and make sure dates/times and platforms are correct. 5) Log performance monthly – Once a month, open platform Insights. – Add the top performing posts to a “Viral_Log” sheet (URL, views, saves, etc.). – Write 3–10 simple bullet-point learnings (patterns), NOT complex analytics. You will get Looms and written SOPs for all of this. Your job is to FOLLOW them, IMPROVE small things, and KEEP EVERYTHING ON TIME.
