description: This role directly determines our revenue. Abrahams Consulting LLC holds NASA SEWP VI Contract #80TECH26D1658 — a $20 billion federal IT contract. We can only sell what is loaded into our NASA catalog. You are the person who builds, maintains, and prices that catalog. Without a well-managed catalog, there are no orders. This is hire #3 on a brand-new government contract team. This role directly determines our revenue. Abrahams Consulting LLC holds NASA SEWP VI Contract #80TECH26D1658 — a $20 billion federal IT contract. We can only sell what is loaded into our NASA catalog. You are the person who builds, maintains, and prices that catalog. Without a well-managed catalog, there are no orders. This is hire #3 on a brand-new government contract team. **The scale of this catalog 9 IT technical areas to catalog across 5,000 Max line items per daily submission 500+ Target items loaded within 60 days The nine technology areas span everything from laptops and servers to software, cloud platforms, networking equipment, AV systems, security tools, and product-based services. Your job is to build this catalog from the ground up and keep it accurate, priced correctly, and growing. **About the role You will be responsible for building and maintaining our entire IT product catalog on NASA's SEWP portal. This involves submitting structured data files called Technology Refreshments (TRs) to add, update, and remove products, assigning the correct UN product classification codes (UNSPSC), and ensuring every price we post is at or below our GSA Schedule price. You will also track product lifecycle — removing discontinued items before NASA flags them. This is a data-heavy, process-driven role. You need to be comfortable working with large spreadsheets, following strict formatting rules, and managing hundreds to thousands of product records with precision. A single incorrect price or wrong product code has real consequences on a federal government contract. Required availability: Monday–Friday, overlap with US Eastern Time business hours — flexible on specific hours but must be reachable during the day for coordination with the PM and DPM. What you will do Build the initial product catalog — Load our first 500+ products into the NASA SEWP database within the first 60 days. Work with our Program Manager and supplier contacts to gather product names, descriptions, part numbers, pricing, and UNSPSC codes for each item. Submit Technology Refreshments (TRs) — Prepare and submit daily TR files in the required keyword-value text format to add new products, update existing ones, change pricing, and remove discontinued items. Follow strict NASA formatting rules — no attachments, no HTML, no logos in TR email s. Assign UNSPSC codes — Every product in the catalog must have a correct 8-digit United Nations Standard Products and Services Code. You will learn and apply this coding system to accurately classify all IT products and services we offer. Monitor and maintain price compliance — Our SEWP prices must always be equal to or lower than our GSA Schedule prices. You will check prices regularly, flag any discrepancies, and submit corrections. If a supplier drops their price, you must update our catalog and notify the Contracting Officer within 7 calendar days. Manage product lifecycle (End of Life) — Track when products are discontinued by manufacturers. Any item on contract for more than 18 months without activity may be flagged by NASA. You will proactively EOL items before that happens. Manage provider/supplier records — For each manufacturer or supplier we resell, maintain accurate provider records in the SEWP system including supply chain level designations (Authorized Reseller, Subset Reseller, etc.) and supplier point of contact information. Support quote building — When the PM or DPM builds quotes for federal agencies, you will be the reference point for accurate product details, current pricing, and CLIN numbers. Help verify that every item quoted is active in the SEWP catalog. Maintain catalog accuracy reports — Keep internal spreadsheets tracking what is in the catalog, what needs updating, what is coming up for EOL, and what new products are pending submission. What you need to know about TR rules NASA has strict rules for catalog submissions. Maximum 1 regular TR per day. Maximum 5,000 line items per TR. TR files must be plain text (.txt) in keyword-value format — no attachments, no logos, no HTML. Submitting incorrectly formatted TRs results in exclusions and delays. You will be trained on the exact format, but attention to detail is non-negotiable from day one. Requirements Must have -Advanced Microsoft Excel — you will manage large product datasets, do price comparisons, and build tracking spreadsheets -Strong data entry accuracy — product codes, prices, and part numbers must be exact -Experience managing product catalogs, databases, or large data sets -Comfortable learning and applying structured classification systems (like UNSPSC codes) -Highly organized — you will track hundreds to thousands of products simultaneously -Good written English for internal coordination with the PM/DPM team -Reliable high-speed internet + professional home office setup -Full-time availability, Monday–Friday Nice to have* -Experience with e-commerce product catalog management (Shopify, Amazon Seller, etc.) -Familiarity with IT hardware and software products (Dell, HP, Lenovo, Cisco, Microsoft, etc.) -Experience with GSA Schedule pricing or government procurement -Background in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain -Experience with product classification systems or data standardization -Prior experience working with US-based clients or employers Why this role is different -Revenue-critical work -The catalog you build is what generates all our orders. Your work has direct business impact. -Supporting a NASA contract -Your work sits at the heart of a $20 billion federal IT procurement vehicle. -Long-term stability -10-year contract. people FIT: You write clear and professional English FIT: You understand sales conversations FIT: You are curious about business and marketing FIT: You can build rapport without sounding fake FIT: You are organized with follow-ups FIT: You are not afraid to message strangers FIT: You can represent our company professionally FIT: You understand or are willing to learn lead generation FIT: You description: Apparel Graphic Designer | T-Shirt Designs, Typography & Ecommerce Product Concepts We are looking for a talented part-time Apparel Graphic Designer to help create original apparel designs for a growing ecommerce brand. This role is focused on creating strong, marketable designs for t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, hats, patches, and other apparel-based products. The main goal is to create more high-quality design concepts so we can test more product listings, identify what customers respond to, and eventually develop winning signature products. This is not a general VA role. This is not mainly a social media role. We are looking for a designer who can create original product graphics that look good, feel wearable, and have ecommerce selling potential. Main Priority: Apparel Design The main focus of this role is creating original apparel graphics. You should be able to design: * T-shirt graphics * Hoodie and sweatshirt designs * Typography-based apparel designs * Badge and patch-style graphics * Statement designs * Faith-forward designs * Patriotic designs * Local/city/state-inspired designs * Vintage-inspired graphics * Clean minimalist apparel concepts * Product design variations and colorways We are looking for someone with strong taste in typography, layout, spacing, and wearable product design. Brief Workflow In many cases, we will provide the niche, phrase, theme, product idea, or general direction. From there, your job will be to create multiple design concepts based on that direction. We will review the designs, give feedback, choose the strongest ones, and continue refining from there. Some designs may be used for test listings to see what customers respond to. Winning designs may eventually become signature products or part of a larger collection. We are looking for someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into strong, sellable apparel design options. What We Need From You You should be able to: * Create original designs from scratch * Create multiple design concepts from one idea * Understand current apparel design trends * Understand what looks good on t-shirts, hoodies, and hats * Use strong typography and layout * Create clean, production-friendly artwork * Follow brand direction and references * Take feedback and revise quickly * Create mockups to show how designs look on products * Organize files clearly * Deliver designs consistently We do not need overly complicated artwork. We need clean, strong, marketable designs that people would actually want to wear. Design Style We Like Our preferred style may include: * Clean typography * Premium minimal design * Vintage-inspired apparel graphics * Collegiate / athletic-style layouts * Badge-style designs * Strong statement designs * Faith-forward concepts * Patriotic concepts * Local pride / city-inspired concepts * Simple but impactful visuals We do not want designs that look generic, overly cluttered, copied, or like basic template work. Production Awareness You do not need to handle final production or POD setup. However, you should understand that designs need to work on real products. Designs should be clean enough for apparel printing, embroidery, patches, or product mockups when needed. You should avoid artwork that is too thin, too detailed, hard to read, or difficult to produce. Tools You may use tools such as: * Adobe Illustrator * Photoshop * Canva * Kittl * Figma * Procreate * AI design tools * Or similar design software We care more about the final result than the exact tool, but designs must look professional and be delivered in usable file formats. File Deliverables Depending on the project, we may ask for: * PNG with transparent background * SVG, PDF, AI, or editable source file when available * Product mockup preview * Organized design files * Font names or design notes when needed * Colorway variations Helpful Experience Experience with any of the following is a plus: * T-shirt design * Apparel brands * Etsy products * Shopify products * Print-on-demand products * Kittl or Canva apparel design * Typography design * Merch design * Hat or patch design * Ecommerce product mockups This role is focused on creating apparel designs and product concepts. Hours & Schedule This is a flexible part-time role to start. Hours are flexible and negotiable depending on your skill level, availability, communication, and quality of work. We may hire more than one designer because we want to test more product ideas and build a stronger design pipeline. We are looking for someone creative, dependable, detail-oriented, and consistent. The right person understands that ecommerce apparel is about testing ideas, improving designs, and finding products that customers actually want to buy. We want designers who can bring ideas to life, create strong product concepts, and help us build a bigger pipeline of testable apparel designs.

title: Full-Time Recruiter — Weekend Availability Required
description: # Philippines-Based Virtual Assistant ## Caregiver Recruiting, Pipeline Management & Homecare Operations **RN-Owned Private-Pay Homecare Agency | Massachusetts | Long-Term Role** We are a fast-growing, RN-owned private-pay homecare agency based in Massachusetts looking for a highly dependable, organized, and accountable **Philippines-based Virtual Assistant**. The **main focus of this role is caregiver recruiting and pipeline management**. Your job is to help find caregivers, screen them, follow up with them, collect documents, schedule interviews, track their progress, and move them through the hiring pipeline quickly and consistently. This is not a casual VA role. This is a repetitive, fast-paced recruiting and operations support role. We need someone who can stay focused, follow up constantly, update trackers accurately, and make sure applicants do not fall through the cracks. You will work directly with ownership and will be expected to communicate quickly, stay organized, and take ownership of the caregiver pipeline. --- ## Main Responsibility: Recruiting & Pipeline Management Your primary responsibility is to keep the caregiver recruiting pipeline moving every day. This includes: * Messaging new caregiver applicants * Calling or texting applicants * Screening caregivers * Scheduling interviews * Following up with applicants who do not respond * Tracking every applicant’s status * Following up on missing documents * Following up on references * Making sure onboarding steps are completed * Updating the recruiting tracker daily * Keeping ownership updated on who is ready, who is delayed, and who needs follow-up * Pushing qualified caregivers forward until they are hired, rejected, or removed from the pipeline The goal is simple: **move caregivers through the pipeline without delay.** This role requires repetitive follow-up. You cannot be afraid to message people multiple times, keep lists organized, and stay on top of every applicant. --- ## Important: Monitoring & Accountability Because this is a remote position, all paid working hours are monitored through time-tracking and activity-monitoring software. You must be fully comfortable with: * Clocking in and out accurately * Screenshot monitoring during paid hours * Activity tracking and idle-time tracking * App and website usage monitoring * Working only on assigned company tasks during paid time * Responding quickly on WhatsApp during scheduled hours * Providing updates throughout the day * Being honest and transparent about internet, power, weather, or personal issues If you are not comfortable being monitored while working, this is not the right position. We are not looking for someone who disappears during work hours, delays responses, gives vague excuses, or needs to be chased for basic updates. --- ## Daily Work Expectations This role involves repetitive but important work every day. You will be expected to: * Review new applicants * Send recruiting messages * Follow up with caregivers * Update trackers * Confirm interview times * Check who is missing documents * Push applicants to the next step * Report progress daily * Communicate immediately when there is a problem This position is best for someone who is disciplined, consistent, and comfortable doing the same important tasks every day. --- ## Secondary Responsibilities: Operations Support Although recruiting is the main focus, you may also help with basic homecare operations, including: * Helping with schedule confirmations * Supporting shift coverage communication * Sending caregiver reminders * Updating spreadsheets and trackers * Organizing documents and digital files * Helping with care-related administrative tasks * Supporting communication with caregivers, families, and internal tea ---------- mbers * Researching vendors, caregivers, software, supplies, or other business needs as assigned --- ## Requirements * Must be based in the Philippines * Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours * Prior experience in recruiting, staffing, healthcare, homecare, or VA work preferred * Homecare experience is strongly preferred * Excellent written English * Good spoken English * Reliable computer and internet connection * Backup internet plan preferred * Must be comfortable using WhatsApp, Google Sheets, trackers, and time-tracking software * Must be comfortable with repetitive follow-up work * Must be responsive during scheduled hours * Must be looking for a long-term role --- ## Non-Negotiables You must be able to: * Show up on time * Respond quickly on WhatsApp * Keep the recruiting tracker updated * Follow up without being reminded * Move applicants through the pipeline daily * Communicate before there is a problem * Give updates if internet, power, or weather issues happen * Stay active and focused during paid hours * Be honest about what was completed and what was not completed * Accept monitoring and accountability during all paid hours If you frequently have attendance issues, internet excuses, delayed responses, or difficulty staying focused during remote work, please do not apply. --- ## This Role Is a Good Fit If You: * Enjoy recruiting and follow-up work * Like clear systems and expectations * Are comfortable with repetitive tasks * Are organized and detail-oriented * Are disciplined and dependable * Want stable, long-term work * Are comfortable being monitored during paid hours * Want to grow with a serious company --- ## title: Operations & Client Support Assistant
description: VFactor Health is a premium, clinical-grade online health-coaching program founded by Veronica Yu, a Registered Dietitian (RD) and Physician Assistant (PA). We're hiring a GoHighLevel Operations & Client Support VA — the organized generalist who keeps the day-to-day of a high-ticket coaching business running smoothly. About VFactor Health We help women 45–65 — on GLP-1 medications or considering them — lose fat, preserve muscle, manage side effects, and reduce long-ter ---------- dication dependence, delivered as health coaching, education, and support. Our clients invest several thousand dollars in our programs, so every touchpoint has to feel organized, personal, and professional. The Role Think part executive assistant, part client-support lead, part CRM/ops coordinator, with solid working knowledge of GoHighLevel (GHL). You'll keep the CRM clean, clients moving smoothly from booking through onboarding, the inbox answered, the files organized, and the founder's day handled — and you'll document how it all works so the business runs the same whether or not anyone's watching. When something needs deep automation building, we bring in a specialist GHL contractor. Your job is to operate the system well, not to build complex workflows from scratch. You'll work directly with the founder/CEO and the operations lead, so reliability, judgment, and clear communication matter as much as any single skill. What You'll Do GoHighLevel operations - Manage contacts and pipelines in GHL — keep records accurate, move contacts through stages, tag/segment correctly, and keep the CRM clean and trustworthy. - Coordinate client onboarding and appointments — schedule, confirm, reschedule, and follow up so nothing falls through the cracks. - Basic workflow troubleshooting — spot when an automation, calendar, or sequence isn't firing, do simple fixes, and clearly escalate anything complex to our GHL automation contractor. Client support & communication - Be the friendly, professional front line across the inbox, email , and SMS — answer client and prospect questions promptly in our warm, clinical-but-approachable brand voice, and route anything clinical to the right coach. - Keep response times fast and follow-ups consistent. - Executive assistance (to the CEO) - Calendar management, inbox triage, scheduling, and task/loose-end follow-up for the founder. - Light project coordination — keep tasks, people, and deadlines on track. Documentation & reporting - Google Drive organization & document management — clean folder structure, consistent naming, easy-to-find documents. - Spreadsheet and reporting updates — keep trackers and simple reports current and accurate. - SOP documentation — record processes with Loom and write clear step-by-step Google Docs SOPs. Who You Are Above all: exceptionally organized, reliable, and proactive. You catch the details, follow through without being chased, and bring order to a fast-moving business. You bring: - Experience supporting an online digital agency and/or a high-ticket coach / info-product business — you understand the pace and client expectations. This is what we care about most. - Working knowledge of GoHighLevel — comfortable in contacts, pipelines, calendars, and basic workflows; you can operate and lightly troubleshoot GHL. - Excellent written English and a genuine customer-service mindset — clear, warm, professional, and quick in client-facing communication. - Fluency with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Loom, plus comfort learning new tools quickly. - Self-management and remote-work discipline — you manage your time, hit deadlines, and communicate proactively, with strong daily overlap with U.S. business hours. - Nice to have (not required) - Familiarity with Typeform, Slack, Zoom, Calendly, DocuSign, email platforms (Klaviyo/Mailchimp), or light QuickBooks. - Background in health, wellness, fitness, or coaching. - Light SOP / process-improvement instincts. - You do not need to be an advanced automation developer. If your passion is building complex GHL/n8n/Zapier automations, that's a different role on our team — this one is about running operations cleanly and supporting the founder. This role isn't for you if… - You need detailed step-by-step direction for everything and don't take ownership. - You're disorganized or inconsistent with follow-through. - You want to spend your day building complex automations rather than operating and supporting. - You're slow or unclear in written client communication. What We Offer - A central, high-trust seat working directly with a clinician-founder at a fast-growing health brand. - A varied, never-boring role spanning operations, client experience, and executive support. 100% remote and flexible, with the stability of a foundational operations hire. - The chance to build and own the SOPs and systems the whole team relies on. job_title: Virtual Assistant for Simon Mariner - Business Development Support | Leadership Communication Practice
description: About the role: This is a research, outreach and pipeline support role for a senior leadership communication coach working with CEOs, Chairs and Executive teams at Australia's largest organisations — with a growing presence in the UK and US. The VA works closely with Simon to build and manage a targeted business development pipeline. The role is operational but requires genuine marketing intelligence — you need to understand what you're doing and why, not just execute tasks. What you'll own: Target list building and maintenance. Using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo.io to identify and track Chief Talent Officers, CHROs, and Heads of Talent at ASX 200 companies and large private organisations. Keeping the list current as people change roles. Trigger monitoring. Setting up and monitoring alerts for events that create outreach opportunities — new executive appointments, company restructures, CEO succession announcements, ASX results, leadership offsites, industry events. Flagging these daily with a brief note on relevance. Outreach drafting. Writing personalised LinkedIn connection requests and follow-up messages for Simon's review and approval. Each message references a specific trigger or piece of research. Never generic. Never templated beyond a light framework. Pipeline tracking. Maintaining a simple CRM or spreadsheet tracking every prospect, outreach sent, response received, and next action required. Weekly pipeline summary to Simon. LinkedIn support. Scheduling approved content posts. Monitoring engagement — who liked, commented, shared — and flagging warm signals for follow-up. Research. Pre-meeting research on prospects and their organisations. One-page briefing notes before any qualifying conversation. Calendar and scheduling. Managing meeting requests and scheduling once a prospect responds positively. Admin support. Invoicing, session scheduling, and general office administration as the practice grows. What you need: Excellent written English. Your outreach drafts need to sound like a senior Australian professional, not a template. This is the most important skill in the role. LinkedIn fluency. You know how Sales Navigator works. You understand how to search, filter, and build lists. You know the difference between a connection request and a DM and when to use each. Research instinct. You can scan a company's news, LinkedIn page, and ASX announcements and identify what matters in under ten minutes. Marketing understanding. You understand what a sales funnel is, what a lead is, what a trigger event is, and why personalisation matters. You don't need to be a marketer — you need to think like one. Discretion. You will be working with confidential client names and commercially sensitive information. This is non-negotiable. Proactivity. Simon is a senior practitioner, not a micromanager. You flag things, you suggest things, you solve problems before they become problems. Tools. Comfortable with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, Google Workspace, and a simple CRM or Notion. Willing to learn new tools quickly. What success looks like in the first 90 days: A clean, researched target list of 100+ CTOs and CHROs at relevant Australian organisations. A working trigger monitoring system. Ten to fifteen outreach messages sent per week on Simon's behalf, each personalised and approved. A pipeline tracker that Simon can read in five minutes and know exactly where every prospect stands. APPLICATION TASK - PLEASE COMPLETE BEFORE SUBMITTING - otherwise application will no be considered. This task is mandatory. Applications without a completed task will not be considered. It should take no more than 30 minutes. The scenario You are working as a Virtual Assistant for Simon Mariner, a senior leadership communication coach based in Sydney, Australia. Simon works exclusively with CEOs, Chairs and Executive Leadership Teams at major organisations, helping them communicate with greater impact, clarity and presence. His clients have included the incoming CEO of Westpac and the newly appointed Global CEO of KPMG. Simon charges $25,000 AUD per engagement and does not discount. He is not a sales trainer, not a presentation coach in the traditional sense, and not a motivational speaker. He is a C-suite strategic communications specialist. You have identified the following trigger event while monitoring LinkedIn this morning: Sarah Chen has just been announced as the new Chief People Officer at Suncorp Group, one of Australia's largest financial services companies. She starts in the role in four weeks. Her LinkedIn profile shows she previously held a senior HR leadership role at NAB for six years. Your task Write two things: 1. A LinkedIn connection request from Simon to Sarah (300 characters maximum — this is LinkedIn's limit for connection requests). It must reference the trigger, feel personal and warm, and not pitch anything. It should make Sarah want to accept. 2. A follow-up direct message from Simon to Sarah (no more than 150 words), to be sent 5 days after she accepts the connection request. This message should reference something specific about her new role or the challenges facing a new CPO in financial services right now. It should open a door without pushing through it. No pitch. No call to action beyond a light invitation to connect. What we're looking for We are not looking for perfect. We are looking for instinct. Can you write in a senior professional's voice? Can you make something feel personal rather than templated? Can you identify what matters to the person you're writing to rather than talking about Simon? Applications that sound like AI wrote them will not progress. Applications that sound like a human who understands the brief will. How to submit Paste both pieces of writing directly into your application message along with a brief note (no more than 100 words) explaining your approach — why you wrote what you wrote.

title: Outbound Calling Sales Person/Onboarding Manager
description: I am the founder of an online marketplace platform that is similar to airbnb, except it's specifically designed for long-term-care facilities for the elderly and disabled. We serve Adult Family Homes, Assisted Living Facilities and Nursing Homes. When one of these homes has an empty room available for an elderly person, they can list it on our website with photos and pricing info. When a family needs to find care for an elderly parent, they can go on our site and search their city to see all the available rooms nearby. They can contact the business with any questions, schedule a tour, request a quote or book the room. We're looking for a friendly, patient and self motivated outbound caller with outstanding sales and English speaking skills. The ideal candidate is a very committed person seeking steady and long-term employment in a position that will help thousands of elderly people and small business owners. This position is full time. Job Description: You will be cold-calling assisted living businesses to offer to list their available rooms on our website/platform for free - so that families can find them easier. 90% of the time, the people you will be speaking with are the business owners themselves. (The other 10% will be their employees.) Most facilities accept Medicaid clients. (Medicaid is a social service for low-income individuals. The government pays the cost of their care, but at a much lower price than private-pay) Business owners will have the option to post their Medicaid openings for free, or if they are looking for private pay clients, they can post their private pay openings on a monthly subscription (optional). If they agree to sign up and list their room(s), you will start by creating an account for them. You will ask their name, email and phone number. After you create an account for them, you'll then attach them as a user to their Organization profile. The next step is to ask them specific questions about their facility as you fill out their facility details such as Contact info, amenities, alcohol, tobacco, pets policies, equipment, and what they do or don't do at their facility. You'll then create two listings for them over the phone. One free Medicaid listing, and one Private Pay listing. The Medicaid listing will be published and live right away, but the private pay listing will stay unpublished. You'll ask them certain questions about about the room they have available, and about the services they offer, and what type of client they are looking for. You'll check all the boxes with their answers. You'll then ask them to get on our website either from their computer or phone, and you'll ask them to search their city from our homepage, and see how their listing looks. You will explain exactly how the entire process works, and instruct them where to click and exactly what to do. You'll explain how the free Medicaid listings work, and how the paid Private Pay subscriptions work. We have a very specific word-for-word script that you'll follow until you have the script and process memorized. Once you end the call, you'll send them a welcome email with additional instructions. The email will have instructions for setting a password, updating any of the facility information, adding photos, and starting a private pay subscription. They can either add photos themselves or email you their photos, and you'll need to add them to their listings. You will update a spreadsheet with all the businesses you sign up every day. You will remain their point of contact in case they need any help on their account. When we call businesses this way, we sign up 1.5 - 2 new accounts/listings per hour, and you will have no problem doing the same within just the first few weeks. The difference between this position and a typical cold-calling sales/telemarketing position is that the majority of the businesses you will be calling are actually happy to hear from you and are excited that you will help them. They have a hard time filling their empty rooms, and there is no service quite like ours. There are no angry people yelling at us or hanging up the phone. Please note that the majority of business owners you call are not native English speakers. Most are immigrants from other countries, and may have limited English and limited experience with computers/internet/technology. This role requires absolute patience. These people have huge hearts for caring for elderly and disabled people, but require some patience with technology. They are usually very self-aware and will tell you they are not good at computers, and they're extremely grateful for our absolute patience in showing them how it all works and explaining in a way that they understand. Pay: The pay is $1,000 month for full time 8 hours per day - plus commissions. While we are ok with the providers creating only free Medicaid listings, we definitely want them to list their private pay listings for the $199/monthly subscription. The $199/month gets them Google Ads, so they will get real google leads to see their listings and contact them directly to book their room. Most of their $199/month goes directly toward Google Ads. Your commission on every single paid subscription is $10. Most clients do not pay for a subscription on-the-spot over the phone, but instead they subscribe in the weeks following your phone call. If a business that you called and signed up pays for a subscription within 3 months of your phone call, you will earn the $10 commission. Every month that they stay subscribed, you will keep getting the $10 commission. Once they find a client and fill their room, they can unsubscribe and remove their ad. If another room becomes available later, and they subscribe again to advertise their opening, you will get the same $10 commission again every month - as long as they re-subscribe within 7 months of ending their first subscriptions. These businesses get an opening every 3-4 months. The average time it takes for them fill a room is 4-6 months. Payday is twice a month around the 1st and the 16th using Payoneer. Trial Period: After the initial training period, you'll start the calls at your own pace on your own. We need to see some of your accounts start signing up for the paid subscriptions as you get more confident and improve. There's a learning curve and the script can be difficult to memorize at first, but overall we'll monitor your sign ups and subscriptions over 2 - 3 months after training. We will know in the first few weeks if you are struggling badly, and will support you with as much additional training as needed. We are patient and willing to spend extra time with you as long as we're seeing improvements. If it looks like you're struggling with no noticeable improvement, or are far below the average with sign-ups, we may end your employment. This has never happened with anyone, but still worth mentioning. Training: I will be training you personally along with our sales director William. He is also Filipino, and has been working with us for over 2 years. We can get on video calls with you as you listen to my calls or William's calls, and watch our screen for the entire calls. You can ask any and all questions in between calls. We'll also send you hours of screen-recorded samples of successful calls to watch and memorize. You can access our Test website and create practice accounts to get used to the software navigation. We will be hiring 3 people for this role, and you'll have the ability to practice doing mock calls with each other to get comfortable with the script. It is a fairly long script because it goes from signing them up, updating their facility info, listing their rooms, to you leading an interactive website demo that they follow along as you explain to them how it all works. It will require some practice, memorization and patience to get comfortable. If you apply for this position, please mention "the assisted living marketplace". Once you're comfortable, you can start calling people as we listen in and watch your screen. If you prefer to record your calls, instead of having us monitor live, that works too. Then you will continue on your own with periodic check-ins from William or myself. Any questions you ever have, you can text or email myself or William. Requirements: Eagerness to memorize the script and process, honesty, patience and communication. We want you to do well and we will continue to train you as long as needed for you to succeed. If you're struggling with anything, please don't be shy or embarrassed or try to hide it. We want to help! We can only succeed if you're succeeding. I've failed more than anyone, and nobody is going to judge you or be mean to you. Outstanding English speaking skills and genuine friendly personality. Our approach is very different from typical cold call sales positions and we will train you until you're a master. Fast reliable Internet, computer and a smart-phone is required. We will provide access to virtual phone numbers through QUO app that you can call/text from. We will also set you up with a company email that you can email from and give to your customers in case they need any further assistance from you with their account. Benefit/PTO You will get 13th month pay in December. In the first year, it the bonus will be relative to the number of months you worked in that first year. You will get 15 days PTO that you choose. You can only take PTO days after 90 days of working unless pre-approved during interview process. There will be 7 additional US holidays that will be paid including Christmas, New Years Day, Thanksgiving, Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Memorial Day. Time Zone: Our company is near Seattle, WA USA and the Time Zone is Pacific Time. The calling/working hours are between 8am - 5pm Pacific time. This is a full time position for 8 hrs per day. You can choose which 8 hrs to work as long as it's Mon - Fri within 8am - 5pm Pacific. If you wish to apply for this position, please provide an English voice sample with your application saying the following lines: "Hi, I was calling to see if you guys have a room available?" "Perfect! I work with families, with hospitals, and with Medicaid to help you get clients without agencies or referral fees. We have a website where we list Adult Family Homes that have current openings. Would you be against me adding your availability to our site?" If you have any questions or if there's anything I missed, please let me know. Thank you! Vitaly

description: UI/UX Designer (Figma) Part-time | Remote | ~20 hours/week | Long-term engagement About Us We are a mobile app development and fractional CTO consultancy that works with startups and growing businesses to build products that are technically solid and genuinely well-designed. You will work closely with our project managers, engineers, and clients to translate product ideas into clean, buildable designs that follow Apple's Human Interface Guidelines. This is not a "make it pretty" role. This is a "make it work, make it make sense, and make sure we're building the right thing" role. If an idea won't work, you say so clearly and explain why. - You are proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You see a gap and you fill it. - You are confident enough to push back. Our clients are passionate and move fast. We need someone who can channel that energy into good design decisions, not just execute everything thrown at them. - You can tell the difference between a good idea that needs refining and an idea that needs to be set aside for now. - You communicate clearly in writing. Most of our collaboration happens async. What This Is Not This is not a role for someone who just does what they are told This is not a role for someone who needs everything figured out before they can start This is not a role for someone who treats every client idea as equally worth designing Nice to Have Experience working directly with non-technical clients or founders in a startup environment Familiarity with health, wellness, or lifestyle apps Experience designing for accessibility (contrast, font sizing, Apple accessibility standards) Logistics Remote, Philippines-based preferred Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week to start Long-term engagement if it's a good fit Payment in USD How to Apply Please send the following: Your portfolio (Figma files preferred, not just screenshots) A brief note (3-5 sentences) on how you handle it when a client asks you to design something you think is a bad idea Your availability and rate We read every application. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Native)
description: I'm Connor, founder of AdStream. I'm based in Australia and I run this company small and fast. AdStream manages the ad creative workflow for e-commerce brands running creator-made (UGC) video ads at volume: creative briefs go out, creators upload video, the brand's team reviews and approves everything in the browser, and approved ads publish straight to Meta. See it for yourself before you apply. Make an account at ---------- , click around, poke at the brief and review flows. The best applications come from people who've actually touched the product. What we're building right now Video playback. Reviewers play and scrub large creator videos in the browser, and right now playback is laggy. We serve full-quality source files straight from S3, so reviewers wait on buffering instead of reviewing. The route forward is Drive-first: Google Drive becomes the home for every customer asset. That gets us three things at once, fast playback on large files, customer assets living in their own Google Drive (a place they control and a brand they already trust), and the foundation for semantic search. That last one is the exciting part: once every file lands in Drive, we process it, get the transcript and text embeddings so you can search what's said in a video, frame embeddings so you can search what's visually in it. "Find b-roll with a kettle on a table." "Pull every clip where someone says sustainable." Internal teams find images, b-roll and past ads in seconds instead of scrubbing through folders, which makes video editing and graphic design dramatically faster. Beyond that, the roadmap you'd own: deepening the Meta integration and adding TikTok (OAuth, campaign publishing, status webhooks), AI creative generation with OpenAI, and Stripe billing. The stack Next.js 15 (App Router, server actions) + React 19 + TypeScript. Tailwind v4. Supabase — Postgres with row-level security, auth, storage. AWS S3. Google Drive API. Meta Graph API. OpenAI. Deployed on Vercel. You don't need prior experience with every line, but be honest about which parts you haven't touched, and don't propose a rewrite in week two. This is an AI-native role We provide a paid Claude Code seat and cover your AI tooling. You must already work this way daily, agentic tools (Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent), not autocomplete. You can write a spec an agent can execute, review agent output critically instead of trusting it, and verify AI-written code before it ships. One senior with a real agentic workflow now ships what a small team shipped a few years ago, that's the bet this role is built on. How we work: A 10–20 minute call every morning: what's planned today, review of yesterday, check in on deadlines. We agree on milestones upfront so everyone stays accountable. Be upfront about how long things will take. Not so we can micromanage, so we can be honest with our users and set expectations they can trust. Don't tell us it's a day if it's a week. Own outcomes, not tasks. Questions early, blockers immediately. Async outside the morning call: Looms, written updates. Hours are 9am–5pm AEST — a normal 7am–3pm day shift in the Philippines, evenings free. How to apply: Start your application with the exact phrase "Drive-first." It tells me you actually read this. Record a Loom (5 minutes max — clear and tight beats thorough and rambling) covering: You and your work. Quick intro, then walk me through something real you've shipped, what it does and what you built. AI doing meaningful work. One real example of using an agent for something substantial: how you directed it, something it got wrong that you caught, and how you verified it before shipping. I want to see judgment, not AI slop. How AI changed your workflow. How much more do you ship now? Do you still write most lines by hand, or mostly review and direct? Your models. Which model do you prefer and why? Do you run more than one, and how do you split work between them? If your Loom lands, we'll jump on a call. Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Bookkeeper for Canadian E-Commerce Brand
description: ABOUT US We're a Canadian DTC tea brand and sell through our Shopify store. We ship to the US and Canada from warehouses in both countries. THE SCOPE Phase One: Catchup & Cleanup (First 1-2 Months) You'll start by reconciling and cleaning up our books for the current year so far. This includes setting up a clean chart of accounts in QuickBooks Online, importing historical transactions, and getting everything reconciled and audit-ready. Phase Two: Ongoing Monthly Management Once the books are clean, this transitions into a long-term monthly role covering everything below. RESPONSIBILITIES Transaction Management - Categorize and reconcile all bank and credit card transactions in QuickBooks Online - Reconcile Shopify payouts against actual orders and refunds - Reconcile multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD) - you must ensure the bank balance in QBO matches the statement exactly, including handling exchange rate differences - Match and track Meta (Facebook /Instagram) ad spend invoices against bank withdrawals - Process and track expenses - supplier invoices, 3PL fees, freight, customs charges, software subscriptions - Ensure every transaction has proper supporting documentation Canadian Tax Compliance - Prepare and file quarterly GST/HST returns - Match receipts and invoices to maximize input tax credits (ITCs) - Track provincial sales tax obligations - Track US sales tax exposure (we use Shopify's auto-tax, but you'll verify) Monthly Reporting - Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements - Flag anomalies, unusual charges, or budget variances - Provide financial clarity to founders - not just numbers, but what they mean Inventory & COGS - Track landed costs (product cost + ocean freight + customs duties + warehousing) - Maintain accurate COGS records aligned with inventory movements - Reconcile inventory valuation quarterly Expense Tracking - Track recurring software costs - Track supplier invoices, 3PL fees, freight, and customs charges - Ensure all expenses are properly categorized and documented Year-End - Prepare working papers and schedules for our CPA/accountant - Support annual corporate tax return preparation - Prepare any required slips REQUIRED TECH STACK (Do Not Apply Without This Experience) - QuickBooks Online - Expert level. This is non-negotiable. - Multi-Currency Banking  - We operate in USD and CAD. You must have experience reconciling multi-currency accounts and handling exchange rates so the bank balance in QBO matches the statement to the penny. - Shopify - Experience reconciling Shopify payouts to QBO. - Google Sheets - Comfortable with ad-hoc reports and collaboration. REQUIREMENTS Must Have: - 3+ years of bookkeeping experience using QuickBooks Online - Experience with Canadian GST/HST filing and input tax credits - Experience with e-commerce businesses (Shopify strongly preferred) - Experience reconciling multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD) - Strong attention to detail - we have zero tolerance for sloppy entries - Fluent in English with strong written communication Nice to Have: - Experience with DTC or subscription-based businesses - Experience with inventory accounting and landed cost tracking - Previous experience transitioning a company from another system onto QuickBooks HOURS & COMPENSATION - Part-time to start - most likely 10-20 hours a month as we're still a small business, but expect it to grow as we scale - Schedule: Flexible, but must have overlap with Pacific Time for communication - Rate: $5–$10 USD/hour depending on experience - Long-term: We want someone who grows with us. This is not a one-off project. WHAT THIS ROLE IS - A key financial support role for a growing e-commerce brand - Someone who brings order, accuracy, and visibility to our finances WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT - Not basic data entry - Not a once-a-month check-in - Not suitable for someone who needs constant direction HOW TO APPLY We ignore generic cover letters. To show us you've read this posting and have the attention to detail we need, please follow these steps: **Step 1:** Start your message with the word TEA. **Step 2:** In your message, answer the following questions: **Question A:** We use multi-currency banking (USD and CAD). How do you handle the exchange rate difference in QBO when reconciling a multi-currency account to ensure the bank balance matches the statement? **Question B:** We receive Shopify payouts approximately 3 times per week. Each payout bundles sales, refunds, fees, and adjustments. How would you reconcile these in QBO? Walk us through your approach. **Question C:** What is your experience with Canadian GST/HST input tax credits? Give us a specific example of how you've maximized ITCs for a previous client. **Question D:** We track our true landed COGS (product cost + inbound freight + duties + 3PL) in a separate inventory system that produces a monthly COGS figure. In QuickBooks Online, walk us through exactly how you'd record COGS each month so our P&L and balance sheet stay accurate. Be specific about which accounts you'd use and what entries you'd make. **Step 3:** Include the following: - A short intro about yourself and your bookkeeping experience - Your experience with e-commerce / Shopify businesses specifically - Your expected monthly rate in PHP - Your available hours and timezone - Your QuickBooks Online proficiency self-rating (1-10) Applications that do not answer the screening questions will not be considered. description: Travel Operations Coordinator / Itinerary Project Manager Job Description We are looking for an exceptionally detail-oriented, highly organized, and meticulous Travel Operations Coordinator / Itinerary Project Manager to help execute high-end surf travel experiences for our clients. This is not a general travel agent sales role. Our team sells and designs the overall trip concept, and this role helps bring those trips to life through detailed planning, research, coordination, fact-checking, vendor communication, and itinerary execution. The ideal candidate is a planner and project manager at heart — someone who loves details, checklists, logistics, timelines, clear communication, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You will help take a simple trip outline and turn it into a complete, polished, highly detailed itinerary with every important step accounted for. This includes gathering essential information, confirming details with clients and vendors, researching travel logistics, checking drive times and transfer flow, coordinating reservations and activities, tracking deadlines, and helping ensure each trip runs smoothly from start to finish. We are a boutique surf travel company that plans elevated, highly customized trips for families, couples, groups, and corporate clients. Our clients expect thoughtful planning, accurate information, beautiful trip flow, and excellent service. This role is essential to delivering that experience. This is a remote position. A strong internet connection, excellent written English, and comfort using remote work tools are required. We use Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects, Zoho Cliq, email , shared documents, spreadsheets, and online research tools. Key Responsibilities Trip Planning & Itinerary Execution - Turn high-level trip outlines into detailed, step-by-step travel itineraries. - Research and verify important trip details such as travel times, transfer logistics, activity timing, restaurant options, surf lesson schedules, check-in/check-out times, and destination-specific considerations. - Help create smooth trip flow with realistic timing, appropriate buffers, and thoughtful sequencing of activities. - Identify missing details, open questions, possible conflicts, and logistical issues before they become problems. - Coordinate with hotels, villas, surf schools, guides, chefs, drivers, restaurants, wellness providers, and other travel partners. - Gather and organize key information from vendors, including pricing, availability, inclusions, cancellation policies, payment terms, contact details, meeting points, and guest requirements. - Assist with booking and confirming trip components such as transfers, surf lessons, activities, meals, spa appointments, restaurant reservations, and special requests. - Maintain detailed trip notes, confirmations, deadlines, and task lists. - Help prepare polished client-facing trip materials, including itineraries, proposals, booking documents, and travel guides. Vendor & Partner Communication - Communicate professionally with travel partners and vendors by email , WhatsApp, and other channels. - Follow up consistently to collect missing information, confirmations, pricing, photos, menus, policies, and other required trip details. - Track vendor responses and make sure all important information is documented clearly. - Help compare vendor options and summarize findings for the team. - Confirm all details before client travel, including dates, times, locations, inclusions, costs, contact information, and special requests. Project Management & Operations - Manage trip-related tasks inside Google Docs/Sheets, Zoho Projects, Zoho CRM and shared documents. - Keep projects organized, updated, and moving forward. - Create and maintain quality assurance and planning checklists, spreadsheets, timelines, and operational documents. - Help ensure deadlines are met and no trip detail is missed. - Support the team with administrative, research, and operational tasks as needed. - Assist with improving internal systems, templates, SOPs, and planning processes over time. The Type of Person We’re Looking For You may be a great fit if you are: - Extremely detail-oriented and naturally organized. - A strong planner who enjoys logistics, structure, and checklists. - Comfortable managing many moving parts at once. - Proactive about spotting missing details, inconsistencies, and potential problems. - Excellent at written English communication. - Reliable, responsive, and consistent. - Calm under pressure and able to work carefully without rushing. - Comfortable asking thoughtful questions when something is unclear. - Able to follow directions while also thinking critically and independently. - Excited to help create exceptional travel experiences for clients. This role requires someone who is meticulous. Small details matter. Dates, times, names, pricing, inclusions, policies, and logistics must be accurate. Requirements & Skills - Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant, Travel Planner, Project Coordinator, Event Planner, Executive Assistant, or similar role. - Excellent written English communication skills. - Strong research skills and ability to verify information from multiple sources. - Strong organization and time management skills. - Experience managing projects, timelines, checklists, or complex administrative workflows. - Proficiency with Google Docs, Google Sheets, spreadsheets, and shared documents. - Familiarity with online calendars and scheduling tools. - Comfort using project management and CRM systems. Experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects, or similar tools is a plus. - Ability to work remotely with a reliable computer and strong internet connection. - Experience in travel, hospitality, luxury service, events, or client-facing operations is a strong plus. Nice-to-Have Experience - Travel planning or itinerary creation. - Hotel, villa, tour operator, or hospitality coordination. - Event planning or wedding planning. - Executive assistant work involving complex scheduling and logistics. - Client service for premium or high-touch customers. - Experience creating polished documents, proposals, or client-facing itineraries. - Interest in travel, wellness, adventure, or boutique hospitality. About Us Lush Palm is a boutique surf travel company specializing in elevated, customized surf trips for families, couples, groups, and corporate retreats. We combine real surf expertise with thoughtful travel planning, trusted local partners, and a high level of service. Our trips often include boutique hotels or private villas, surf lessons or guiding, private transfers, chefs, wellness, activities, and detailed destination planning. Our goal is to make surf travel feel seamless, thoughtful, and special for our clients. Application Instructions This is a part time role to start (4-5 hours/day, with potential to grow into full-time ~8 hours a day) To apply, please send your resume and a brief cover letter explaining why you would be a strong fit for this role. In your cover letter, please answer the following questions: 1. Tell us about a time you had to manage many small details for a project, trip, event, or client. 2. What systems, checklists, or tools do you use to stay organized? 3. Why are you interested in helping plan and execute detailed travel experiences? 4. What is one example of a small detail that could cause a big problem in a travel itinerary? description: Type: Full-time, long-term Pay: $1,000–$1,500/month retainer + leaderboard performance bonuses Hours: ~40/week, Monday–Friday (weekends optional but encouraged) Location: Fully remote ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT THIS IS ------------------------------------------------------------ I'm hiring a direct response video editor to join our creative team. You'd come in as an editor — but I do need someone who already has solid experience and a strong skillset, not a beginner. Full-time and long-term for the right person, not a one-off gig. ------------------------------------------------------------ ABOUT US ------------------------------------------------------------ You'll be working with a fast-growing health and wellness brand scaling hard in the US market. We run a huge creative team that ships a high volume of paid ad creatives every week, and we spend serious money on ads — so the work you make actually goes out and gets tested at scale. You'll see real numbers on your edits, not just upload and forget. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHO I'M LOOKING FOR ------------------------------------------------------------ A direct response editor who makes ads built to perform, not just look nice. If you've only ever done pretty edits with no understanding of what makes an ad convert, this probably isn't for you. You should be able to cut these ad styles confidently: - AI UGC ads - Voiceover + b-roll style ads - Greenscreen / AI avatar style - Claymation / Pixar / 3D animation style - Podcast-style ads - And honestly, whatever style is winning right now You'll be making a high volume of AI-generated creative — AI UGC, claymation, Pixar-style, podcast ads, avatars, and more — so you need to be genuinely comfortable producing and blending AI generative assets into ads that convert. ------------------------------------------------------------ THE ACTUAL EDITING SKILLS YOU NEED ------------------------------------------------------------ This is the part people usually leave vague, so let me be specific. Day to day, you'll need to be genuinely good at: HOOKS & RETENTION EDITING You understand the first 3 seconds make or break an ad. You know how to open strong, hold attention with pattern interrupts, zooms, jump cuts, and pacing, and keep someone watching to the CTA. PACING & RHYTHM You cut to the energy of the voiceover/script — tight where it needs to be, never letting a clip drag. Your edits feel fast and snappy without being messy. STORYTELLING TO A SCRIPT You can take a VO or ad script and build the visual story around it: matching b-roll, on-screen text, and beats to what's being said so the message actually lands. B-ROLL SOURCING & SEQUENCING You know how to find (or generate) the right supporting footage and place it so it reinforces the message, not just fills space. CAPTIONS & ON-SCREEN TEXT Clean, readable, well-timed subtitles and kinetic text — styled to match the brand, synced properly, and used to drive retention (not just slapped on). SOUND DESIGN Music selection that fits the mood, proper audio leveling, SFX and "whooshes" on transitions, ducking music under VO. Bad audio kills good visuals. BASIC MOTION GRAPHICS & TEXT ANIMATION Simple, clean animated text, callouts, highlights, and transitions that look professional. COLOR & CLEANUP Basic correction so clips match and look consistent, plus a clean, polished finish (no jarring cuts, no random aspect-ratio jumps). AI GENERATION You can actually prompt and produce usable assets — AI UGC clips, claymation, Pixar-style, avatars, b-roll, images — and blend them into a real ad so it doesn't look obviously AI. ORGANIZATION Named files, tidy project structure, hitting deadlines. You make it easy for the team to work with you. ------------------------------------------------------------ TOOLS YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW ------------------------------------------------------------ CapCut, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, Veo 3, Nano Banana, Higgsfield — and whatever else is current in the gen-AI stack. This space changes every single week and I need someone who actually keeps up, not someone I have to drag along. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT YOU'LL OWN (KPIs) ------------------------------------------------------------ DAILY OUTPUT: 1–3+ high-quality ad creatives per day, following our scripts and styles. 70% FIRST-PASS APPROVAL RATE: At least 7 out of 10 of your submissions should require no revisions — meaning they match the brief and are ready to test. AVAILABILITY: Online and responsive Monday–Friday. Weekends are optional but encouraged for the people who want to climb the leaderboard faster. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT MATTERS MOST (BEYOND THE SKILLS) ------------------------------------------------------------ - DTC experience is a must. You've already worked with one or more DTC / ecom brands — this is non-negotiable. Show me the work. - You use AI tools daily and stay updated as new ones drop. - Mindset — this is the big one. Coachable, fast learner, growth-oriented, and the type who tries to overdeliver instead of doing the bare minimum. You don't have to be perfect on day one. But you should be good enough to hit the ground running and hungry enough to keep leveling up. We've got a head editor who'll guide you on frameworks, hook structures, and what actually makes an ad win — so this is a genuine chance to learn ecom and direct response from the inside while getting paid well to do it. ------------------------------------------------------------ COMPENSATION ------------------------------------------------------------ Base retainer: $1,000–$1,500/month, depending on your skill level and experience. Retainers go up over time as your skills grow and you take on more responsibility. Leaderboard bonuses — on top of your retainer. Here's how it works: the editor with the highest number of winning ads gets first place, and so on. The whole team is ranked on a leaderboard each month, and the top 5 editors get paid bonuses on top of their base. The better your creatives perform, the higher you climb, the more you earn. ???? 1st place: $[500] ???? 2nd place: $[400] ???? 3rd place: $[300] 4?? 4th place: $[200] 5?? 5th place: $[100] We spend at a scale where this adds up to real money for editors who consistently ship winners. The leaderboard isn't just for show — it's there so the people putting in the work actually get rewarded for it. ------------------------------------------------------------ THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF ------------------------------------------------------------ - You make pretty videos but don't understand direct response. If you can't explain why a hook works or what makes an ad convert, this isn't the role. - You need hand-holding. You'll get guidance and frameworks from our head editor, but you're expected to manage your own workload, hit deadlines, and solve problems without constant check-ins. - You're a one-tool specialist who resists learning new things. Our stack changes weekly. If a new AI tool drops and the team adopts it overnight, you need to pivot without frustration. - You see this as "just a job." The people who win here are genuinely into short-form, AI creative, and direct response — and want to grow with a fast-scaling brand, not clock in and out. ------------------------------------------------------------ HOW TO APPLY ------------------------------------------------------------ In your proposal, include: - The Names of the previous Ecom Brands/Companies you have edited for - A short description of your current skillset. - A few examples of past ad creative work (UGC, voiceover, animation — whatever you've got) to back it up, including the DTC brand(s) you've worked with. Then answer these questions: 1. Pick one ad creative you've made that performed well. Break down WHY it worked from a direct-response angle — the hook, pacing, offer, CTA, or any specific editing choice that drove the result. 2. Tell me about a creative that underperformed. How did you use the performance data to figure out why, what did you change in the next version, and what happened? 3. Walk me through how you produce AI UGC or generative ads (claymation, Pixar, podcast, avatar, etc.) so they don't look obviously AI. What's your process and which tools do you reach for? 4. This role is high-volume — 1 to 3+ creatives a day. Describe your experience working at that kind of pace and how you keep quality high while moving fast. Include the code word 'ScaleMode' somewhere in your application. I only review applications that include it — it tells me you actually read the post and pay attention to detail. Then submit the trial task after you send your proposal. That's it. Looking forward to seeing what you can do.

title: Head Engineer

Knowledge of safety regulations, quality standards, and construction processes. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven. You understand why one hook stops thumbs and another doesn't. Editing is a tool you use. It is not what you are. If you're primarily a video editor who also posts to TikTok, this role isn't for you. Hit deadlines without being reminded. • Write hooks that compete. Every video starts with a line or visual that earns the next three seconds. You'll be held to this. • Select audio with intent — trending sounds, original audio, voiceover decisions. You'll know why you chose what you chose. • Edit for performance: pacing, completion rate, CTA placement. CapCut or similar. Editing is a means to an end — the end is results. • Transform UGC and existing footage into original-feeling content. You know how to recut, reframe, and re-score so the algorithm treats it as new. Uncut re-uploads aren't in your vocabulary. • Use native TikTok formats — Duet, Stitch, Green Screen — as deliberate reach tools, not as features you stumbled across. • Repurpose top-performing TikToks for Instagram Reels. Manage Facebook pages as a secondary duty. • Monitor comments and DMs; flag anything needing owner attention. • Coordinate with TikTok Shop: product links, affiliate awareness, live selling when applicable. • Track your own metrics — watch time, saves, shares, follower growth — and deliver a clear weekly summary. Honest numbers, not vanity metrics. • Proactively bring ideas, trend observations, and competitive intel. Don't wait to be asked. What We're Looking For Hard Requirements • Minimum 2 years managing TikTok strategy and growth for a US-market brand or agency client — not just editing videos for one • Demonstrated results: account growth, engagement lifts, or performance data you can point to and explain • Fluent written English — you write scripts, captions, and communicate directly with the brand owner • Comfortable editing in CapCut or equivalent — editing is a required supporting skill, not the job itself • Async-friendly, reliable, deadline-driven — you treat a posting schedule like a commitment • Able to work with minimal supervision on a fully remote team Strong Advantages • TikTok Shop experience: product linking, affiliate coordination, LIVE commerce awareness • Proficiency with Duet, Stitch, and Green Screen as strategic reach tools • Experience in natural products, wellness, pet, or handcrafted goods categories • Familiarity with US DTC consumer behavior ?? TikTok Compliance & Platform Intelligence — Non-Negotiable These brands operate in regulated-adjacent categories: skincare, pet nutrition, personal care. One post with the wrong claim, a banned audio track, or an undetected policy violation can suppress an account, restrict a shop, or worse. This role requires someone who treats TikTok's Terms of Service, Community Guidelines, and Commerce Policies as required reading — not fine print. That means: • You track policy updates. You know what changed in the last 90 days and what it means for product content. • You flag risks before posting — not after. • You know what can and cannot appear in TikTok Shop listings, captions, and on-screen text for health and wellness products. • You understand duplicate content detection and how to re-edit UGC properly so it registers as original. • You can explain your compliance reasoning when asked. Candidates who treat this as a checkbox will not advance. Candidates who treat this as a professional discipline will. What You'll Get • $350–$550 USD/month, part-time (~20 hours/week) — based on experience and results. Clear path to full-time as the brands grow. • Fully remote, async-first. No micromanagement, no daily check-ins. Own your schedule as long as deadlines are met. • Stable, long-term engagement — not a project hire. The right person grows with us. • Clean scope. No customer service, no inventory, no tasks outside your lane. • Direct access to the brand owner — fast decisions, real feedback, good work recognized. How to Apply Send the following via onlinejobs.ph message: 1. A brief intro (3–5 sentences): who you are, what TikTok accounts or brands you've managed, and one result you drove that you're proud of. 2. Links to 2–3 TikTok accounts you've managed. If under NDA, describe the account — but be specific about what you did and what happened. 3. Your answer to this required question. How would you handle it — in your content approach and in what you'd communicate to the brand owner?" Answer in your own words. A vague or generic response tells us everything we need to know. These are small, real brands built around products people genuinely love. We're not filling a seat — we're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, wants a stable long-term role, and is ready to grow alongside us. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

description: Job Title: LinkedIn Sales Navigator Research and Outreach Virtual Assistant Employment Type: Gig, project-based with potential to extend to part-time ongoing Hours: 5 hours per day, Monday through Friday About Me I am a Senior Talent Acquisition professional based in the United States with 20 years of experience supporting major financial institutions and global organizations. I am conducting a confidential job search and need a skilled, reliable VA to manage my entire LinkedIn outreach campaign from research through execution. I have a 10-year-old LinkedIn account with 6,000+ connections and an active LinkedIn Sales Navigator subscription. Everything strategic is already done. My messaging templates are written and organized by industry. My target company lists are built. My tracking spreadsheet is set up. What I need is someone who can take all of that and run it independently every day with zero hand-holding. Your Exact Daily Responsibilities Research and Lead List Building (approximately 1 to 1.5 hours) Using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, search for the right contacts at each target company on my provided list. Filter by company name, target title keywords, and seniority level I will specify. Verify that each contact’s current title matches my target criteria before adding them to the daily lead list. Log all identified contacts in our shared Google Sheet with their full name, company, current title, and LinkedIn profile URL before beginning outreach. Send Connection Requests (approximately 1.5 to 2 hours) Send 40 connection requests per day using my exact provided templates. Each template is specific to an industry section. You will replace only the bracketed fields, the contact’s first name. No other wording changes under any circumstances. Log each request in the tracking sheet immediately after sending, including contact name, company, title, industry section, date sent, and status marked as Pending. Do not exceed 50 connection requests in a single day. Monitor Accepted Connections and Send Follow-Ups (approximately 30 minutes) Check LinkedIn notifications daily for newly accepted connections. Send the follow-up message within 24 hours of acceptance using the exact industry-specific template I provide. Replace only the bracketed fields for first name and company name. Log the follow-up in the tracking sheet with date sent and status updated to Follow-Up Sent. Monitor Replies and Flag to Me Immediately (approximately 30 minutes) Check LinkedIn messages for any replies from contacts. Do not respond to any reply under any circumstances. The moment anyone replies, flag it to me immediately via WhatsApp with the contact’s full name, company, and the exact text of their message. Mark their status in the tracking sheet as Reply Received with the date. I handle all conversations personally from that point forward. Daily Summary and Next Day Prep (approximately 30 minutes) Send me a brief daily WhatsApp or email update at the end of each session covering the following. How many contacts were researched and added to the lead list. How many connection requests were sent and to whom. How many follow-up messages were sent and to whom. Any replies received and from whom. Any issues encountered including title mismatches, profiles that could not be found, or any LinkedIn restriction or warning notices. Use the remaining time to pull tomorrow’s target companies and begin preliminary research so the next day starts efficiently. What You Will Never Do Never respond to any reply or message from a contact. Never modify the provided message templates. Never connect with anyone outside the approved target company list without my explicit written approval. Never send more than 50 connection requests in a single day. Never make any changes to my LinkedIn profile, settings, biography, photo, or account information of any kind. Tools You Will Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, access provided by me. Shared Google Sheet for daily tracking, set up by me. WhatsApp for daily communication and urgent reply flagging. You Are the Right Person If You Have hands-on experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator for lead research and outreach. Have supported a professional job search campaign or B2B LinkedIn outreach campaign before. Can follow written instructions precisely and consistently without improvising or taking initiative beyond your defined scope. Have strong professional English, sharp attention to detail, and zero tolerance for errors in names or company details. Are available Monday through Friday and can commit to five focused hours per day for the duration of the project. Communicate proactively if something is unclear rather than guessing. Have experience supporting HR, recruiting, legal, financial services, or other professional services clients. How This Engagement Works This starts as a two week paid gig. If your work is strong and the campaign is generating results, this converts to an ongoing part-time role for the duration of my job search. Before your first day I will provide complete access to all tools, all templates, all target lists, and the tracking sheet. We will do a 30 minute onboarding call via Zoom to walk through everything together so there are no questions on day one. To Apply Do not send a generic proposal. It will not be read. Tell me specifically what LinkedIn Sales Navigator research or outreach work you have done before. Give me one concrete example: who you did it for, what the daily scope was, and what the outcome was. If you have supported a job search or recruiting outreach campaign specifically, describe it in detail. Include your availability to start. Applications without a specific example and a stated rate will not be considered. Sales Navigator proficiency is non-negotiable for this role.
