title: # Cinematic Real Estate Video Editor
description: # Cinematic Real Estate Video Editor ## Position Overview We are looking for a talented Cinematic Real Estate Video Editor to help build one of Australia's leading premium real estate media brands. This is not a role for someone who simply cuts clips together. We are looking for an editor who understands storytelling, pacing, emotion, and marketing. Every video should feel intentional, cinematic, and elevate the property's value. Our goal is to create timeless, premium real estate films that stand apart from the fast-paced, over-edited style commonly seen in the industry. We value clean editing, thoughtful sequencing, natural motion, and visual quality over flashy effects. If your editing style relies heavily on speed ramps, excessive transitions, or trending effects, this role is probably not the right fit. --- ## Key Responsibilities ### Cinematic Video Editing * Edit premium real estate property films using Adobe Premiere Pro. * Create polished, cinematic videos that showcase each property's lifestyle and character. * Build strong narratives that guide viewers naturally through the home. * Maintain smooth pacing and clean visual flow throughout every project. * Deliver content suitable for luxury residential marketing. ### Storytelling * Select the strongest clips to create an engaging narrative. * Understand how buyers experience a home and edit to match that journey. * Use timing, composition, movement, and music to create emotion. * Highlight the property's best features without making the edit feel rushed. ### Brand Consistency * Learn and maintain our premium editing style. * Ensure every project aligns with our visual identity and brand standards. * Maintain consistency across all client videos. * Create edits that strengthen our reputation as a premiu ---------- dia company. ### Audio & Music * Select music that complements each property. * Edit naturally to the rhythm without over-cutting. * Balance music and ambient audio where appropriate. * Create immersive viewing experiences. ### Colour & Finishing * Apply or refine colour grading to maintain a clean, natural, high-end aesthetic. * Ensure exposure, white balance, and colour remain consistent throughout the edit. * Perform final quality checks before delivery. ### Marketing Awareness * Understand that every video is a marketing tool. * Edit with the goal of increasing engagement and helping properties stand out. * Produce videos suitable for social media, listing websites, and premium brand marketing. --- ## Required Skills * Advanced experience with Adobe Premiere Pro. * Strong understanding of cinematic editing principles. * Excellent storytelling ability. * Experience editing professional real estate videos. * Strong understanding of pacing and rhythm. * Ability to organise projects efficiently. * High attention to detail. * Ability to work quickly without compromising quality. * Strong communication skills. * Ability to accept feedback and continuously improve. --- ## Preferred Experience Experience editing: * Luxury residential properties. * Architectural films. * Interior design content. * Lifestyle and brand videos. * Commercial real estate. * Drone footage. * Gimbal footage. Experience with: * Adobe After Effects (basic titles and motion graphics only). * Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop (an advantage, but not essential). --- ## What We're Looking For We want someone who understands that great editing is often subtle. Our ideal editor: * Thinks like a filmmaker, not just an editor. * Understands how to build emotion through sequencing. * Creates edits that feel intentional and refined. * Values clean, timeless editing over flashy effects. * Takes pride in producing work that clients are excited to share. We are building a premium brand, and every video should reflect that standard. --- ## Success in This Role A successful editor will consistently produce cinematic real estate films that elevate our brand and our clients' properties. They will work efficiently, communicate well, meet deadlines, and deliver videos that combine technical excellence with compelling storytelling.

title: Operations Coordinator
description: Are you the person everyone relies on to keep things running? Do you enjoy solving problems, making decisions, and bringing order to chaos? Do you naturally take ownership instead of waiting for someone else to tell you what to do? If you enjoy organizing people, communicating clearly, and solving real-world operational challenges, we'd love to meet you. Chickadee Cleans is a fast-growing vacation rental cleaning company based in Phoenix, Arizona. We partner with professional property managers and short-term rental owners to keep their homes guest-ready through exceptional cleaning, inspections, communication, and reliability. We're looking for an Operations Coordinator who will become a key part of our leadership team. As the company grows, this role is designed to grow into our Operations Manager position. --- ABOUT THE ROLE Your mission is simple: **Keep the day running smoothly and solve problems before they become emergencies.** You'll coordinate with cleaners, inspectors, property managers, and guests throughout the day to ensure every property is completed on time and to our standards. Every day is different. Some days everything goes according to plan. Other days you'll be balancing schedule changes, cleaner call-outs, client questions, and unexpected challenges—all while keeping everyone informed and moving forward. If you enjoy making decisions, communicating with people, and finding solutions under pressure, you'll likely enjoy this role. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: DAILY OPERATIONS * Coordinate daily cleaning schedules. * Monitor job progress throughout the day. * Resolve scheduling conflicts. * Coordinate backup coverage when unexpected issues arise. * Help ensure every property is completed on time. COMMUNICATION & INBOX MANAGEMENT * Manage the main company inbox, including responding to calls and texts in a timely, professional manner. * Communicate with cleaners and runners throughout the day. * Respond professionally to property managers and clients. * Keep everyone informed when schedules change. * Resolve issues before they become larger problems. * Handle inbound sales inquiries, including holding initial conversations with prospective clients. DECISION MAKING * Make independent decisions using company guidelines. * Prioritize multiple situations happening simultaneously. * Identify solutions rather than waiting for instructions. * Escalate major issues when appropriate. CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT * Maintain accurate notes and operational records. * Help improve systems and processes. * Identify recurring issues and recommend better ways of operating. * During lighter operational periods, you’ll have standing project work to fill your time productively—this may include process documentation, marketing post scheduling, or other initiatives. We’re looking for someone flexible who takes initiative to help the company in whatever way is most useful during down time. --- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR The ideal candidate is someone who: * Naturally takes ownership. * Communicates professionally in written and spoken English. * Remains calm under pressure. * Enjoys solving problems. * Thinks critically before asking for help. * Is highly organized. * Pays close attention to detail. * Learns new software quickly. * Is dependable and responsive—actively engaged for the full scheduled shift, not just waiting for messages to come in. * Wants to grow into a leadership role. As a small attention-to-detail exercise, please include "Yellow Bird" in the subject line of your application. --- PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in one or more of the following is helpful, but not required: * Operations * Dispatch * Logistics * Property management * Customer service * Project coordination * Sales or customer-facing communication You should also have: * Excellent written and spoken English. * A reliable computer and high-speed internet connection. * A quiet workspace. * Experience using Google Workspace. * Comfort learning and working within multiple software platforms. * Willingness to use time-tracking software during work hours. --- SCHEDULE * Full-time * Thursday through Monday * Hours fall within Arizona business hours (approximate window 8:00 AM–6:00 PM Arizona time); exact daily start and end time will be finalized with the selected candidate. * Weekends are our busiest days and are an important part of this position. * Additional paid hours may occasionally be available during holidays, busy seasons, or periods of company growth. * Time-tracking software (e.g., Hubstaff) is required during all scheduled work hours. --- GROWTH OPPORTUNITY This is not intended to remain an entry-level operations position. As you learn our business and demonstrate strong judgment and leadership, you'll take on increasing responsibility with the goal of growing into our Operations Manager. We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with a growing company. --- WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Within your first several months: * Daily operations run smoothly with minimal supervision. * Most operational issues are resolved before management becomes involved. * Cleaners receive timely communication and support. * Clients and prospects receive prompt, professional responses. * Operational processes continue to improve over time. --- APPLICATION QUESTIONS Please include: 1. Your resume. 2. A brief introduction about yourself. 3. Describe a time you successfully managed multiple urgent situations at once. How did you prioritize them? 4. Tell us about a process you improved in a previous role. OPERATIONS SCENARIO Please answer the following question in as much detail as you feel is necessary. Imagine it is **8:15 AM Arizona time**. You are the Operations Coordinator for Chickadee Cleans. All scheduled cleanings are planned to begin at **10:00 AM**. You receive the following information at the same time: * One cleaner calls out sick. * A second cleaner lets you know they will be approximately 45 minutes late. * A property manager asks if one of their homes will be ready for the scheduled **4:00 PM** guest check-in. * A guest requests an early check-in at **2:00 PM**. Walk us through exactly how you would handle the next 30 minutes. Please explain: * Which issue you would address first and why. * What messages or phone calls you would make. * What information you would gather before making decisions. * How you would communicate with the cleaners, the property manager, and the guest. * Any assumptions you make and why. You may not have all of the information you want immediately, so explain what assumptions you would make and how you would verify them. There is no single "correct" answer. We're interested in understanding how you prioritize, communicate, and make decisions when multiple urgent situations happen at once.

title: Expert at Writing Online Dating Profiles (NO AI)
job_title: Expert at Writing Online Dating Profiles (NO AI)
description: Help Men Attract Their Dream Woman Through Exceptional Dating Profile Writing We're looking for an exceptional writer who understands attraction, psychology, storytelling, and online dating at a deep level. This is not traditional copywriting. You won't be writing blog posts, advertisements, sales pages, or social media content. Instead, you'll be crafting high-converting dating profiles for men on Tinder, Hinge, and Bumble. Your job is to transform ordinary information about a client into a profile that immediately captures attention, creates intrigue, sparks attraction, and dramatically increases the likelihood that women swipe right, start conversations, and ultimately agree to dates. What You'll Be Writing For each client, you'll create: Tinder bios Bumble bios Hinge prompts Bumble prompts Tinder profile prompts and profile text Job title optimization Occupation descriptions Profile positioning and messaging Alternative profile variations for testing What Success Looks Like The profiles you write should: Attract the specific type of woman the client wants to meet Differentiate the client from thousands of other men Create curiosity and emotional engagement Encourage women to swipe right Encourage women to message first whenever possible Make conversations start positively from the very first message Create a natural pathway toward meeting in person Feel authentic, natural, and completely aligned with the client's personality The goal is not simply to write something funny or clever. The goal is to strategically position the client so women are excited to match with him before a conversation even begins. Who We're Looking For You may be a great fit if: You have extensive experience writing dating profiles You deeply understand male-female attraction dynamics You understand what women actually respond to on dating apps You can write in multiple styles and personalities You know how to create intrigue without sounding try-hard You can make a profile feel confident, attractive, and authentic You are an excellent interviewer and can quickly understand a client's personality You have strong attention to detail You consistently produce original work Non-Negotiable Requirements ABSOLUTELY NO AI-GENERATED WRITING This role is for a genuine writer. We are not looking for someone who generates content using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Jasper, or any other AI writing tool. Every profile must be written from scratch by a human. We have extensive experience reviewing dating profiles and can immediately identify content that feels AI-generated. If there is even the slightest indication that AI was used to write, heavily assist, or generate any part of the profile, your application will be rejected immediately and you will no longer be considered for future work. We are specifically looking for writers who can produce original, natural, human-sounding content that reflects real personality, emotional intelligence, and nuanced social understanding. To Apply Please submit: A brief introduction about yourself Any experience writing dating profiles, personal branding content, or similar work Follow these steps: 1. Open our Fulfillment Team Tracker: ---------- /spreadsheets/d/140BpHakCi0MkYrmsq2MWy9v70wPefTVQ__aWCR2Cxhg/edit?usp=sharing 2. Pick one of our clients. Using the information the clients provided about themselves, write a Tinder/Bumble bio and 3 Hinge prompts. (If the client did not provide relevant info, just make up one.) The three Hinge prompts should start with... a. "Together we could... "*insert here the romantic date idea. Be very specific about the details on the date (eg. location, what you're doing during the date) and use vivid imagery to make them visualise what it's like to go on a date with our male client. For example, "Together we could...watch the sunset over a glass of wine at the beach, and talk about our biggest dreams and fears." b. My humble brag is/My greatest strength is.. *insert here what they are good at. Ideally, it would be something that could be related to the girl. For example, if a client works in sales, you can say "My humble brag is...I can convince you do whatever I want ;)". Another example: "My humble brag is...I'm essentially an expert in female psychology. " c. The way to win me over is/Win me over by... *insert here a quality (that is not about her looks) that the client wants from his dream girl. The purpose of this prompt is to convey that he has standards, that he won't be satisfied with just any random girl, and to make the woman qualify or prove that she, in fact, possesses the qualities he desires. For example... "The way to win me over is...being able to cook me a nice ribeye with a cheeky kiss on the cheek." The prompts should be fun, flirty, playful. It should focus on ONE key idea and elaborate on that one idea as opposed to listing different things. There should be no repetition of words or ideas in different parts of the profile. It should make the woman excited to get to know our male client and ideally make them want to go out with them on a date. Avoid generic lines, clichés, and recycled dating-app tropes. We are looking for someone who can become a long-ter ---------- mber of our team and help our clients achieve exceptional results on Tinder, Hinge, and Bumble.

Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement. • Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders. MUST-HAVES • Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes. • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines. • Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually. • Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats. • Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats). • Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism. • Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours. BONUS SKILLS • Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs. • Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics. • Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video). • Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow. • Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats. title: Senior Video Editor
description: *** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! *** *** About the Role *** If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it! Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals. This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals. If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading. *** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP *** To succeed here, you need to live these three values: Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision. Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team. Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable. *** Role Overview *** You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress. The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client. *** Core Responsibilities *** Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project. Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes. Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency. Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals. Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product. Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers. Team Growth and Standards: Help grow our junior editors and improve how we work. You will share what you know, give clear feedback on their edits, and streamline our editing practices, templates, and workflows so the whole team moves faster and more consistently. Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here. *** Required Qualifications *** Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats. Software: High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results. Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows. RAW Workflow (Required): Proven, hands-on experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. This is a senior role, so we expect you to own complex, high-resolution RAW workflows from day one. Leadership and Process: You can mentor less-experienced editors, give clear and useful feedback, and tighten how the team works. You make the people and the process around you better, not just your own edits. Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume. Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress. *** Bonus / Preferred Skills *** - Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar) - Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers - Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content - Familiarity with ---------- or structured feedback workflows - Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects *** Compensation *** Hourly Rate: $8.00 to $15.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill. This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability. Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $1,280 to $2,400 USD per month (about 78,000 to 146,000 PHP). Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $640 to $1,200 USD per month (about 39,000 to 73,000 PHP). [*Conversions are approximate.] *** A Note on AI and Judgment *** At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt. If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now. *** How to Apply *** Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job. - Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]" - Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP). - Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration. - State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section. - In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff. - Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only. - We expect senior applicants to record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. It is not a hard requirement, but at this level skipping it is a missed opportunity. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include it move to the top of the list. Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

title: Enrollment Specialist
description: OUR MISSION Colure Health’s mission is to deliver reliable, patient?centered care that improves health outcomes through consistency, compassion, and disciplined operational excellence. We believe that if we can save one life, then the work is worth it. Every employee plays a role in building the systems, relationships, and trust that make high?quality longitudinal care possible. ABOUT COLURE HEALTH & THE ROLE Colure Health operates the Mozaiq Care+ platform, which includes post-discharge outreach and ongoing care-management programs — Transitional Care Management (TCM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and Behavioral Health Integration (BHI) — for health-system partners including NYC Health + Hospitals. The Enrollment Specialist is the first point of contact in the patient journey: working from provider and discharge patient lists, the Specialist identifies eligible patients, verifies their information and insurance, obtains consent, and completes enrollment in Mozaiq Care+ before handing the case to a Care Coordinator for post-discharge outreach. This role supports U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours. Because the Philippines is roughly 12–13 hours ahead of ET, scheduled shifts fall overnight in Philippine local time; the legally required night-shift differential applies to hours worked between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM Philippine time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Review provider and discharge patient lists (PCP panels, specialist rosters, and hospital discharge census) to identify patients who may qualify for Colure Health’s Mozaiq Care+ care-management programs: Transitional Care Management (TCM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and Behavioral Health Integration (BHI). • Make first contact with each identified patient — ahead of the Care Coordinator’s outreach call — to introduce Colure Health and explain the relevant program in clear, plain-language terms. • Verify all information needed to enroll the patient: identity, demographics, insurance/payer details and coverage, caregiver contacts, and program-specific eligibility criteria (qualifying diagnosis, time-since-discharge window, and similar requirements). • Obtain and accurately document verbal or written patient consent prior to enrollment, consistent with program and payer requirements. • Set the patient up in Mozaiq Care+: create or update the patient record, confirm insurance and eligibility, and complete enrollment intake so the case is fully ready before hand-off. • Hand off each verified, enrolled patient to a Care Coordinator with complete, accurate notes so the post-discharge outreach call can move directly into the safety screen and scheduling conversation without re-asking for information already collected. • For Remote Patient Monitoring enrollments, coordinate device shipment and walk the patient or caregiver through setup, expectations, and basic troubleshooting. • Resolve enrollment barriers — consent hesitation, distrust, language, confusion about cost or insurance — using an Acknowledge – Reframe – Solve – Close approach. • Maintain accurate, audit-ready enrollment, insurance-verification, consent, and disenrollment/opt-out records in Mozaiq Care+. • Use qualified interpreter support and caregiver-permission protocols for limited-English-proficiency, elderly, and caregiver-involved patients, consistent with Colure Health standards. • Track personal list-to-enrollment conversion metrics and participate in regular call review and QA coaching. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • Excellent spoken and written English (C1 / near-native); Tagalog or another Philippine language is a plus but not required, since calls are conducted in English. • High school diploma or equivalent; coursework or experience in healthcare administration, insurance, or care management is a plus. • 6+ months of experience in a contact-center, healthcare-enrollment, insurance, or patient-facing administrative role. • Comfortable explaining program benefits and consent requirements clearly, accurately, and without overstating what a program guarantees. • Strong active listening and rapport-building skills; able to work through hesitation or confusion about enrollment without applying pressure. • Solid computer literacy and the ability to accurately enter and verify demographic, insurance, and consent data in Mozaiq Care+. • High attention to detail; enrollment and consent records must be accurate and audit-ready. • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet distraction-free workspace, and equipment suitable for handling sensitive health and insurance information. • Available to work scheduled shifts within the role’s Eastern Time (ET) operating window. • Able to pass a background check and complete HIPAA / PHI-handling training prior to handling live patient enrollments. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Prior experience with Transitional Care Management, Chronic Care Management, Remote Patient Monitoring, or Behavioral Health Integration programs. • Experience with insurance verification, eligibility checking, or medical billing basics. • Familiarity with EHR, CRM, or care-management enrollment platforms, including reviewing provider panels or patient rosters. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • List-to-enrollment conversion rate among patients identified from provider and discharge lists as program-eligible. • Insurance-verification and consent and intake documentation accuracy and completeness in Mozaiq Care+. • RPM device activation and successful setup rate, where applicable. • Zero compliance incidents: no enrollment completed without valid consent, no clinical advice given, no overstated program claims. • Turnaround time from patient-list review to verified enrollment and hand-off to a Care Coordinator. WHAT COLURE HEALTH OFFERS • Full paid training on Mozaiq Care+ care-management programs (TCM, CCM, RPM, BHI), consent requirements, and the Mozaiq Care+ platform before handling live enrollments. • Remote, work-from-home role with a defined, consistent shift schedule. • Ongoing coaching and QA feedback from a dedicated Enrollment Program Manager. • Career growth path within Colure Health’s care-management organization. ROLE BOUNDARIES & COMPLIANCE Enrollment Specialists are not clinicians. Enrollment Specialists do not diagnose, provide clinical advice, or make final care-eligibility determinations on their own judgment — clinical eligibility is confirmed by Colure Health’s clinical team. Their job is to work the provider/discharge list accurately, explain programs clearly, verify insurance and consent, and complete enrollment so the Care Coordinator can move straight into safety screening and scheduling. title: AI Ad Videos Specialist
description: Read This Before You Apply! This role is NOT for someone who is just getting started with AI video tools or still learning the basics. We work with paying clients whose businesses depend on real ad performance. If you cannot point to specific campaigns you have directly contributed to — with real results — please do not apply. We respect your time and ask that you respect ours. About This Opportunity We are a growing performance creative agency that helps e-commerce and direct-response brands scale their paid advertising on Meta and TikTok. Our core value proposition is simple: we give clients the creative firepower — volume, speed, and strategy — that their in-house teams can't match. We are building an elite team of AI-powered creative specialists who can produce high-converting ad creatives at scale. We are not hiring a video editor. We are not hiring someone to make things look pretty. We are hiring someone who understands why ads work and can use AI tools to produce, test, and iterate on those ads faster than any traditional production team. The Role: As our AI Ad Video Creative Specialist, you will be responsible for producing scroll-stopping video ad creatives that are engineered to convert. You will work directly from creative briefs that specify the target audience, offer, desired hook angles, and performance benchmarks. Your job is to translate those briefs into finished video ads — and to bring your own creative intelligence to the process. This is not a set-it-and-forget-it role. The best performers here will be proactive about suggesting new angles, flagging creative fatigue early, and thinking about why something did or did not perform — not just executing and delivering files. What You Will Do: Produce 15–40 video ad variations per client per month using AI-assisted production workflows Develop multiple hook variations for each core offer (different emotional angles, formats, and openings) Work from direct response briefs and translate them into finished, platform-ready ad creatives (Meta Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts formats) Maintain strict brand guidelines while pushing creative variety Deliver creatives with clear naming conventions tied to hook angle and target audience for easy split testing Participate in performance review sessions — you must be able to look at CTR and ROAS data and draw intelligent creative conclusions from it Recommend creative iterations based on what is and is not working in the data Turn around revisions quickly and without friction --- Non-Negotiable: Every applicant must be able to demonstrate all of the following. If you cannot, please do not apply. Requirements and What We Mean: | Proven AI video ad production:- You have used tools like Runway, Kling, Pika, HeyGen, CapCut AI, or equivalent to produce finished ad creatives — not experiments or personal projects, but real ads for real clients or brands. | Direct response marketing understanding:- You know what a hook is and why the first 3 seconds determine everything. You understand offers, CTAs, and the difference between brand awareness and performance creative. | Portfolio of real ad creatives:- You can show us finished video ads you have made — ideally with context on what they were trying to achieve and what happened when they ran. | Platform-specific formatting knowledge | You know the difference between a Meta Reel creative and a TikTok ad creative. You understand aspect ratios, caption placement, and what gets ads flagged. | Basic ad metrics literacy:- You know what CTR, CPM, ROAS, and hook rate mean and can discuss them intelligently without needing an explanation. | Reliable delivery and communication | You meet deadlines. You communicate proactively if something is delayed. YOU DO NOT DISAPPEAR! Ideal Background: We are not asking for a degree or a specific job title. We are looking for evidence of capability. The following backgrounds tend to produce the strongest applicants: Freelance performance creative producer Media buyer or paid social specialist who also produces their own creatives UGC content creator who has made the pivot into direct response and ad production Creative strategist at a digital marketing or performance agency Independent video producer specialising in e-commerce or DTC brand ads What matters far more than your background is your portfolio and your answers to the application questions below. --- Tools & Tech: You should already be proficient in at least several of the following. We are not going to train you on these tools — you should come ready to use them. AI video generation: Runway Gen-3, Kling, Pika, Luma Dream Machine, or equivalent AI voiceover / lip sync: HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Captions.ai, or equivalent Video editing: CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, or equivalent Scriptwriting and hook ideation: Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent Static ad support: Canva, Adobe Express, Photoshop (for thumbnail frames and overlays) File management and delivery: Google Drive, Dropbox, Notion, or equivalent --- Compensation: Pay is competitive and commensurate with your experience and output quality. Structure: Project-based or monthly retainer depending on workload and fit. Rate: Discussed during the interview process based on your portfolio and capacity. Availability: We prioritise candidates who can commit to consistent weekly output, not one-off projects. Location: Fully remote. All time zones considered. --- How to Apply: Read every word of this section. The application process is intentionally selective. We are looking for people who follow instructions precisely, communicate clearly, and take the work seriously. The application itself is the first test. Step 1 — Do NOT send a CV or resume We do not want your CV. We do not care where you went to school or what your job titles have been. We care about what you can actually produce. A CV will not help your application — it may hurt it. Step 2 — Gather Your Top 3 Video Ad Creatives Select the three video ad creatives you are most proud of. These should be finished ads — not demo reels, not mood boards, not personal content. Real ads, made for a real product or client. For each creative, prepare the following: A direct link to the video (YouTube unlisted, Vimeo, Google Drive, Dropbox — no download-gated links) One sentence on what the ad was trying to do (product, audience, goal) One sentence on what tools you used to produce it Any performance data you are able to share (optional but valued) Step 3 — Answer These Questions in Your Email Copy these questions into your email and answer each one directly. Do not write an essay. Be specific and direct. Vague answers will not progress. 1. Describe your current AI video production workflow from brief to final file. What tools do you use at each stage? 2. What is the biggest mistake you see other AI video creators make when producing ad creatives? Why does it matter? 3. A client's ad creative is getting a strong thumb-stop rate (hook rate above 35%) but a poor click-through rate. What does that tell you, and what would you change? 4. What is the maximum number of finished video ad variations you could produce in a week if given a detailed creative brief, assuming you were working on this full-time? 5. Give one example of a creative decision you made — a hook angle, a format choice, a structural element — that you believe directly improved an ad's performance. Be specific. Step 4 — The Email Begin your email with the words: CREATIVE FIRST. This tells us you read the full posting. Applications that do not begin with these exact words will be deleted without being read, regardless of the quality of the work inside. Send your application to: everythingagencyhq at gmail dot com (remove the spaces inbetween and use the correct address) Subject line: AI Ad Video Specialist Your email should contain: The words CREATIVE FIRST at the very beginning Your three video ad creative links with the required context for each Your answers to all five questions above Your general availability and weekly capacity Your preferred rate or range (optional at this stage) What Happens Next We review every application that follows these instructions. If your work and answers stand out, we will reach out to schedule a short video call. Strong applicants may be offered a test project before any ongoing engagement is confirmed. We believe in evaluating people on real work, not interviews alone. One Final Note: We are building something serious and we are looking for someone who is equally serious about this craft. If you have been producing AI-powered ad creatives, staying close to what performs, and thinking like a marketer — this is the kind of work you will thrive in. If this is something you have been casually experimenting with, this is not the right fit yet. We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Care Coordinator
description: OUR MISSION Colure Health’s mission is to deliver reliable, patient?centered care that improves health outcomes through consistency, compassion, and disciplined operational excellence. We believe that if we can save one life, then the work is worth it. Every employee plays a role in building the systems, relationships, and trust that make high?quality longitudinal care possible. ABOUT COLURE HEALTH & THE ROLE Colure Health operates the Mozaiq Care+ platform and runs post-discharge care-continuity outreach for patients discharged from NYC Health + Hospitals facilities. The goal is simple: close the gap between hospital discharge and the patient’s next real appointment. The Care Coordinator is a care-access closer, not a salesperson. Patients typically arrive already identified, verified, and enrolled by an Enrollment Specialist, so the Coordinator can move straight into the safety screen and scheduling conversation. Every completed, safe call ends with a booked PCP, specialist, or telehealth appointment, or a clearly owned same-day safety action — a pleasant conversation with no scheduled next step is not a successful call. This role supports U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours. Because the Philippines is roughly 12–13 hours ahead of ET, scheduled shifts fall overnight in Philippine local time; the legally required night-shift differential applies to hours worked between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM Philippine time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Place outbound, post-discharge calls to patients recently discharged from NYC Health + Hospitals facilities (Bellevue, Elmhurst, Kings County, Lincoln, Metropolitan, and Woodhull), following Colure Health’s Care Continuity Outreach Playbook call flow: Verify – Safety – Reason – Path – Barrier – Close – Document. • Verify patient identity (name and date of birth) and confirm permission before discussing care details with a caregiver or family member. • Run the safety screen on every call to surface emergency or same-day clinical issues before scheduling; immediately direct patients to 911 or 988 and stop routine scheduling when a red-flag symptom is reported. • Determine the correct follow-up pathway — PCP, specialist, telehealth fast-track, or same-day clinical escalation — and close every reachable, safe call with a booked appointment as the primary outcome. • Identify and resolve real-time barriers to care (transportation, language, childcare, work conflicts, cost concerns, distrust) using the zero-barrier approach; no referral form or insurance question is used as a reason to delay scheduling. • Offer immediate PCP assignment to patients who do not have, or have lost contact with, a primary care provider. • Apply the Acknowledge – Reframe – Solve – Close objection-handling framework to move hesitant patients toward a scheduled next step. • Receive each patient after an Enrollment Specialist has already reviewed the provider/discharge list, verified eligibility and insurance, obtained consent, and set the patient up in Mozaiq Care+ — using that completed intake to move straight into the safety screen and scheduling conversation instead of re-collecting information. • Document every call outcome in Mozaiq Care+ using the required outcome code (appointment booked, next step assigned, unable to reach, refused, same-day escalation, or emergency escalation) along with barrier, urgency, owner, deadline, permission status, and next action. • Adapt scripts for elderly, limited-English-proficiency, behavioral-health, and caregiver-involved patients, and for those enrolled in MLTC, FIDA, or PACE plans, using qualified interpreter support where needed. • Meet quality and productivity standards measured against the Manager QA Scorecard (opening and trust, privacy and permission, safety screen, pathway accuracy, barrier resolution, conversion close, documentation, and role boundaries). REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • Excellent spoken and written English (C1 / near-native); Tagalog or another Philippine language is a plus but not required, since calls are conducted in English. • High school diploma or equivalent; coursework or experience in healthcare, customer service, or call-center operations is a plus. • 6+ months of experience in a contact-center, customer-service, healthcare-support, or patient-facing role. • Comfortable following a structured call script while adapting naturally to real, sometimes difficult, patient conversations. • Strong active listening, empathy, and de-escalation skills; able to stay calm with anxious, confused, or distrustful patients. • Basic computer literacy and the ability to navigate a documentation platform (Mozaiq Care+) while talking with a patient. • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet distraction-free workspace, and equipment suitable for handling sensitive health information. • Available to work scheduled shifts within the role’s Eastern Time (ET) operating window, including rotating evening or Saturday shifts. • Able to pass a background check and complete HIPAA / PHI-handling training prior to taking live patient calls. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Prior experience in a healthcare, medical office, insurance, or care-management call-center environment. • Familiarity with EHR, scheduling, or care-management platforms. • Experience working U.S. healthcare accounts or supporting U.S.-based patients. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Appointment-booked rate — the primary metric: every safe, reachable call ends in a scheduled PCP, specialist, or telehealth visit, or a documented same-day safety action. • Average Manager QA Scorecard score (100-point rubric covering opening/trust, privacy, safety screen, pathway accuracy, barrier resolution, conversion close, documentation, and role boundaries). • Zero automatic-fail incidents: no medication advice given, no false reassurance, no missed red-flag symptom, no unauthorized PHI disclosure. • Documentation completeness and accuracy in Mozaiq Care+ on every call. WHAT COLURE HEALTH OFFERS • Full paid training on the Care Continuity Outreach Playbook, safety-escalation protocols, and the Mozaiq Care+ platform before taking live calls. • Remote, work-from-home role with a defined, consistent shift schedule. • Ongoing call coaching and QA feedback from a dedicated supervisor. • Career growth path within Colure Health’s care-management organization, including pathways into Enrollment Specialist and senior coordinator roles. ROLE BOUNDARIES & COMPLIANCE Care Coordinators are not clinicians. Care Coordinators do not diagnose, clear symptoms, give medication advice, or tell a patient they are “fine.” Their job is to screen for safety, remove barriers, and get the patient to the right appointment or escalation — every call ends with a documented next step. description: We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the health niche, focused on building high-converting video ads for Meta. We sell bamboo compression products — knee sleeves, ankle braces, gloves and socks — primarily targeting customers aged 50+ across European markets. Our flagship product, DailyCompress, is a breathable bamboo knee sleeve with one key difference: it's designed to be worn through the night. Here's why that matters. While you sleep, blood flow to the knee slows right down — so the joint stays stiff, swells, and never fully recovers, which is exactly why mornings feel so painful and stiff. DailyCompress applies gentle, even compression all night long to keep circulation going, flush out fluid and waste, and ease swelling and inflammation while you rest. You wake up with a more supple, less painful knee. On top of that: a perfect fit for every body and a sleeve that genuinely stays in place — for a group of people most braces were never designed for, and never designed to be worn in bed. What we're really after (please read this carefully) This is the most important part of the role, so we'll be direct about it. Our biggest growth opportunity sits at the very top of the funnel — with cold, "unaware" and "problem-aware" audiences. These are people who feel knee pain and stiffness every single day, but who don't yet know what's actually causing it, and who have often never been diagnosed with anything. By far, this is our largest audience. That means our ads can't open by shouting "arthritis." The ---------- nt we name a diagnosis, we shrink our reach to the small group that already self-identifies. Instead, our best-performing ads: - Lead with a felt symptom or a relatable everyday ---------- nt (that first stiff step out of bed) - Reframe the problem by revealing a hidden cause the viewer never connected the dots on - Then bridge naturally to the solution, the proof, and the offer So we are specifically looking for an editor who can build long-form, top-of-funnel storytelling ads that educate and reframe — not just conversion edits for warm traffic. Our videos are getting longer, not shorter. The ability to hold a cold viewer's attention for 2–4+ minutes is the single most valuable skill you can bring to this role. This is a senior role — we are not looking for a beginner. We need an experienced editor who has already made videos exactly like this and can prove it, not someone still learning the craft on the job. description: About the Role We are an Australian-based private lender seeking a highly detail-oriented Loan Data Analyst with experience working alongside credit decisioning frameworks or rule books. This role goes beyond basic data review — you will play a key part in structuring financial data in line with credit policy, ensuring our assessors can make fast, consistent, and responsible lending decisions. Key Responsibilities • Review and analyse customer bank transaction data (last 90 days) • Categorise income, expenses, and liabilities in line with internal credit rules • Apply and interpret credit policy / rulebook guidelines to real customer data • Identify financial behaviours such as: Gambling activity BNPL usage Payday lending / wage advances Overdraft reliance • Prepare clear, structured summaries aligned to decisioning requirements • Flag inconsistencies, risks, or policy breaches for escalation • Support continuous improvement of credit rules and data structuring processes • Maintain strict privacy, confidentiality, and data handling standards What We’re Looking For • Experience working with credit rulebooks, decisioning frameworks, or lending policies • Background in lending, fintech, credit risk, or financial data analysis • Strong understanding of: Income verification Expense analysis Liability assessment Responsible lending principles • Proven ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and risk indicators in transaction data • High attention to detail and structured thinking • Ability to follow and apply rules consistently (not just interpret data) • Strong written English and ability to present clear, logical summaries Important – Privacy & Data Handling You will be working with sensitive financial data. description: Majestix Collection is a premier destination for buying, selling, and trading luxury timepieces. We're looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper to accurately record every transaction that moves through our inventory — from the price we pay for a watch, through reconditioning and shipping, to the final sale and commission calculations. This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys clean, accurate records and can follow a defined system without cutting corners. You'll be the single source of truth for our numbers, so precision and trustworthiness matter more than speed. What you'll do 1. Record what we pay for each watch Every watch enters through our Sell/Trade form, which automatically feeds into our MJX Sales Tracker (Google Sheets) under the "Submit and Shoot" tab. A thread is created for each watch in Zoho Cliq, where the amount paid is usually posted as a screenshot. You'll be tagged when a value is ready to record, and you'll log the purchase price in the correct row. 2. Record Shipping, reconditioning and parts costs When a watch is received and kept (not returned to the seller): Move its row from the "Submit and Shoot" tab into the "Stock and Sold" tab, placing it above the "Sold" section. Log the ship-in cost (we'll provide a rate sheet based on distance and insured value of the package). Log polish, service, and parts costs. Document what each cost is for using cell comments. When a single cost is made up of multiple components, use a formula (e.g. =value1+value2+value3) and describe each component in the cell comment. 3. Record the sale When a watch sells, the final numbers come from the platform invoice (eBay, Chrono24) or our own customer invoice — found in the sales thread (Zoho Cliq) or under Payments > Invoices. In the same row, record the initial amount we were paid. Record every fee involved in the sale — taxes, shipping, additional parts, platform fees, and so on. 4. Calculate the commisions Using the recorded numbers, calculate commissions for each tea ---------- mber — both in the MJX Sales Tracker and in each employee's personal commission sheet. This part of the role requires independence and discretion. You'll work directly with leadership and stay separate from the sales team, with no outside influence on the numbers. You'll have access to sensitive compensation data, so confidentiality and neutrality are non-negotiable. What we're looking for: Meticulous attention to detail and a genuine love for accurate, organized records Comfortable in Google Sheets — formulas, cell comments, and structured multi-tab workbooks Trustworthy and discreet; able to handle confidential financial and compensation data Able to follow a defined workflow consistently and flag anything that doesn't add up An independent worker who can stay objective and neutral Nice to have: Bookkeeping or accounting background Experience with Zoho Books or QuickBooks Familiarity with Zoho Cliq Experience with e-commerce or marketplace sales (eBay, Chrono24) To apply, please send the following. title: Job Title  CRM Systems Assistant / Data Migration & Optimization Specialist (Fast-Paced, Builder Mindset Required)
job_title: Job Title  CRM Systems Assistant / Data Migration & Optimization Specialist (Fast-Paced, Builder Mindset Required)
description: Here is the **fully merged, clean, high-level job post** with everything integrated, structured, and professional. You can copy/paste this **as-is** to Upwork, LinkedIn, Indeed, or send directly to candidates. --- ## **Job Title** **CRM Systems Assistant / Data Migration & Optimization Specialist (Fast-Paced, Builder Mindset Required)** --- ## **Overview** We are migrating from an old CRM into a newly built CRM and are looking for a **high-caliber systems assistant** to handle **data transfer, structure optimization, and system improvement**. This is **not a basic assistant or data-entry role**. You must think like a **builder and operator**, not just a task follower. Your responsibility is to ensure data is transferred **accurately**, **organized intelligently**, and **structured in a way that supports analytics, automation, and scale**. Speed matters. Precision matters more. --- ## **Core Responsibilities** * Transfer data from old CRM systems and Excel/CSV files into a new CRM * Ensure correct field mapping, relationships, and data integrity * Identify: * Missing fields * Inefficient structures * Redundant or unclear data * Gaps that limit analytics or automation * Recommend and implement improvements that increase: * Efficiency * Clarity * Scalability * Reporting accuracy * Maintain organized documentation of changes and decisions * Ensure CRM data is clean, usable, and visually organized * Communicate clearly and consistently on progress and issues --- ## **Required Skills & Mindset** ### **CRM & Systems Thinking** * Strong experience working with CRMs (any major platform) * Thinks in **systems, workflows, and structure** * Understands how CRM data feeds: * Dashboards * KPIs * Automation * Decision-making * Able to spot what’s **missing**, not just move what exists ### **Advanced Excel & Data Precision** * Must know how to **transfer, clean, and structure Excel/CSV sheets** * Extreme attention to detail — accuracy is non-negotiable * Able to organize information in a way that is: * Logical * Clean * Aesthetically clear * Understands how spreadsheet structure impacts CRM performance ### **Systems Operator & Daily Optimization** * Able to **run a system**, not just work inside one * Understands scalability and continuous improvement * Proactively identifies inefficiencies **daily** * Maintains: * Organized daily output * Clear task tracking * Consistent system hygiene * Fluent in structured workflows and disciplined execution ### **AI & Communication Systems** * Experience with: * AI calling systems * Automated texting * Email campaigns * Able to: * Organize communication flows * Track results * Manage statistics and performance metrics * Report outcomes clearly * Understands how communication tools integrate with CRM data ### **Supplier & Operations Communication** * Maintain professional, organized communication with suppliers and partners * Track conversations, follow-ups, and outcomes inside the CRM * Ensure no information is lost or mismanaged ### **Eye for Expansion** * Notices patterns, gaps, and growth opportunities * Thinks beyond the current structure * Makes recommendations that improve: * Scalability * Visibility * Efficiency * Understands how today’s decisions affect future growth --- ## **What This Role Is NOT** * Not a basic VA role * Not slow, micromanaged work * Not “do only what’s written” execution If you only move data without thinking critically, this role is not a fit. --- ## **Project Expectations** * Immediate start * Fast execution with high accuracy * Clear communication * Ownership mentality * Results over excuse How to Apply To apply, include ALL of the following (applications missing any item will not be reviewed): A brief summary of your CRM, data migration, and systems experience One example where you improved, optimized, or restructured a system (even a small improvement counts) Confirmation that you can work fast, accurately, and independently Your WhatsApp number (international format preferred) for direct communication Candidates who pass the initial review will receive a short test task to validate systems thinking, speed, and execution quality. --- ## **Important Note** This role protects and strengthens a growing system. We are looking for someone who takes pride in **order, structure, and results**.

title: Meta ads editor
description: VIDEO EDITOR (META ADS) Remote • Contract to Monthly Retainer BEFORE YOU APPLY It is important to fully understand who we are, where we stand, and the standard we hold before you move forward. This is not for everyone. We hire editors who hold a high standard, work fast, and want to build something real with a team that is scaling. We move fast and we expect you to keep up. The editors who thrive here want volume, real money, and work they are proud of. Before we tell you what the role looks like, here is who we are. WHO WE ARE Launch OS is the marketing engine behind high-ticket coaches, consultants, and other service based companies doing $150k to $800k+ per month. We are a done-for-you marketing partner. We take full ownership of our clients' growth: paid ads, full-funnel builds, CRM and automation, email and SMS, webinars, challenges, and the creative that fuels all of it. Our entire system runs on one framework, the Modern Marketing Method: Offer, Leads, Sales, Fulfillment. Video ads sit at the front of that machine. They are the first thing a prospect sees, and they decide whether the rest of the system ever gets a chance to work. That is where you come in. The ads you edit go straight in front of paying clients' audiences and directly create their revenue. In a nutshell, we build predictable ad engines for our clients, and high-quality edits are an important part of making sure those ads convert. OUR MISSION Bring the good guys back. The businesses built on ethics and grit, the ones who do things right but still get overlooked while louder, shadier operators cut corners. Those are the people we fight for, because business can be both ethical and wildly profitable. OUR CORE VALUES Simplicity is Sophistication The smartest solution is usually the simplest one. Anyone can make things complicated. It takes real skill to make them simple. One of Zero Say what others can't and do what others won't. Authenticity Wins People smell bullshit from a mile away. Just be real. Resourcefulness Not Resources "I don't know" is never an answer. Use the tools at your disposal. Get it done. Obsess Over Value + Extreme Ownership Make people's lives better. Own every result, good or bad. Always ask: "How does this help them?" No Boring S*** Life's too short for boring ideas. If it doesn't spark something in you, why should anyone else care? WHO THIS IS FOR • An editor who lives and breathes short-form vertical video ads built for Meta (Facebook and Instagram) • Someone who can edit 20 ads in 48 to 72 hours while keeping the quality high • Someone who keeps edits engaging and simple. Over-editing kills ads • Someone who uses AI to speed up the work and knows the difference between a clean edit and AI slop WHAT WE EXPECT • Edit scroll-stopping Meta video ads that hold attention from the first frame • Know music and sound design. The right track, clean audio, and background levels that sit properly under a voiceover • Know b-roll and motion graphics. When to use them, how long to hold them on screen, and when to leave them out. Motion should serve the message • Build engaging cuts and pacing that feel intentional. Tight, clean, and easy to follow • Zero spelling errors. Captions and on-screen text get checked every single time OUR STANDARD ON AI • AI is allowed where it genuinely helps • No Remotion plus Claude editing. Edits are done manually • Anything that looks like AI slop does not ship THE BASICS • Timeliness. You hit deadlines without being chased • Self-sufficient with strong time management • Detail-oriented. You catch the small things before we do • Fast, clear communication • You take full ownership. You own your misses and improve fast NON-NEGOTIABLES • Hit every deadline, every time • Do what you say you are going to do • No spelling or text errors in delivered work • Manual editing, no AI slop • Show up prepared and communicate fast • Do not do the minimum HOW THIS WORKS We do not hire off a resume. We hire off the work. Step 1: The Paid Trial Edit We send you one unedited ad. You edit it and return it within a 24-hour turnaround. This is paid (see below). We are watching for speed, quality judgment, and attention to detail. Step 2: The Paid Engagement If the trial edit is done properly, we move straight into a paid engagement, starting with a batch of 20 to 30 video ads to edit. From there it becomes an ongoing monthly relationship based on volume and performance. WHAT IS INCLUDED • The written script for the video ad • The raw footage of the ad • Examples of quality ads our current team has done WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Timeliness • A real understanding of what quality looks like • Highly engaging edits that stay simple, clean, and intentional • No spelling errors • Someone detail-oriented who knows how to create cuts and edits that hold attention PAY • $50 for the single trial edit • After the trial, $1,500 to $3,500 per month depending on total volume The better and faster you are, the more volume comes your way, and the more you make. The work is steady, the team is scaling, and you can do all of it from anywhere. HOW TO APPLY We will be hiring off the work, not the resume. When you apply, include the following: • A link to your portfolio or reel, leading with the short-form vertical video ads you have edited for Meta (Facebook and Instagram) • 2 to 3 direct links to individual ads you edited, with one line on each explaining exactly what you did • The software and tools you edit in • Your honest turnaround on a single ad, and whether you can hold 20 ads in a 48 to 72 hour window without the quality slipping • One line on how you use AI in your workflow To confirm you read this whole post, start your message with the word "Greenlight" and tell us one thing in your editing process that you refuse to compromise on, no matter the deadline. Applications with spelling errors, or missing the word "Greenlight," will not be reviewed.

title: Ecommerce sales rep/customer service
description: Hiring: Inside Sales & Customer Support Rep (Remote, Full-Time, High-Ticket Ecommerce) Hi everyone, Facundo here. I run two small US e-commerce stores: one in commercial water and hydration systems (drinking fountains and bottle refill stations), and one in outdoor power and forestry equipment (log splitters, wood chippers, attachments). I'm looking for one friendly, English-fluent person to be the voice of both stores on live chat, email , and phone. The heart of the job is sales: helping people feel confident making a high-ticket purchase, guiding them to the right product, preparing quotes, and following up so we don't lose them. One store is established with a light, steady flow of inquiries. The other is new and growing fast, with strong projections for this year and next. You'd start by covering both because volume is low. As we grow, you'll focus on just one. A few honest things up front: - The workload is light right now. Think around two live chats and a couple of calls per store per day, plus preparing quotes. - You'll have real downtime, especially the first month but you will use this time to learn about the products and systems. The best people use it to follow up on open quotes and abandoned carts, because that's where the commission is. This role rewards initiative, not clock-watching. - The questions are mostly simple: order status, "which model fits my needs," basic product questions. Some technical ones come in. At first you'll pass those to me; over time you'll handle most yourself. Because the products are high-ticket (orders from hundreds to several thousand dollars), the one thing that really matters is clear, confident, natural English on the phone. You're helping people feel comfortable making a real purchase. That's the job. What you'll do: - Help customers pick the right product, answer their questions, and close the sale - Prepare and send quotes, then follow up on them by call and email - Recover abandoned checkouts by reaching out before the lead goes cold - Answer inbound live chats, email s, and phone calls for both stores - Call customers after delivery to check in and ask for a Trustpilot review - Handle the occasional refund, warranty, or shipping question (these are rare) - Keep simple notes updated in the CRM and pass anything technical to me (at first) - Light Shopify tasks as you settle in (optional) Required: - Sales experience (any role where you helped someone d ---------- to buy) - Customer service experience -Sales experience - Strong, natural spoken English and a great attitude (just as important as the experience) Strongly preferred: - Shopify experience (admin, orders, fulfillment) - Experience selling higher-priced or considered purchases, not just fast retail Compensation: $600 to $800+/month (base + uncapped commission) - Base: $600/month at 40 hrs/week - Commission: 0.4% - 1% of every sale you help close through pre-purchase chat, phone call, follow-up email , or abandoned-cart recovery. Organic website checkouts where you didn't interact with the customer don't count. - Review bonus: $10 per published Trustpilot review you bring in from post-purchase calls - There's no cap. The more you close, the more you make. Strong performers clear $800/month and up. Hours: 9 AM to 5 PM EST, Mon to Fri (US business hours) Tools we use: Go High Level CRM for phone, text, and live chat. How you'll learn the role: written SOPs and short video walkthroughs for both stores, plus a few live training calls with me in your first week or two. The first month is paid learning time, so curiosity and willingness to learn count. To apply, please submit: 1. Internet speed test result (50 Mbps+ preferred) 2. Typing speed test result (40+ WPM preferred) 3. One paragraph of your written English 4. A 45-second audio sample. Don't just introduce yourself, sell me. Pretend I'm a customer on the phone, on the fence about a $4,500 log splitter, and I ask: "Why shouldn't I just grab the cheaper one at my local store?" Talk me into feeling good about the bigger purchase. 5. In 3-4 sentences: tell me about the best sale you ever closed, or a tough customer you turned around. What did you actually do? 6. Your IQ score from your profile (required) 7. Your contact info Put your favorite dessert in the subject line so I know you actually read this. If your English is excellent, say so. I bump base pay for standout candidates. Looking forward to it. Facundo

title: Competitor Pricing Analyst
description: Big Little Campers is a premium campervan rental company based in Auckland and Christchurch, New Zealand. We need someone reliable to check a small set of competitor websites every working day and log their rental prices into a spreadsheet, following a fixed checklist. No sales or customer contact involved. This is a data accuracy and consistency role, not a creative one. Precision and showing up every day matter far more than speed. ## What "good" looks like in this role - Every entry is the genuine final price for the exact scenario specified, not an approximation - A working screenshot exists for every single row, no exceptions - The same scenario is checked the same way every week, so the numbers are truly comparable over time - The weekly session happens on a similar day and at a similar time each week, so the data points stay consistent - Anything odd gets flagged rather than silently logged and left for someone else to notice weeks later ## What this role does not involve - No customer contact, no phone calls, no email s to competitors or customers - No pricing decisions.
