title: Education and Training Administrator
description: Position Overview The Education and Training Administrator is responsible for providing comprehensive administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Education and Training Manager across the IntegrityX Group. The primary purpose of this role is to increase the operational capacity of the Education and Training Manager by assuming responsibility for routine administrative, operational, and coordination activities that support the effective management of the Education and Training Department. The role supports the efficient operation of the Education and Training Department across multiple business units by ensuring that administrative processes are completed accurately, documentation is maintained, projects remain organised, and routine operational activities are coordinated effectively. Working closely with the Education and Training Manager, the Training Development Officer, and the Education and Training Officers, the Education and Training Administrator provides operational support across departmental initiatives while ensuring that administrative processes are delivered efficiently and consistently. An understanding of educational environments, training operations, and learning administration is highly beneficial to ensure effective support across the Education and Training Department. The Education and Training Administrator does not perform instructional design, educational delivery, tutoring, Training Needs Analysis, or management functions, but provides the administrative support necessary for the Education and Training Manager, Training Development Officer, and Education and Training Officers to operate efficiently. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive and Departmental Management Support Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Education and Training Manager. Coordinate departmental administrative activities across multiple business units. Prepare reports, presentations, trackers, and supporting documentation required by the Education and Training Manager. Maintain departmental action registers, project trackers, and operational records. Monitor deadlines, outstanding actions, and follow-up requirements. Coordinate administrative tasks arising from management meetings and strategic initiatives. Maintain departmental templates, forms, registers, and operational documentation. Assist with the coordination of departmental projects and initiatives. Maintain confidentiality of all departmental information and records. 2. Meeting Administration and Executive Reporting Prepare agendas, meeting documentation, and presentation material for meetings hosted by the Education and Training Manager. Update management presentation slide decks using information supplied by the Education and Training Manager. Produce executive summaries fro ---------- eting transcripts. Compile action lists and extract key directives assigned to the Education and Training Manager. Maintain meeting action registers and monitor outstanding actions. Coordinate meeting schedules, invitations, and follow-up communication. Assist with the preparation of monthly and weekly departmental reporting. Maintain accurate records of decisions, actions, and meeting outcomes. 3. Training Administration and Learning Management System (LMS) Support Administer training activities within Tekmatix and other approved Learning Management Systems. Upload training materials, videos, lesson resources, assessments, and supporting documentation as directed. Maintain course structures and learning resources within the LMS. Enrol learners into training programmes as instructed by the Education and Training Manager. Allocate appropriate training programmes to employees across the IntegrityX Group. Maintain learner records and training completion data. Coordinate certification administration and maintain certificate records. Support training implementation through accurate administration and system maintenance. Maintain training development trackers and administrative records. 4. Employee Onboarding and Training Coordination Coordinate onboarding administration for new employees. Create learner profiles and training records within approved systems. Allocate onboarding and role-specific training programmes. Schedule welcome meetings between new employees and the Education and Training Manager. Send onboarding communications and training information on behalf of the Education and Training Manager. Monitor onboarding progress and training completion. Maintain onboarding trackers and escalate outstanding actions where required. Support onboarding administration across all IntegrityX Group business units. 5. Smart Workforce Academy Administration Coordinate administrative activities relating to Academy learners. Respond to routine learner enquiries using approved information and templates. Monitor learner progress through administrative tracking. Maintain learner records and certification registers. Confirm completion of automated learner communication processes. Support alumni administration and routine follow-up activities. Escalate educational, commercial, or management enquiries to the Education and Training Manager where appropriate. 6. Education Administration and Project Logistics Provide administrative support for education-related projects as directed by the Education and Training Manager. Support preparation of management documentation for education meetings. Update administrative sections of education project documentation under the direction of the Education and Training Manager. Coordinate logistical requirements for approved learner activities, educational programmes, and departmental projects. Research suppliers and obtain quotations for approved educational resources, stationery, equipment, and learning materials. Prepare procurement information for purchasing by the appropriate personnel. Coordinate logistical requirements associated with approved educational events and activities. Maintain administrative records relating to departmental education projects. 7. Documentation, Records and Operational Administration Maintain organised electronic filing systems and document repositories. Apply approved naming conventions and version control procedures. Maintain departmental trackers, registers, calendars, and operational records. Perform administrative quality checks on documentation and records. Monitor document completeness and identify missing or outdated information. Maintain departmental templates and standard documentation. Ensure accurate record keeping across departmental systems. Support audit readiness through organised documentation management. 8. Stakeholder Communication and Project Coordination Coordinate routine communication between internal stakeholders, learners, and external service providers. Send reminders, follow-ups, confirmations, and administrative correspondence on behalf of the Education and Training Manager. Coordinate project administration across departmental initiatives. Monitor project milestones and follow up on outstanding deliverables. Maintain communication records and project documentation. Escalate matters requiring managerial judgement to the Education and Training Manager. 9. Personal Learning and Internal Compliance Maintain knowledge of IntegrityX Group systems, policies, SOPs, and administrative procedures. Participate in departmental meetings and training activities. Develop proficiency in approved digital platforms, Learning Management Systems, and AI-supported administrative tools. Maintain high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and organisational excellence. Continuously identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency within the Education and Training Department. Required Skills and Attributes Qualifications A recognised Certificate, Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Office Administration, Education, Training, Project Administration, or a related field is preferred. A qualification or recognised certification in Office Administration, Executive Administration, Project Administration, Business Administration, or a related administrative discipline will be advantageous. A teaching qualification, tutoring experience, or an educational background will be considered advantageous due to the nature of the department and the support provided across education and training initiatives. Experience Previous experience in an administrative, executive support, project coordination, training administration, or education administration role. Experience working within a Learning Management System (preferably Tekmatix) or similar online learning platforms will be advantageous. Experience supporting multiple stakeholders and coordinating projects within a fast-paced environment. Experience working remotely within an international organisation will be advantageous. Skills and Attributes Excellent organisational and administrative skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. High level of proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office applications. Experience using Learning Management Systems (preferably Tekmatix) is advantageous. Strong administrative coordination and project management skills. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while supporting multiple stakeholders. Strong problem-solving and organisational skills. Professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound administrative judgement. Willingness to learn and utilise AI-supported administrative tools and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency. Ability to support an executive-level manager through effective planning, organisation, coordination, and follow-up.

You'll be across the majority of GHL's functionality so you can help clients with whichever features matter to them, deliver training, resolve support requests, and carry out small build projects. You won't be the deepest technical specialist on the team (we have automation specialists and web/funnel designers for that), but you'll be the capable, client-facing all-rounder who keeps clients confident and moving forward. ## WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING * Deliver new client training via Zoom, walking clients through the features relevant to their business * Assist with onboarding new clients, including supporting our onboarding specialist with the data migration process * Handle client support requests, most of which you'll resolve by providing clear written how-to instructions, a Loom video, or a pre-recorded video from our user training library * Escalate the small number of support requests that require GHL technical support, and track them through to resolution for the client * Build simple funnels in functional terms - placing forms, buttons and other elements on pages and testing that everything works (our web designers handle the visual design, so you won't need design skills) * Build simple workflows as part of client projects * Implement small paid projects at the request of clients * Communicate clearly and professionally with clients throughout, in both written and spoken English On more complex projects, you'll have backup from our team to help with the more challenging tasks. You're never left alone with a hard problem. ## LEARNING AND GROWTH You'll have the opportunity to deepen your GHL expertise and to work with AI tools as part of your role. We invest in our team's growth and provide training. If you enjoy learning and want to move toward mastery of the platform, you'll fit in well here. ## REQUIREMENTS * 1-2 years of hands-on experience using GoHighLevel across a broad range of features (ideal) * Previous client-facing work experience - for example customer support, customer success, account management, onboarding, or training. This is a requirement. * Clear, confident written and spoken English, and comfort speaking with clients on Zoom with screen sharing * A good working knowledge across most GHL functions: subaccounts, CRM and pipelines, forms, calendars, conversations, funnels, workflows and settings * The ability to build simple funnels (functionally) and simple workflows * A background in other IT work - such as networking, technical support, or another technical role - will be an advantage ## KEY PERSONAL QUALITIES 1. Client-focused and patient 2. "Can do" attitude 3. Takes initiative and is efficient 4. Strong problem solver who can work things out without hand-holding 5. High attention to detail 6. Reliable and consistent with communication and availability ## THE DETAILS This is a full-time position, 40 hours per week. We pay the 13th month in December. We also provide time off in lieu if we need you to work outside your regular hours to meet a deadline. We will expect to be your only employment; we are not interested in people working for multiple clients or running side businesses. We'd prefer that you work 8am - 4pm Philippines time, as this aligns with the business day here in Australia: 11am - 7pm Sydney time. Salary: US$900 - US$1,100 per month, depending on experience. ## ABOUT US We are Clientflow, an Australian GoHighLevel agency focussed on providing SaaS software to white collar services businesses, such as mortgage brokers, real estate services businesses, surveyors, education and training companies, and financial services businesses. We operate at a higher level of technical competence than most other GoHighLevel agencies. We've built a reputation for technical excellence and outstanding customer service that we will expect you to continue. Because of our reputation, clients trust us to build very sophisticated solutions in GoHighLevel for them. Few HighLevel agencies tackle implementation projects as complex as the ones we routinely complete. ## APPLYING FOR THIS ROLE Please detail how well your experience matches the requirements above when applying. Include any references that you have from previous employers for similar work, especially client-facing work. After reviewing applications, we'll hold a short initial interview, followed by a technical skills assessment as a second step. DO NOT use an AI tool to write your application for this role. We want to hear from you in entirely your own words. Feel free to also ask any questions that you have about the role and the work involved. NOTE: Do not contact us through other channels about this role. The only way to be considered for this position is to apply through this website (onlinejobs.ph).

title: Full Stack Platform Engineer
description: Our company is an English teaching platform. We offer 1 on 1 classes hosted on Google Meet. Our course material is set and students can pick up where they last left off with any teacher on the platform, allowing them to take classes based on their availability. Alongside our coursework we have additional practices, and an application we built to allow them to continue learning outside of the live sessions. Students come onto the platform and can book these 1 on 1 sessions based on the availability on the site. This booking can be done through our calendar where they choose a time availability and then a teacher that is available within that time, or they can choose a specific teacher and then book based on their availability. For our teachers they place their availability in the system, students can then book one hour long live lessons based on that availability. Teachers have the ability to unlock lessons for the students from their dashboard after a class is completed so that students can view their new practices/resources for the completed class. Teachers can also leave notes on students so that the next teacher can pick up where the previous teacher left off. From our admin panel we have the ability to edit our landing page, add or take away teachers, delete students or add credits to their account, change our pricing of our packages, add content and lessons, we have an overview of some analytics, and a few other additional features. Our system works based on credits, students can buy individual or packages of credits. Our transactions are currently conducted through stripe. A single credit is deducted from students' credits when a class is booked. When a teacher teaches a live class they will have $10 added to their payout balance. The system is then meant to recognize how much the teacher is owed for the week and automatically pay them out on Sunday from our stripe balance. Our system also automatically generates the Google meets link for both our student and teacher, based off the booking they made on our platform. Our system has some set rules for booking and cancellations that it automatically applies. Additionally, our system sends automated reminders and confirmations for classes. What we are looking for: Someone to come and resolve our current issues, and potentially add additional features. Focus Role: Full Stack Platform Engineer / SaaS Product Developer 1. Define the Primary Objectives The purpose of this role is to: Stabilize the current platform infrastructure Resolve production-level payment and booking issues Improve scheduling/calendar functionality Improve teacher and student user experience Implement scalable company account functionality Expand reporting, analytics, and administrative tools Improve mobile responsiveness and multilingual support The developer should be capable of both: Debugging existing systems Building scalable new product features 2. Immediate Priority Issues (Critical Fixes) A. Stripe Automatic Payout Failure Current issue: Teachers are not receiving automatic Sunday payouts despite successful student payments through Stripe. Developer responsibilities: Audit Stripe Connect configuration Review payout automation logic Review webhook handling and cron jobs Review failed payout logs Verify international payout support for Latin America and USA Implement reliable payout retry/error handling Ensure payout tracking visibility inside admin dashboard Expected outcome: Fully automated, stable weekly teacher payouts B. Student Booking Error Current issue: Students attempting to book available classes receive: “Slot not available or already booked” Developer responsibilities: Audit booking transaction logic Review concurrency/duplicate booking handling Review database slot locking logic Verify frontend/backend slot synchronization Improve booking reliability and error messaging Expected outcome: Students can reliably book available classes without false conflicts C. Teacher Timezone & Availability Issues Current issue: Teacher availability dates shift incorrectly for some users. Example: Thursday May 28 displays as Wednesday May 27. Developer responsibilities: Audit timezone conversion logic Verify UTC storage handling Review frontend/browser timezone interpretation Standardize timezone behavior across devices Ensure teacher local time displays correctly to students in their own timezone Expected outcome: Accurate global scheduling across all user regions D. Stripe Teacher Connection Errors Current issues: Some teachers cannot connect Stripe Some cannot reconnect/disconnect “Stripe Connected” remains incorrectly Teachers receive onboarding errors Developer responsibilities: Rebuild Stripe onboarding flow Improve Stripe Connect account reset/reconnect functionality Improve onboarding validation and logging Improve user-facing error handling Expected outcome: Reliable Stripe onboarding and reconnection flow E. Calendar Slot Generation Current issue: Continuous availability is not splitting into bookable hourly classes. Example: 3PM–6PM should automatically create: 3PM–4PM 4PM–5PM 5PM–6PM Developer responsibilities: Create automatic slot generation logic Prevent duplicate or overlapping slots Ensure slots display correctly for students and teachers Expected outcome: Fully functional class slot generation system F. Form Validation Improvements Current issue: Users receive generic “Error” or “Zod Error” messages. Developer responsibilities: Create field-specific validation messages Improve onboarding UX Improve frontend validation handling Expected outcome: Clear, actionable form error messages G. Mobile & UX Improvements Mobile PDF Issue PDFs do not display correctly on phones Language Switcher Mobile language switcher missing Spanish should be default option for Spanish-speaking users Student Payment/Booking Flow Students sometimes receive payment redirect errors despite successful purchases Developer responsibilities: Improve mobile responsiveness Improve multilingual UX Improve post-payment flow handling Improve session persistence and redirects Expected outcome: Stable and mobile-friendly user experience 3. Secondary Platform Improvements A. Admin Credit Controls Current issue: Admins can add credits but cannot remove them. Developer responsibilities: Create full credit adjustment system Add audit logs for credit changes B. Platform Messaging Accuracy Current issue: “Trusted by 1000+ students” is inaccurate. Developer responsibilities: Remove or replace inaccurate social proof messaging 4. Future Product Expansion Features A. Company Accounts System Goal: Allow businesses to purchase and manage credits for employees. Required functionality: Company account creation Shared company credit pools Multiple students under one organization Company-level reporting Company usage analytics Employee activity tracking Credit balance visibility Admin dashboard should show: Company usage Credits remaining Weekly classes used Student activity Teacher dashboard behavior should remain unchanged. B. Advanced Analytics & Reporting Goal: Improve platform insights and operational visibility. Potential features: Revenue tracking Teacher utilization Student attendance Credit usage reports Company analytics Booking trends Cancellation rates C. Weekly Calendar Navigation Goal: Allow students to browse multiple weeks of teacher availability. Required functionality: Weekly calendar view Forward/backward week navigation Faster availability browsing D. Improved Student Notes System Goal: Expand lesson notes and student tracking. Potential features: Teacher lesson notes Student learning history Saved corrections Homework/resources Shared progress tracking 5. Candidate Requirements Preferred technical experience: React / Next.js Node.js Stripe & Stripe Connect PostgreSQL or relational databases Scheduling/calendar systems SaaS platforms API integrations OAuth/Google integrations Mobile-responsive frontend development Strongly preferred: Experience debugging live production applications Experience with international timezone systems Strong product-thinking and UX awareness

title: High-Retention Horror Gaming Editor (Finishing Pass & Sound Design Expert)

description: ABOUT THE ROLE: I am looking for an elite, high-retention video editor specializing strictly in the FINISHING PASS for a fast-growing horror gaming channel. If you are a master of comedic timing, psychological horror pacing, and retention editing mechanics, this is for you. THE WORKFLOW (Why this job rules): You will NEVER have to sit through hours of raw gameplay or look for the storyline. I do 100% of the heavy lifting on the rough cut. I will hand you a tightly chopped, fully synchronized 10-minute timeline sequence. Your entire job is to take my locked narrative cuts and elevate them into a highly produced, un-skippable piece of content. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Technical Asset Conversion: Native capability handling massive 3840x1080 dual-canvas raw recording streams. You will format, scale, zoom, and frame the gameplay and facecam tracks across my existing cuts. 2. Advanced Sound Design & Scoring: Layering immersive audio environments (e.g., creepy ambient tones, footsteps, sudden sub-bass drops, and sharp jump-scare stingers). You must master the "Pacing Contrast" technique—using quirky, upbeat background instrumentals during exploration that violently drop to absolute dead silence the exact millisecond a scare or reaction occurs. 3. Dynamic VFX & Motion Effects: Executing tracking elements, visual punch-ins, camera shakes, and targeted zoom transitions to maintain high viewer retention. 4. Stylized Visual Captions: Creating clean, highly accurate, animated word-by-word pop-up subtitles with selective color-highlighting for high-intensity or funny moments. REQUIREMENTS: - Deeply embedded in Western gaming YouTube culture (you understand modern pacing, retention trends, and comedic timing). - Reliable, fast communication and strict adherence to deadlines. - Must have an active subscription or access to a premium, high-tier audio library (like Epidemic Sound) for separated instrument stems and advanced sound FX. HOW TO APPLY: To prove you read this entire posting and pay attention to detail, please reply with: 1. A link to a portfolio or short showreel demonstrating your BEST gaming/horror sound design and retention effects. 2. A brief sentence explaining how you handle audio-ducking or pacing changes when a jump scare happens. 3. Confirm you can smoothly process 3840x1080 ultrawide source files. Selected candidates will be given a short, 60-second PAID test edit sequence to showcase their skills. I look forward to working with you!

Reporting and Growth Strategy Prepare weekly TikTok Shop performance reports. Track creator performance, ad performance, inventory movement, campaign results, and operational issues. Monitor competitors, TikTok Shop trends, viral product angles, creator formats, and category opportunities. Help create SOPs and improve systems as the channel grows. Experience using TikTok Ads Manager. Understanding of FBT, seller-fulfilled orders, samples, TikTok order SLA, cancellations, and account health. Knowledge of Shopify and marketplace integrations. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is: Honest and trustworthy. Proactive and organized. Detail-oriented. Comfortable taking ownership. Strong in communication and follow-up. Able to solve problems without waiting to be told every step. Interested in growing with the company long term. Capable of becoming a future leader in the team. Success Metrics Increased TikTok Shop GMV. More active and productive creators. Higher creator video output and affiliate sales. Improved ad ROAS and campaign profitability. Fewer stockouts, sample delays, cancellations, and fulfillment issues. Accurate inventory sync across TikTok, Shopify, and other marketplaces. Clean weekly reporting and clear next-step recommendations. Stronger systems, SOPs, and team accountability. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate understands both the growth and operations side of TikTok Shop. This person can manage creators, ads, inventory, fulfillment, and marketplace syncing while staying organized and accountable. We are looking for someone who can grow with the company, take ownership of the TikTok channel, and become a trusted long-term leader in the business.

description: ## About us, in plain terms Blue Harbour ( ---------- )  helps large infrastructure organisations achieve **capital certainty** — a clear, governed, trustworthy view of where their capital programmes stand and the decisions behind them. We use AI to deliver that with a speed and diligence traditional consulting can't match: what used to take a consulting team weeks, we turn around fast and well. We're already live with our first major client in New Zealand, opening in Australia next, and built to expand into new markets after that. AI is *how we work*, not what we sell. We sell certainty; AI is our edge in producing it. We're hiring our **first operator** — the person who runs the commercial engine of the business so it keeps running and replicating into new markets. ## The role in one line Run the commercial machine end-to-end — the product-and-knowledge engine that turns delivered work into reusable assets, the business-development pipeline, the executive backbone, and research — with the judgment to know what to handle and what to escalate. ## What you'll actually do - **Run the product-and-knowledge engine — this is the heart of the role.** We turn every piece of delivered work into reusable, sellable product: the features, methods and analysis built for one client become the templates, modules and playbooks we deploy for the next. We run a structured, AI-operated "second brain" that several people contribute to, and it's already built. Your job is to keep it coherent *and* to drive the loop that converts one-off delivery into canonical, reusable assets — enforce the conventions, keep the canonical material clean and current, turn finished work into templates, and make the repeatable version of what we do one of our most valuable assets. You steward and systematise against the founder's "what good looks like"; you don't have to author the product judgment, you have to capture and compound it. - **Run the growth pipeline — Australia next.** Research and qualify the organisations we'd work with as we open a new market — whether we partner to sell and deliver, or go direct — keep the CRM current, and draft the outreach and pitches. You run the funnel right up to the close; the founder holds the relationships and closes. As you go, you help capture *how* it's done — the repeatable version of "find and win the next market" is itself one of the assets we're building. - **Hold the executive backbone.** Inbox, calendar, follow-up, focus protection. Nothing drops. - **Build the pipeline of high-value rooms and relationships.** Research and organise the events, forums, and introductions that grow our network in target markets. You handle the research and logistics; the founder handles the relationships once he's in the room. - **Run onboarding for new tea ---------- mbers.** As we bring on technical and delivery people, you run the onboarding scaffolding — training flow, a guided path through the system, the day-to-day "where does this live" — so they get productive without the founder running it. (You're building the scaffolding a future delivery team will run.) - **Draft offers of service** from a brief to ~70% off our template library; the founder takes them the rest of the way. - **Run market and competitive research** — pricing, positioning, landscape, and which market to open next — delivered as a clear, decision-useful read with sources, not a pile of links. You'll use AI throughout — the same way the business does, as the tool that makes the work fast and thorough. Day one, that means using AI with judgment to do real work; over time, you'll grow into genuinely running an AI-operated company, a skill that compounds and that almost no one has yet. ## What you get - **USD 2,000–3,000/month**, depending on experience. This is a **full-time, single-client role**, and we pay a fair full-time rate specifically so you don't need a second client splitting your focus. The pay and the single-client commitment are two halves of the same deal. - **Benefits from day one:** private health cover (HMO), a 13th-month equivalent, paid leave, and an equipment/internet allowance. We're hiring for the long term and we structure the role that way. - **A provided AI tooling seat.** - **Real growth without having to leave to get it.** You'll become fluent in running an AI-native operation — a rare and rising skill — and the role's scope deepens as the business opens new markets. - **Stability.** This is a long-term seat at a growing business, not a project or a stop-gap. We're looking for someone who wants one solid, high-trust role for years, not the next rung. ## Ramp & hours - Part-time for the first 6–8 weeks while you learn the system, **paid as a fixed monthly retainer** (not pro-rata), then full rate once you're up to speed — sooner if you're ready. - Remote, with a **minimum 4 hours' daily overlap with New Zealand business hours** (Manila daytime — no night shifts). When in your day the rest of the work happens is flexible; the overlap and "nothing drops" are not. ## Who this is for If you've run an operation end-to-end and been trusted with the whole picture before, you'll recognize this role. We're looking for someone who: - leads with **judgment** — knows what to handle, what to escalate, and what to push back on; - turns **one-offs into reusable assets** — instinctively makes the second version a template, not another from-scratch job, and can tell what's reusable from what's client-specific; - thinks in **systems and conventions** — can keep a shared system coherent as more people use it, without bottlenecking everything through themselves; - **finishes** — work arrives done and self-checked, not at 80%-and-back-to-you; - writes **clearly and fast**, and can hold someone else's voice; - uses **AI with judgment** — knows when to trust it, when not to, and when to do it by hand; - is **discreet by instinct**, not just when told; - wants a **long-term, single-client seat** and the security that comes with it. This is a high-responsibility, high-ownership role. The right person is bracing for that — for owning outcomes and holding the line on what matters — not for anything else.

title: Copywriter / Ghostwriter - Full time
description: Copywriter / Ghostwriter - Full time We are not looking for someone to schedule posts and reply with emojis. We need a ghostwriter who understands psychology first, social media second. Someone who can sit inside a CEO's head, write what he'd actually say, and make a stranger stop scrolling and think "wait, who is this." What you'll actually do: 1. Write content for the CEO and the company page. Research the news in our space. Understand exactly who we're talking to (ICP). Write posts that trigger curiosity, not posts that look nice and get ignored. 2. Get in the comments. Talk to brand owners and ecom people in their world, not just ours. Real replies. Real opinions. Not "Great point!" 3. Find prospects and start conversations. DM them. Follow up. Book meetings. This is sales-adjacent work, not just content work. What matters more than anything else: You understand why people stop scrolling. Why someone replies to a stranger's comment. Why a DM gets answered instead of ignored. That's psychology, not a content calendar. You write like a person, not a content machine. Real sentences. Real opinions. The occasional typo or rough edge is fine. We'd rather have an honest, slightly imperfect post than a polished one that sounds like every other LinkedIn post out there. What we don't need you to already know: The technical side of social media - platforms, formatting, posting schedules, repurposing one LinkedIn post into X, Instagram, and Facebook versions. That's teachable. Writing voice and psychology are not. Big plus: You know how to use Claude or GPT to scale this process without it sounding like AI wrote it. If you can use AI as a tool and still produce something that sounds like a real person typed it in five minutes, that's exactly the skill set we want Background we're looking for: Copywriting or ghostwriting experience. Someone who has written for a founder, a personal brand, or a CEO before - and can show us posts that actually got engagement, not just posts that exist. Task - send this back to us in your own words, no AI: Pick any LinkedIn post from a founder or CEO in the ecommerce / Amazon / agency space that you think is genuinely good. Send us the link. Then tell us in 3-4 sentences: - Why did this post stop you from scrolling - What's the psychological trigger it's using (curiosity, status, fear of missing out, controversy, etc.) - What would you have changed if you wrote it We want your real opinion, written the way you'd text a friend about it. Not a polished essay.

title: Administrative Coordinator
description: Full-Time Remote Administrative Coordinator / Customer Support Assistant Company: Nightingale Lawn & Landscape LLC Location: Remote, supporting a U.S.-based lawn and landscape company Schedule: Full-time, U.S. business hours required Reports to: Owner/CEO About the Role Nightingale Lawn & Landscape is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Administrative Coordinator to help keep our office organized, customers responded to, and follow-up tasks moving. This role supports daily communication, customer follow-up, accounts receivable reminders, filing, documentation, marketing admin tasks, and internal coordination. You will help make sure nothing falls through the cracks between customers, sales, operations, and billing. This is not just a basic VA role. We need someone who can think, communicate clearly, follow systems, document details, and escalate issues properly. Main Responsibilities You will help with: Answering and responding to phone calls, texts, and email s Routing customer messages to the correct team member Sending estimate follow-ups, scheduling updates, reminders, and post-job check-ins to customers Following up on overdue invoices using our approved process Documenting customer communication and next steps clearly Filing and organizing documents in our systems Helping keep tasks, reminders, and handoffs organized Supporting simple marketing admin tasks such as social posts, Google profile updates, or website updates when assigned Escalating complaints, pricing questions, scheduling conflicts, payment disputes, or unusual requests to the right leader What Success Looks Like You are successful when: Customers receive timely, professional responses Overdue invoice follow-up is completed and documented Customer updates and follow-ups are not missed Files and records stay organized Internal handoffs are clear The owner and managers are only pulled into issues that truly need them No preventable admin tasks fall through the cracks Required Skills You must have: Strong spoken and written English Professional phone and email communication High attention to detail Strong follow-through Good judgment on when to handle something and when to escalate Experience in customer service, admin support, collections follow-up, or coordinator work Comfort with email , spreadsheets, file management, and online software Ability to work remotely while staying responsive and accountable Willingness to learn our systems, including Aspire and LeanScaper AI Important Boundaries You will not make final decisions on pricing, scheduling promises, HR issues, payment exceptions, or scope changes without approval. You will not process physical payments, bank deposits, payroll, or accounts payable. Tools We Use Aspire LeanScaper AI QuickBooks Online Email and phone systems FileCenter / shared file storage Google Business Profile Social media platforms Ideal Candidate The right person is organized, reliable, calm with customers, and serious about documentation. You should be comfortable following processes, improving broken workflows, and asking good questions when something is unclear. We want someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, protects confidential information, and helps create a smoother experience for both customers and our internal team. To Apply Please send: A short (several minute) introduction about yourself Your relevant admin or customer service experience Your expected monthly salary in USD Your internet speed and computer setup A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit The word Nightingale in your subject line so we know you read the full post
